If you choose anonymity, the public ledger and the fundraiser page show the amount and “Anonymous”; nobody sees the name except our finance team. If you do not opt for anonymity, the name you entered as your display name is shown, without your email address or other data.

Vaše podatke (ime, e-poštu, iznos, način uplate, kampanju, potvrde) koristimo za obradu uplate, potvrdu, evidenciju i, ako pristanete, obavještavanje o radu udruženja. Ne prodajemo ih i ne dajemo trećima osim procesoru plaćanja, banci i pružaocima usluga koji ih obrađuju za nas, u skladu sa Politikom privatnosti. Podatke o uplatama čuvamo koliko nalažu računovodstveni propisi.

We use your data (name, email, amount, payment method, campaign, receipts) to process the payment, issue the receipt, keep records and, if you consent, inform you about the association's work. We do not sell it and do not pass it to third parties other than the payment processor, the bank and the service providers who process it for us, in accordance with the Privacy Policy. We keep payment records for as long as accounting regulations require.

Član 12 — Dupla, pogrešna ili neovlašćena uplata

Article 12 — Duplicate, erroneous or unauthorised payments

Ako je uplata prošla dva puta, ako ste unijeli pogrešan iznos ili pogrešnu kampanju, ili je kartica korišćena bez vašeg ovlašćenja, pišite na [[PLACEHOLDER: kontakt e-mail]] u roku od [[PLACEHOLDER: broj, npr. 14]] dana od zaduženja. Navedite datum, iznos i adresu e-pošte koju ste koristili pri uplati; ništa više ne tražimo.

If a payment went through twice, if you entered a wrong amount or a wrong campaign, or if your card was used without your authorisation, write to [[PLACEHOLDER: contact email]] within [[PLACEHOLDER: number, e.g. 14]] days of the charge. State the date, the amount and the email address you used when paying; we ask for nothing more.

Zahtjev provjeravamo u odnosu na evidenciju i, kada je osnovan, vraćamo novac na istu karticu ili račun sa kojeg je stigao, u roku od 15 dana od odluke. Pogrešnu kampanju ispravljamo preusmjeravanjem umjesto povraćaja ako to želite. Refundacija se u javnom registru vidi kao nova stavka sa suprotnim predznakom.

We check the request against our records and, where it is justified, refund the money to the same card or account it came from, within 15 days of the decision. We correct a wrong campaign by redirection instead of a refund if you prefer. A refund appears in the public ledger as a new row with the opposite sign.

Ako je donacija već isplaćena korisniku prije prijema zahtjeva, povraćaj nije moguć osim za neovlašćeno korišćenje kartice; o tome vas obavještavamo.

If the donation has already been paid out to the beneficiary before we receive the request, a refund is not possible except for unauthorised use of a card; we will inform you of this.

Na izvodu kartice uplata se prikazuje kao [[PLACEHOLDER: opis transakcije dogovoren sa Monri]]. Ako vidite tu stavku a ne sjećate se uplate, prvo pišite nama; brže je od reklamacije banci. Reklamaciju banci (chargeback) rješavamo sa procesorom; ako se pokaže neosnovanom, možemo odbiti buduće uplate sa te kartice.

On your card statement the payment appears as [[PLACEHOLDER: transaction descriptor agreed with Monri]]. If you see that entry and do not remember the payment, write to us first; it is faster than a dispute with your bank. A bank dispute (chargeback) is handled with the processor; if it proves unfounded, we may decline future payments from that card.

Član 13 — Kotizacije za događaje

Article 13 — Entry fees for events

Kotizacija je prijava na konkretan događaj i ide u Fond za pomoć, na cilj tog događaja, osim ako na stranici događaja piše da ide u Operativni fond. Ako događaj odložimo, prijava važi za novi termin, uz pravo prenosa na drugu osobu. Ako ga otkažemo mi, birate povraćaj kotizacije u punom iznosu na isti način plaćanja u roku od 30 dana ili njeno pretvaranje u donaciju Fondu za pomoć; pitamo vas e-poštom, bez skrivenih podrazumijevanih opcija, a ako ne odgovorite u roku od 30 dana, kotizaciju vraćamo. Ako odustanete sami, kotizaciju ne vraćamo, ali prijavu možete prenijeti do zatvaranja prijava. Sve ostalo uređuju Uslovi učešća na događajima.

An entry fee is a registration for a specific event and goes to the Impact Fund, to that event's cause, unless the event's page says it goes to the Operations Fund. If we postpone the event, the registration is valid for the new date, with the right to transfer it to another person. If we cancel it, you choose a full refund of the entry fee to the same payment method within 30 days or its conversion into a donation to the Impact Fund; we ask you by email, with no hidden default options, and if you do not answer within 30 days, we refund the entry fee. If you withdraw yourself, the entry fee is not refunded, but you may transfer the registration until registration closes. Everything else is governed by the Event Terms.

Član 14 — Šta objavljujemo

Article 14 — What we publish

U javnom registru objavljujemo za svaku uplatu: datum, iznos, ime za prikaz ili „Anonimno“, kampanju ili stranicu učesnika, ogranak i način uplate; za svaku isplatu: datum, iznos, opis korisnika koji ne otkriva identitet, kategoriju, ogranak i dokumentaciju. Objavljujemo i stanje oba fonda, formulu raspodjele po ograncima i godišnji finansijski izvještaj.

In the public ledger we publish for every payment in: the date, the amount, the display name or “Anonymous”, the campaign or fundraiser page, the chapter and the payment method; for every payment out: the date, the amount, a description of the beneficiary that does not reveal their identity, the category, the chapter and the documentation. We also publish the balance of both funds, the allocation formula by chapter and the annual financial report.

Iznose isplata objavljujemo u roku od 30 dana od isplate, a isplate korisnicima nastojimo izvršiti u roku od 60 dana od odluke Komisije.

We publish the amounts of payments out within 30 days of payment, and we aim to make payments to beneficiaries within 60 days of the Committee's decision.

Član 15 — Porezi i potvrde

Article 15 — Tax and receipts

Za svaku donaciju izdajemo potvrdu e-poštom. Privrednim društvima i preduzetnicima na zahtjev izdajemo potvrdu o donaciji sa podacima udruženja za njihove knjige; [[PLACEHOLDER: da li i pod kojim uslovima su donacije poreski priznat rashod u Crnoj Gori, potvrđuje računovođa]]. Ne dajemo poreske savjete; provjerite sa svojim računovođom.

We issue a receipt by email for every donation. To companies and sole traders we issue on request a donation confirmation with the association's details for their books; [[PLACEHOLDER: whether and under what conditions donations are a tax-deductible expense in Montenegro, to be confirmed by the accountant]]. We do not give tax advice; check with your accountant.

Član 16 — Prigovori

Article 16 — Complaints

Prigovor na uplatu, potvrdu, objavljenu stavku ili postupanje šaljete na [[PLACEHOLDER: kontakt e-mail]]. Odgovaramo u roku od 15 dana. Ako niste zadovoljni odgovorom, možete se obratiti Upravnom odboru na istu adresu sa naznakom „za Upravni odbor“.

A complaint about a payment, a receipt, a published entry or our conduct is sent to [[PLACEHOLDER: contact email]]. We reply within 15 days. If you are not satisfied with the reply, you may write to the Board at the same address, marked “for the Board”.

Član 17 — Izmjene i mjerodavno pravo

Article 17 — Changes and governing law

Pravila možemo izmijeniti; nova verzija važi za uplate nakon objave, a mjesečne donatore obavještavamo po članu 8. Svaka verzija nosi oznaku i datum. Primjenjuje se pravo Crne Gore.

We may change these rules; the new version applies to payments made after publication, and monthly donors are notified under Article 8. Every version carries a number and a date. The law of Montenegro applies.

DIO B: PRAVILA PRIHVATANJA DONACIJA (INTERNA)

PART B: GIFT ACCEPTANCE RULES (INTERNAL)

Član 18 — Koje donacije ne primamo

Article 18 — Gifts we do not accept

Udruženje ne prima donaciju: za koju postoji osnovana sumnja da potiče iz nezakonitog izvora; koja je uslovljena uticajem na izbor korisnika, zapošljavanje ili odluke organa; koja bi udruženje obavezala na promociju političke partije, kandidata ili vjerske zajednice; od lica koje udruženje ili članovi njegovih organa ne mogu identifikovati kada je to obavezno po članu 19; koja bi po ocjeni Upravnog odbora nanijela štetu ugledu udruženja. [[PLACEHOLDER: Upravni odbor odlučuje da li i koje djelatnosti davaoca isključuje, na primjer duvan ili kockanje]].

The association does not accept a donation: which is reasonably suspected to come from an illegal source; which is conditioned on influence over the selection of beneficiaries, hiring or the decisions of its bodies; which would oblige the association to promote a political party, a candidate or a religious community; from a person whom the association or the members of its bodies cannot identify when this is required under Article 19; which in the Board's judgment would harm the reputation of the association. [[PLACEHOLDER: the Board decides whether and which industries of a giver are excluded, for example tobacco or gambling]].

O odbijanju donacije odlučuje Izvršni direktor, a za iznose preko [[PLACEHOLDER: iznos]] EUR ili sporne slučajeve Upravni odbor. Odbijena i vraćena donacija se evidentira sa razlogom.

The decision to decline a donation is made by the Executive Director, and for amounts above [[PLACEHOLDER: amount]] EUR or in disputed cases by the Board. A declined and returned donation is recorded with the reason.

Član 19 — Identifikacija i veće donacije

Article 19 — Identification and larger donations

Za pojedinačnu donaciju ili zbir donacija istog davaoca u godini preko [[PLACEHOLDER: iznos]] EUR udruženje utvrđuje identitet davaoca (ime i prezime ili naziv, adresa, za pravna lica registarski broj) i, kada je iznos preko [[PLACEHOLDER: iznos]] EUR, traži izjavu o porijeklu sredstava. [[PLACEHOLDER: pragovi i obaveze po Zakonu o sprječavanju pranja novca i finansiranja terorizma za NVO, potvrđuje advokat]]. Anonimna donacija u smislu člana 11 znači skrivanje imena od javnosti, ne od udruženja; gotovinska donacija bez identifikacije davaoca prima se samo do [[PLACEHOLDER: iznos]] EUR.

For a single donation or the sum of donations from the same giver in a year above [[PLACEHOLDER: amount]] EUR, the association establishes the identity of the giver (first name and surname or company name, address, and for legal entities the registration number) and, where the amount exceeds [[PLACEHOLDER: amount]] EUR, asks for a statement on the source of funds. [[PLACEHOLDER: thresholds and obligations under the Law on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing for NGOs, to be confirmed by the lawyer]]. An anonymous donation within the meaning of Article 11 means hiding the name from the public, not from the association; a cash donation without identification of the giver is accepted only up to [[PLACEHOLDER: amount]] EUR.

Donacija iz inostranstva prima se pod istim pravilima; udruženje evidentira državu porijekla uplate.

A donation from abroad is accepted under the same rules; the association records the country of origin of the payment.

Član 20 — Rukovanje gotovinom

Article 20 — Cash handling

Gotovina se prima samo uz numerisanu potvrdu, prebrojava u prisustvu dva lica, evidentira na platformi u roku od 48 sati i polaže na račun udruženja u roku od pet radnih dana (Pravila o ograncima, član 13). Do potvrde prijema od strane udruženja iznos je „predato na čekanju“ i ne ulazi u javne iznose. Niko ne drži gotovinu udruženja na ličnom računu.

Cash is accepted only against a numbered receipt, counted in the presence of two people, logged on the platform within 48 hours and deposited in the association's account within five working days (Chapter Rules, Article 13). Until the association confirms receipt, the amount is “pending hand-in” and does not count in the public totals. Nobody holds the association's cash in a personal account.

Član 21 — Kartična plaćanja i bezbjednost

Article 21 — Card payments and security

Kartična plaćanja prima isključivo procesor Monri preko svojih komponenti; podaci o kartici ne dolaze na servere udruženja (obim PCI DSS SAQ-A). Sva obavještenja procesora provjeravaju se potpisom prije obrade, a ista uplata se evidentira samo jednom. Refundacije kartičnih uplata vrše se isključivo preko procesora na izvornu karticu.

Card payments are received exclusively by the processor Monri through its components; card data never reaches the association's servers (PCI DSS SAQ-A scope). All notifications from the processor are signature-verified before processing, and the same payment is recorded only once. Refunds of card payments are made exclusively through the processor to the original card.

Član 22 — Evidencija i odlučivanje o refundacijama

Article 22 — Records and refund decisions

Refundaciju, preusmjeravanje i ispravku odobrava Izvršni direktor ili lice koje on ovlasti, na osnovu zahtjeva i provjere evidencije; refundaciju preko [[PLACEHOLDER: iznos]] EUR odobravaju dva lica. Svaka se knjiži kao ispravka sa vezom na izvornu uplatu i razlogom, u skladu sa modelom novca udruženja (jedna knjiga, sve cifre izvedene iz nje).

A refund, redirection or correction is approved by the Executive Director or a person they authorise, on the basis of the request and a check of the records; a refund above [[PLACEHOLDER: amount]] EUR is approved by two people. Each is booked as a correction linked to the original payment, with the reason, in accordance with the association's money model (one ledger, every figure derived from it).

Udruženje ne prima donacije koje bi trebalo da isplati određenom fizičkom licu mimo odluke Komisije, ne vrši „prolazne“ uplate za treća lica i ne vraća donaciju na račun različit od izvornog.

The association does not accept donations that it would have to pay out to a specific natural person outside a Committee decision, does not make “pass-through” payments for third parties, and does not refund a donation to an account other than the original one.

DIO A: USLOVI UČEŠĆA

PART A: EVENT TERMS

Član 1 — Organizator i primjena

Article 1 — Organiser and scope

Događaje organizuje Nevladino udruženje „Santamore“, Teuta 113, Porto Montenegro, 85320 Tivat, registarski broj [[PLACEHOLDER: registarski broj]], PIB [[PLACEHOLDER: PIB]], e-pošta [[PLACEHOLDER: kontakt e-mail]] (u daljem tekstu: mi, udruženje), samostalno ili preko svojih ogranaka i u saradnji sa partnerskim klubovima.

Events are organised by the Non-governmental association “Santamore”, Teuta 113, Porto Montenegro, 85320 Tivat, registration number [[PLACEHOLDER: registration number]], PIB [[PLACEHOLDER: PIB]], email [[PLACEHOLDER: contact email]] (hereinafter: we, the association), directly or through its chapters and in cooperation with partner clubs.

Ovi uslovi važe za sve naše događaje: trke, zimska kupanja i plivanja u otvorenoj vodi, regate i jedrenje, veslanje, pješačenja, humanitarne šetnje i druga javna okupljanja koja organizujemo. Prijavom na događaj i potpisom Izjave o učešću prihvatate ih. Detalji konkretnog događaja (datum, mjesto, distance, kotizacija, minimalni uzrast, program, posebna pravila) objavljeni su na stranici tog događaja i čine dio ovih uslova.

These terms apply to all our events: runs, winter swims and open-water swims, regattas and sailing, rowing, hikes, charity walks and other public gatherings we organise. By registering for an event and signing the Participation Waiver you accept them. The details of a particular event (date, place, distances, entry fee, minimum age, programme, special rules) are published on that event's page and form part of these terms.

Ako je partner (klub, opština, sponzor) suorganizator, na stranici događaja navodimo ko odgovara za koji dio programa.

Where a partner (a club, a municipality, a sponsor) is a co-organiser, the event page states who is responsible for which part of the programme.

Član 2 — Prijava

Article 2 — Registration

Prijava se podnosi isključivo preko naše internet platforme. Prijava važi kada: popunite obrazac sa tačnim podacima; potpišete Izjavu o učešću (dio B) elektronski, potvrdom na platformi; platite kotizaciju predviđenu za događaj, ako je ima; i primite potvrdu prijave e-poštom.

Registration is made exclusively through our online platform. A registration stands once you: complete the form with accurate details; sign the Participation Waiver (Part B) electronically, by confirmation on the platform; pay the entry fee set for the event, if there is one; and receive the registration confirmation by email.

Prijava je lična. Startni broj, čip i sve što uz prijavu dobijete smijete koristiti samo vi. Nastup pod tuđim brojem znači diskvalifikaciju oba učesnika i gubitak prava na osiguranje i medicinsku pomoć po ovim uslovima.

Registration is personal. The race number, the timing chip and everything else you receive with your registration may be used only by you. Taking part under someone else's number means disqualification of both participants and loss of the right to insurance and medical assistance under these terms.

Broj mjesta je ograničen kapacitetom navedenim na stranici događaja. Prijave se zatvaraju kada se kapacitet popuni ili istekom roka navedenog na stranici, šta prije nastupi. Naknadna prijava na dan događaja moguća je samo ako je stranica događaja tako predvidjela.

The number of places is limited to the capacity stated on the event page. Registration closes when the capacity is full or when the deadline stated on the page expires, whichever comes first. Late registration on the day of the event is possible only if the event page provides for it.

Kotizacije idu u Operativni fond udruženja: iz njih se plaća organizacija događaja (dozvole, osiguranje, medicinska služba, oprema, staza, majice, medalje), ne donacije. Iznos kotizacije naveden je na stranici događaja sa uračunatim porezima. Na plaćanja kotizacija primjenjuju se i Pravila donacija u dijelu koji se odnosi na način plaćanja, potvrde i povraćaje.

Entry fees go to the association's Operations Fund: they pay for organising the event (permits, insurance, medical service, equipment, course, shirts, medals), not for donations. The amount of the entry fee is stated on the event page with taxes included. The Donation Policy also applies to entry fee payments in the part concerning payment methods, receipts and refunds.

Član 3 — Zdravstvena spremnost

Article 3 — Medical fitness

Prijavom izjavljujete da ste zdravstveno sposobni za napor koji izabrana distanca ili aktivnost nosi, da ste se u slučaju bilo kakve sumnje posavjetovali sa ljekarom i da vam nije poznata nijedna vaša zdravstvena okolnost koja učešće čini opasnim za vas ili druge.

By registering you declare that you are medically fit for the effort that the chosen distance or activity involves, that in case of any doubt you have consulted a doctor, and that you know of no medical condition of yours that makes participation dangerous for you or for others.

Za zimska kupanja i plivanje u otvorenoj vodi posebno izjavljujete da razumijete dejstvo hladne vode na organizam (šok od hladne vode, gubitak snage, pothlađenost) i da nemate stanje srca, krvnih sudova ili disajnih organa koje takvo izlaganje čini opasnim.

For winter swims and open-water swimming you additionally declare that you understand the effect of cold water on the body (cold-water shock, loss of strength, hypothermia) and that you have no cardiac, vascular or respiratory condition that makes such exposure dangerous.

Možemo, ali nismo dužni, tražiti ljekarsko uvjerenje za pojedine događaje ili distance; to je navedeno na stranici događaja.

We may, but are not obliged to, require a medical certificate for particular events or distances; this is stated on the event page.

Možete nas na obrascu za prijavu obavijestiti o alergijama, hroničnim stanjima i ljekovima koje uzimate, ako želite da medicinska služba to zna; te podatke vide samo rukovodilac događaja i medicinska služba.

You may inform us on the registration form of allergies, chronic conditions and medication you take, if you want the medical service to know; only the event manager and the medical service see this information.

Član 4 — Minimalni uzrast i maloljetni učesnici

Article 4 — Minimum age and minor participants

Minimalni uzrast po aktivnosti i distanci: [[PLACEHOLDER: tabela minimalnog uzrasta po distanci i aktivnosti, npr. dječija trka do 1 km od 5 godina uz roditelja, 5 km od 12, 10 km od 16, zimsko kupanje od 16 uz roditelja i od 18 samostalno, regata prema pravilima kluba, pub crawl 18+]]. Uzrast se računa na dan događaja. Stranica događaja može odrediti stroži uzrast.

Minimum age by activity and distance: [[PLACEHOLDER: table of minimum ages by distance and activity, e.g. children's run up to 1 km from 5 years with a parent, 5 km from 12, 10 km from 16, winter swim from 16 with a parent and from 18 alone, regatta according to the club's rules, pub crawl 18+]]. Age is counted on the day of the event. The event page may set a stricter age.

Za učesnika mlađeg od 18 godina prijavu podnosi i Izjavu o učešću potpisuje roditelj ili staratelj, koji: odgovara za procjenu da je dijete spremno za izabranu distancu; navodi broj telefona na kome je dostupan tokom događaja; za dijete mlađe od [[PLACEHOLDER: uzrast, npr. 12]] godina prisutan je na događaju lično ili preko punoljetnog lica koje pisano odredi; navodi lice ovlašćeno da preuzme dijete nakon aktivnosti.

For a participant under 18, the registration is submitted and the Participation Waiver signed by a parent or guardian, who: is responsible for judging that the child is ready for the chosen distance; gives a telephone number on which they can be reached during the event; for a child under [[PLACEHOLDER: age, e.g. 12]] is present at the event in person or through an adult they designate in writing; and names the person authorised to collect the child after the activity.

Na svakom događaju važi naša Politika zaštite djece: djeca se predaju samo roditelju ili navedenom licu, aktivnosti sa djecom vode najmanje dvije odrasle osobe, a dijete na fotografiji objavljujemo samo uz saglasnost roditelja.

Our Child Safeguarding Policy applies at every event: children are handed over only to the parent or the named person, activities with children are led by at least two adults, and we publish a photograph of a child only with the parent's consent.

Član 5 — Šta obezbjeđujemo

Article 5 — What we provide

Za svaki događaj obezbjeđujemo ono što je navedeno na stranici događaja, a najmanje: dozvole nadležnih organa; obilježenu i, gdje je potrebno, obezbijeđenu trasu; redare i uputstva; prvu pomoć na licu mjesta srazmjerno broju učesnika i aktivnosti; za događaje u vodi kvalifikovane spasioce, pratilački čamac i bezbjednosni brifing; imenovano lice za zaštitu djece kada učestvuju djeca; osiguranje od odgovornosti organizatora; okrepu, startni broj, majicu ili kostim i medalju kada su navedeni na stranici događaja.

For every event we provide what is listed on the event page, and at least: permits from the competent authorities; a marked and, where necessary, secured course; marshals and instructions; first aid on site proportionate to the number of participants and the activity; for events in the water, qualified lifeguards, a safety boat and a safety briefing; a named safeguarding lead when children take part; organiser's liability insurance; refreshments, a race number, a shirt or costume and a medal when they are listed on the event page.

Ne obezbjeđujemo lično osiguranje učesnika od nezgode, osim ako je na stranici događaja navedeno drugačije. Preporučujemo da provjerite sopstveno zdravstveno osiguranje i osiguranje od nezgode, posebno za aktivnosti u vodi i na moru.

We do not provide personal accident insurance for participants unless the event page states otherwise. We recommend that you check your own health insurance and accident insurance, especially for activities in the water and at sea.

Član 6 — Rizici i odgovornost

Article 6 — Risks and liability

Trčanje, plivanje u moru zimi i u otvorenoj vodi, jedrenje, veslanje i okupljanja na otvorenom nose stvarne rizike: pad, iscrpljenost, dehidraciju, hladnu vodu, struje i talase, sudar sa drugim učesnikom, plovilom ili preprekom, nagle promjene vremena, povrede koje mogu biti teške. Učestvujete svojom voljom, na sopstveni rizik i prema sopstvenoj procjeni svojih sposobnosti.

Running, swimming in the sea in winter and in open water, sailing, rowing and outdoor gatherings carry real risks: falls, exhaustion, dehydration, cold water, currents and waves, collision with another participant, a vessel or an obstacle, sudden changes in the weather, injuries that can be serious. You take part of your own free will, at your own risk and on your own assessment of your abilities.

Dužni smo da događaj organizujemo sa pažnjom dobrog organizatora: sa dozvolama, obilježenom trasom, redarima, medicinskom službom i spasiocima kako je navedeno u članu 5 i na stranici događaja. Ne možemo ukloniti rizike koji su dio same aktivnosti i ne odgovaramo za štetu koja iz njih proizađe.

We must organise the event with the care of a prudent organiser: with permits, a marked course, marshals, a medical service and lifeguards as set out in Article 5 and on the event page. We cannot remove the risks that are part of the activity itself and we are not liable for harm arising from them.

Ne odgovaramo za štetu koju prouzrokujete sami sebi ili drugima nepoštovanjem ovih uslova, uputstava redara, spasilaca i medicinske službe, ili učešćem u stanju koje je suprotno članu 3.

We are not liable for harm you cause to yourself or to others by failing to comply with these terms or with the instructions of marshals, lifeguards and the medical service, or by taking part in a condition contrary to Article 3.

Ova odredba ne isključuje niti ograničava našu odgovornost za štetu prouzrokovanu namjerno ili krajnjom nepažnjom, za smrt ili tjelesnu povredu nastalu našom krivicom, ni bilo koju odgovornost koja se po zakonu ne može isključiti ili ograničiti.

This provision neither excludes nor limits our liability for harm caused intentionally or by gross negligence, for death or bodily injury caused by our fault, or any liability that cannot be excluded or limited by law.

Za štetu koju prouzrokujete trećim licima ili imovini tokom događaja odgovarate sami.

You are yourself liable for damage you cause to third parties or to property during the event.

Član 7 — Pravo da vas zaustavimo

Article 7 — Our right to stop you

Rukovodilac događaja, redar, spasilac ili medicinska služba mogu vam narediti da prekinete učešće, napustite vodu ili stazu, ili primite pomoć, kada procijene da je vaše zdravlje ili bezbjednost, ili bezbjednost drugih, ugroženo. Dužni ste da postupite odmah. Odbijanje znači isključenje sa događaja bez povraćaja kotizacije.

The event manager, a marshal, a lifeguard or the medical service may order you to stop taking part, to leave the water or the course, or to accept help, when they judge that your health or safety, or the safety of others, is at risk. You must comply immediately. Refusal means exclusion from the event without a refund of the entry fee.

Kontrolna vremena i tačke prekida za svaku distancu objavljeni su na stranici događaja; učesnik koji ih ne stigne nastavlja na sopstvenu odgovornost van organizovanog dijela događaja, bez redara, obezbjeđenja staze i medicinske službe, ili se povlači po uputstvu redara.

Cut-off times and cut-off points for each distance are published on the event page; a participant who does not reach them continues at their own responsibility outside the organised part of the event, without marshals, course security or the medical service, or withdraws as instructed by the marshals.

Ako primite medicinsku pomoć na događaju, saglasni ste da vam se pruži prva pomoć i, kada je potrebno, da budete prevezeni u zdravstvenu ustanovu. Troškove liječenja van prve pomoći na licu mjesta snosite vi ili vaše osiguranje.

If you receive medical assistance at the event, you consent to being given first aid and, where necessary, to being transported to a healthcare facility. The costs of treatment beyond first aid on site are borne by you or your insurance.

Član 8 — Ponašanje na događaju

Article 8 — Conduct at the event

Dužni ste da: pratite uputstva organizatora, redara, spasilaca i medicinske službe; ostanete na obilježenoj trasi ili u označenoj zoni; nosite startni broj vidljivo; ne ugrožavate, ne ometate i ne vrijeđate druge učesnike, volontere, gledaoce ni stanovnike; poštujete saobraćajna pravila tamo gdje staza nije zatvorena za saobraćaj; ne bacate otpad van predviđenih mjesta; poštujete Kodeks ponašanja udruženja.

You must: follow the instructions of the organiser, marshals, lifeguards and the medical service; stay on the marked course or in the designated zone; wear your race number visibly; not endanger, obstruct or insult other participants, volunteers, spectators or residents; obey traffic rules where the course is not closed to traffic; not drop litter outside the places provided; and comply with the association's Code of Conduct.

Zabranjeno je: učešće pod dejstvom alkohola ili droga na trkama, plivanjima, regatama i drugim fizičkim aktivnostima; nošenje staklene ambalaže na stazi i u zoni starta i cilja; korišćenje bicikala, trotineta, rolera i vozila na stazi osim vozila organizatora; praćenje učesnika vozilom ili plovilom bez dozvole organizatora; slušalice u oba uva tamo gdje je staza otvorena za saobraćaj ili gdje stranica događaja to zabranjuje; dovođenje životinja na stazu osim pasa vodiča; ponašanje i oprema koji vrijeđaju druge.

The following is prohibited: taking part under the influence of alcohol or drugs in runs, swims, regattas and other physical activities; carrying glass containers on the course and in the start and finish zone; using bicycles, scooters, roller skates and vehicles on the course other than the organiser's vehicles; escorting a participant by vehicle or vessel without the organiser's permission; headphones in both ears where the course is open to traffic or where the event page forbids them; bringing animals onto the course other than guide dogs; conduct and equipment that offend others.

Kostimi i oprema, uključujući odijela Djeda Mraza, moraju biti bezbjedni za aktivnost: bez dijelova koji se mogu zaplesti, bez otvorenog plamena, prilagođeni vremenu i vodi.

Costumes and equipment, including Santa suits, must be safe for the activity: no parts that can snag, no open flame, suited to the weather and the water.

Učesnika koji ozbiljno krši ova pravila ili ugrožava bezbjednost možemo udaljiti sa događaja i diskvalifikovati bez povraćaja kotizacije, a u ponovljenom ili teškom slučaju isključiti iz budućih prijava.

A participant who seriously breaches these rules or endangers safety may be removed from the event and disqualified without a refund of the entry fee and, in a repeated or grave case, excluded from future registrations.

Član 9 — Posebna pravila po vrsti događaja

Article 9 — Special rules by type of event

Trke i šetnje. Startujete u grupi i vremenu koje vam je dodijeljeno. Poštujete zatvaranje staze i uputstva policije i redara na raskrsnicama. Kolica za djecu, invalidska kolica i pratnja učesnika sa invaliditetom dozvoljeni su kada stranica događaja to predviđa, uz posebnu startnu zonu.

Runs and walks. You start in the wave and at the time assigned to you. You respect course closures and the instructions of the police and marshals at junctions. Prams, wheelchairs and support for participants with disabilities are allowed when the event page provides for it, with a dedicated start zone.

Zimska kupanja i plivanje u otvorenoj vodi. Ulazite u vodu samo po znaku spasilaca, u označenoj zoni i u grupi kojoj ste dodijeljeni. Nosite kapu u boji koju odredimo. Izlazite na znak ili čim osjetite hladnoću, drhtavicu, slabost ili vrtoglavicu. Nakon izlaska se odmah presvlačite u suvu odjeću koju ste dužni ponijeti. Za plivanje na distanci dodatno: bova ili plutača ako je stranica događaja propisuje, zabrana plivanja van označene trase, pratnja čamaca i obaveza da im se javite na znak.

Winter swims and open-water swimming. You enter the water only on the lifeguards' signal, in the marked zone and in the group assigned to you. You wear a cap in the colour we set. You leave the water on the signal or as soon as you feel cold, shivering, weakness or dizziness. After leaving the water you change immediately into the dry clothes you are required to bring. For distance swims, additionally: a tow float or buoy if the event page requires it, no swimming outside the marked course, escort boats and the obligation to respond to their signal.

Regate i jedrenje. Skiper plovila odgovara za plovilo, posadu, opremu za spasavanje i poštovanje pravila plovidbe i pravila regate kluba organizatora. Plovilo mora biti registrovano i osigurano u skladu sa zakonom. Svaki član posade potpisuje Izjavu o učešću; za maloljetne članove posade važi član 4. Organizator može otkazati ili prekinuti regatu zbog vjetra i mora bez odgovornosti za štetu.

Regattas and sailing. The skipper of the vessel is responsible for the vessel, the crew, the rescue equipment and compliance with the rules of navigation and the racing rules of the organising club. The vessel must be registered and insured in accordance with the law. Every crew member signs the Participation Waiver; Article 4 applies to crew members who are minors. The organiser may cancel or abandon the regatta because of wind and sea conditions without liability for damage.

Događaji sa alkoholom (pub crawl i slično). Samo za lica sa navršenih 18 godina, uz provjeru dokumenta. Nema takmičenja u piću. Ugostitelji služe po zakonu; organizator može isključiti učesnika koji je vidno pod dejstvom alkohola i pozvati mu prevoz. Ne organizujemo fizičku aktivnost za učesnike takvog događaja istog dana.

Events with alcohol (pub crawl and similar). Only for persons aged 18 or over, with an identity document check. No drinking contests. Venues serve in accordance with the law; the organiser may exclude a participant who is visibly under the influence of alcohol and call transport for them. We do not organise physical activity for the participants of such an event on the same day.

Član 10 — Fotografisanje i objavljivanje

Article 10 — Photography and publication

Na događajima fotografišemo i snimamo za galeriju, izvještaje, objave i materijale sponzora. Pri prijavi birate da li pristajete da budete prepoznatljivi na objavljenim materijalima. Ako ne pristanete, to poštujemo pri izboru i obradi materijala; grupne i panoramske snimke na kojima ste jedan od mnogih učesnika možemo objaviti, a svaku objavljenu fotografiju na kojoj se prepoznate uklanjamo u roku od tri radna dana na zahtjev poslat na [[PLACEHOLDER: kontakt e-mail]].

At events we take photographs and film for the gallery, reports, posts and sponsor materials. At registration you choose whether you consent to being identifiable in published material. If you do not consent, we respect that when selecting and editing material; we may publish group and panoramic shots in which you are one of many participants, and we remove any published photograph in which you recognise yourself within three working days of a request sent to [[PLACEHOLDER: contact email]].

Za djecu je potrebna izričita saglasnost roditelja ili staratelja, koja se može povući u svakom trenutku; uz fotografiju djeteta ne objavljujemo ime ni podatke po kojima se dijete može naći.

For children, the explicit consent of a parent or guardian is required and may be withdrawn at any time; we do not publish a child's name or any details by which the child could be found alongside the child's photograph.

Materijal ne prodajemo i ne ustupamo za komercijalnu upotrebu van promocije udruženja, njegovih događaja i sponzora događaja.

We do not sell the material or license it for commercial use beyond promoting the association, its events and the event's sponsors.

Član 11 — Lični podaci

Article 11 — Personal data

Podatke iz prijave (ime, datum rođenja, kontakt, veličina majice, kontakt za hitne slučajeve, zdravstvene napomene koje ste sami dali, podatke o plaćanju, potpisanu Izjavu o učešću sa datumom i verzijom) obrađujemo radi organizacije događaja, bezbjednosti, rezultata, računovodstva i obavještavanja o događaju, u skladu sa našom Politikom privatnosti.

We process the registration data (name, date of birth, contact details, shirt size, emergency contact, health notes you have given yourself, payment data, the signed Participation Waiver with its date and version) for organising the event, safety, results, accounting and event communication, in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

Ime, startni broj, kategoriju i rezultat objavljujemo na listi rezultata, osim ako pri prijavi izaberete da vaše ime na rezultatima bude sakriveno. Kontakt za hitne slučajeve koristimo samo u hitnom slučaju.

We publish the name, race number, category and result in the results list, unless at registration you choose to have your name hidden in the results. We use the emergency contact only in an emergency.

Član 12 — Odustajanje i prenos prijave

Article 12 — Withdrawal and transfer of registration

Ako odustanete, kotizaciju ne vraćamo: događaj se planira i plaća prema broju prijavljenih. Do zatvaranja prijava možete besplatno prenijeti prijavu na drugu osobu: javite nam se sa podacima nove osobe, koja potom potpisuje svoju Izjavu o učešću i, ako se prijavljuje na drugu distancu, plaća razliku u kotizaciji. Prenos nije moguć na dan događaja.

If you withdraw, we do not refund the entry fee: the event is planned and paid for according to the number of registered participants. Until registration closes you may transfer your registration to another person free of charge: contact us with the new person's details; that person then signs their own Participation Waiver and, if registering for a different distance, pays the difference in the entry fee. No transfer is possible on the day of the event.

Izuzetno, kod povrede ili bolesti dokazane ljekarskim izvještajem prije zatvaranja prijava, možete izabrati prenos prijave na sljedeće izdanje istog događaja umjesto povraćaja.

Exceptionally, in case of injury or illness proven by a medical report before registration closes, you may choose to carry your registration over to the next edition of the same event instead of a refund.

Član 13 — Vrijeme, viša sila i otkazivanje

Article 13 — Weather, force majeure and cancellation

Bezbjednost ide prije programa. Ako vremenski uslovi, stanje mora, odluka nadležnog organa, viša sila ili drugi razlog van naše kontrole događaj učine opasnim ili nemogućim, možemo ga skratiti, izmijeniti trasu ili program, odložiti ili otkazati, i prije i tokom događaja. Odluku objavljujemo na sajtu i šaljemo prijavljenima e-poštom čim je donesemo, a na licu mjesta preko razglasa i redara.

Safety comes before the programme. If weather conditions, the state of the sea, a decision of a competent authority, force majeure or any other reason beyond our control makes the event dangerous or impossible, we may shorten it, change the course or the programme, postpone it or cancel it, both before and during the event. We publish the decision on the website and send it to registered participants by email as soon as we take it, and on site by public address and through the marshals.

Ako događaj odložimo, prijava važi za novi termin, uz pravo prenosa na drugu osobu do zatvaranja prijava za novi termin. Ako događaj otkažemo mi, birate: povraćaj plaćene kotizacije na isti način plaćanja u roku od 30 dana, ili njeno pretvaranje u donaciju, kako je opisano u Pravilima donacija. Skraćenje, izmjena trase ili prekid već započetog događaja iz bezbjednosnih razloga ne daju pravo na povraćaj.

If we postpone the event, your registration stands for the new date, with the right to transfer it to another person until registration for the new date closes. If we cancel the event, you choose: a refund of the entry fee paid, to the same payment method, within 30 days, or its conversion into a donation, as described in the Donation Policy. Shortening, rerouting or stopping an event already under way for safety reasons gives no right to a refund.

Ne odgovaramo za vaše putne troškove, smještaj ni druge troškove nastale zbog odlaganja ili otkazivanja.

We are not liable for your travel costs, accommodation or other costs incurred because of a postponement or cancellation.

Član 14 — Rezultati, nagrade i prigovori

Article 14 — Results, prizes and protests

Rezultate objavljujemo na sajtu u roku navedenom na stranici događaja. Prigovor na rezultat podnosi se rukovodiocu događaja u roku od 30 minuta od objave na licu mjesta, odnosno u roku od 48 sati od objave na sajtu; odluka rukovodioca događaja je konačna. Nagrade su navedene na stranici događaja i ne mogu se zamijeniti za novac osim kada su novčane. Dobitnik nagrade saglasan je da se njegovo ime i fotografija sa dodjele objave.

We publish the results on the website within the time stated on the event page. A protest against a result is submitted to the event manager within 30 minutes of publication on site, or within 48 hours of publication on the website; the event manager's decision is final. Prizes are listed on the event page and cannot be exchanged for money unless they are cash prizes. A prize winner agrees to the publication of their name and a photograph from the award ceremony.

Član 15 — Prikupljanje sredstava uz učešće

Article 15 — Fundraising alongside participation

Učesnik može uz prijavu otvoriti stranicu za prikupljanje sredstava na našoj platformi. Prilozi prikupljeni preko te stranice su donacije udruženju namijenjene korisnicima i ne odnose se na kotizaciju; na njih se primjenjuju Pravila donacija. Učesnik ne prima niti prosljeđuje priloge lično; gotovinu koju prikupi predaje udruženju po pravilima o evidenciji gotovine.

A participant may open a fundraiser page on our platform alongside their registration. Contributions collected through that page are donations to the association intended for beneficiaries and are unrelated to the entry fee; the Donation Policy applies to them. The participant neither receives nor passes on contributions personally; any cash they collect is handed over to the association under the cash-handling rules.

Član 16 — Lične stvari i garderoba

Article 16 — Personal belongings and bag drop

Garderobu obezbjeđujemo kada je navedena na stranici događaja. Stvari ostavljate na sopstvenu odgovornost; ne odgovaramo za novac, nakit, uređaje i druge vrijedne stvari. Nepreuzete stvari čuvamo 30 dana.

We provide a bag drop when it is listed on the event page. You leave belongings at your own responsibility; we are not liable for money, jewellery, devices or other valuables. We keep unclaimed items for 30 days.

Član 17 — Prigovori i kontakt

Article 17 — Complaints and contact

Prigovor na organizaciju događaja, naplatu ili postupanje našeg tima šaljete na [[PLACEHOLDER: kontakt e-mail]] u roku od 14 dana od događaja. Odgovaramo u roku od 15 dana. Prigovor koji se tiče djeteta ili zaštite djece ide odgovornom licu za zaštitu djece po Politici zaštite djece.

A complaint about the organisation of an event, a charge or the conduct of our team is sent to [[PLACEHOLDER: contact email]] within 14 days of the event. We reply within 15 days. A complaint concerning a child or child safeguarding goes to the safeguarding lead under the Child Safeguarding Policy.

Član 18 — Izmjene uslova

Article 18 — Changes to the terms

Uslove možemo izmijeniti za buduće događaje. Za događaj na koji ste se prijavili važi verzija koju ste prihvatili pri prijavi, osim izmjena koje nalaže zakon ili nadležni organ, o kojima vas obavještavamo e-poštom. Svaka verzija nosi oznaku i datum.

We may change the terms for future events. For an event you have registered for, the version you accepted at registration applies, except for changes required by law or by a competent authority, of which we notify you by email. Every version carries a version number and a date.

Član 19 — Mjerodavno pravo i nadležnost

Article 19 — Governing law and jurisdiction

Na ove uslove primjenjuje se pravo Crne Gore. Sporove nastojimo riješiti dogovorom; ako to ne uspije, nadležan je [[PLACEHOLDER: stvarno i mjesno nadležni sud za Tivat, potvrđuje advokat]]. Ako je pojedina odredba ništava, ostale ostaju na snazi.

These terms are governed by the law of Montenegro. We seek to settle disputes by agreement; if that fails, jurisdiction lies with [[PLACEHOLDER: the court with subject-matter and territorial jurisdiction for Tivat, to be confirmed by the lawyer]]. If any provision is void, the others remain in force.

In addition to declaration B.1 or B.2, a crew member confirms: the name and registration of the vessel, the skipper's name, that the skipper is familiar with the racing rules and responsible for the vessel and the crew, and that the vessel is insured in accordance with the law.

DIO A: KODEKS (JAVNI)

PART A: THE CODE (PUBLIC)

Član 1 — Zašto i za koga

Article 1 — Why and for whom

Trčimo, plivamo i slavimo zajedno i hoćemo da se na našim događajima, na sajtu i u našem timu svako osjeća dobrodošlo i bezbjedno. Ovaj kodeks važi za sve: učesnike, navijače i posjetioce; volontere, tim, članove organa i osnivače; partnere, sponzore, fotografe i izvođače dok rade sa nama. Važi na događajima i pripremama za njih, na stranicama za prikupljanje, u porukama i komentarima, na našim nalozima na društvenim mrežama, i svuda gdje nastupate u ime udruženja.

We run, swim and celebrate together, and we want everyone to feel welcome and safe at our events, on the site and in our team. This code applies to everyone: participants, supporters and visitors; volunteers, staff, officers and founders; partners, sponsors, photographers and contractors while they work with us. It applies at events and in their preparation, on fundraiser pages, in messages and comments, on our social media accounts, and wherever you act in the name of the association.

Prihvatanjem Uslova učešća, otvaranjem naloga, volontiranjem ili radom sa nama prihvatate i ovaj kodeks. Kada kodeks i neki drugi naš dokument uređuju isto pitanje, važi stroži.

By accepting the Event Terms, opening an account, volunteering or working with us you also accept this code. Where this code and another of our documents govern the same point, the stricter one applies.

Član 2 — Naša načela

Article 2 — Our principles

  1. Svi su dobrodošli. Bez obzira na pol, uzrast, porijeklo, jezik, vjeru, invaliditet, izgled, seksualnu orijentaciju, imovno stanje ili sportsku spremu. Naši događaji su za rekreativce, takmičare i one koji su došli da navijaju.
  2. Niko se ne ismijava. Ne zato što je spor, prvi put u vodi, u kostimu Djeda Mraza ili zato što je odustao.
  3. Bezbjednost prije programa. Kad postoji sumnja, odlučujemo u korist bezbjednosti, i ako to znači prekid.
  4. Novac je javan. Svaki euro koji prođe kroz nas vidi se u javnom registru; niko od nas ne rukuje novcem mimo pravila.
  5. Djeca prije svega. Za sve što se tiče djece važi Politika zaštite djece, bez izuzetka.
  6. Ovo je naš grad i naše more. Ponašamo se kao gosti u sopstvenoj zajednici: prema komšijama, prema ugostiteljima, prema obali.
  1. Everyone is welcome. Regardless of sex, age, origin, language, religion, disability, appearance, sexual orientation, means or fitness. Our events are for recreational runners, competitors and those who have come to cheer.
  2. Nobody gets mocked. Not for being slow, for being in the water for the first time, for wearing a Santa suit or for dropping out.
  3. Safety before the programme. When in doubt, we decide in favour of safety, even if that means stopping.
  4. Money is public. Every euro that passes through us is visible in the public ledger; none of us handles money outside the rules.
  5. Children first. For everything that concerns children the Child Safeguarding Policy applies, without exception.
  6. This is our town and our sea. We behave as guests in our own community: towards neighbours, towards venues, towards the shore.

Član 3 — Poštovanje i uznemiravanje

Article 3 — Respect and harassment

Ponašaj se prema ljudima sa poštovanjem, uživo i onlajn. Uznemiravanje ne tolerišemo. Pod uznemiravanjem podrazumijevamo, između ostalog:

Treat people with respect, in person and online. We do not tolerate harassment. By harassment we mean, among other things:

  1. uvrede, ponižavanje, prijetnje i zastrašivanje;
  2. neželjene komentare o tijelu, izgledu ili sposobnostima, neželjene dodire i nasrtljivost;
  3. diskriminatorne ispade, „šale“ i simbole po bilo kom osnovu iz člana 2;
  4. fotografisanje ili snimanje nekoga ko je to odbio, i objavljivanje tuđih fotografija ili podataka bez saglasnosti;
  5. uporno prekidanje, praćenje, pisanje ili pritiskanje nakon jasnog „ne“;
  6. seksualno uznemiravanje u bilo kom obliku;
  7. odmazdu prema nekome ko je prijavio problem ili odbio da učestvuje u nečemu.
  1. insults, humiliation, threats and intimidation;
  2. unwanted comments about someone's body, appearance or ability, unwanted touching and pushiness;
  3. discriminatory outbursts, "jokes" and symbols on any of the grounds in Article 2;
  4. photographing or filming someone who has refused, and publishing other people's photographs or data without consent;
  5. persistent interrupting, following, messaging or pressuring after a clear "no";
  6. sexual harassment in any form;
  7. retaliation against someone who reported a problem or declined to take part in something.

Nasilje, prijetnja nasiljem i seksualno uznemiravanje su najteže povrede i po pravilu znače trenutno udaljenje i zabranu.

Violence, threats of violence and sexual harassment are the gravest breaches and as a rule mean immediate removal and a ban.

Član 4 — Onlajn prostor

Article 4 — Online

Stranice za prikupljanje, poruke uz donacije, komentari, timski razgovori i naši nalozi na društvenim mrežama dio su istog prostora. Pišite istinito i pristojno; ne objavljujte tuđe lične podatke; ne reklamirajte; ne koristite naše naloge i grupe za političke, vjerske ni komercijalne poruke. Poruke koje vrijeđaju, obmanjuju ili uznemiravaju uklanjamo, a naloge koji to ponavljaju suspendujemo, kako je opisano u Uslovima korišćenja.

Fundraiser pages, donation messages, comments, team chats and our social media accounts are part of the same space. Write truthfully and civilly; do not publish other people's personal data; do not advertise; do not use our accounts and groups for political, religious or commercial messages. We remove messages that insult, mislead or harass, and we suspend accounts that repeat this, as described in the Terms of Use.

Kada objavljujete o našim događajima na svojim nalozima, jasno je da govorite u svoje ime, osim ako vas udruženje nije ovlastilo. Ne dogovarajte ni ne vodite privatne razgovore sa djecom u vezi sa našim aktivnostima; komunikacija ide preko roditelja.

When you post about our events on your own accounts, it is clear that you speak for yourself, unless the association has authorised you. Do not arrange or hold private conversations with children in connection with our activities; communication goes through parents.

Član 5 — Fer igra

Article 5 — Fair play

Na trkama, plivanjima i regatama: startuj u svojoj grupi, drži se obilježene trase, ne skraćuj, ne koristi tuđi startni broj i ne daj svoj drugome, ne primaj nedozvoljenu pomoć (vozilo, bicikl, plovilo, vuča) i ne ometaj druge. Rezultat postignut varanjem se briše, a ponovljeno varanje isključuje iz budućih događaja. Kod izazova na platformi: prijavljuj samo aktivnosti koje si zaista uradio i samo sa svog naloga.

At races, swims and regattas: start in your own wave, keep to the marked course, do not cut it short, do not use someone else's race number and do not give yours to anyone else, do not accept unauthorised assistance (vehicle, bicycle, boat, towing) and do not obstruct others. A result achieved by cheating is struck, and repeated cheating means exclusion from future events. On platform challenges: log only activities you have really done, and only from your own account.

Pobjednici i brzi učesnici čekaju i pozdravljaju posljednje. To je naš običaj.

Winners and fast finishers wait for and cheer the last ones in. That is our custom.

Član 6 — Alkohol i supstance

Article 6 — Alcohol and substances

Neki naši događaji, poput novogodišnjeg obilaska lokala, uključuju alkohol. Pravila su jasna:

Some of our events, such as the New Year pub crawl, involve alcohol. The rules are clear:

  1. alkohol samo za punoljetne; organizatori i ugostitelji provjeravaju uzrast;
  2. niko se ne nagovara na piće; bezalkoholna opcija uvijek postoji i ravnopravna je;
  3. vidno alkoholisanoj osobi nećemo točiti dalje i možemo je zamoliti da napusti događaj;
  4. ne sjedaj za volan poslije pića; pomoći ćemo ti da nađeš prevoz;
  5. na sportskim događajima (trke, kupanja, regate) alkohol i druge supstance prije i tokom učešća nisu dozvoljeni; učesnik pod dejstvom se ne pušta na start;
  6. volonteri i tim ne piju alkohol dok imaju zadatak, a posebno dok rade sa djecom, na vodi ili sa novcem.
  1. alcohol only for adults; organisers and venues check age;
  2. nobody is talked into drinking; a non-alcoholic option always exists and is treated as equal;
  3. we will not serve any more to a visibly intoxicated person and we may ask them to leave the event;
  4. do not get behind the wheel after drinking; we will help you find a ride;
  5. at sporting events (races, swims, regattas) alcohol and other substances before and during participation are not allowed; a participant under the influence is not allowed to start;
  6. volunteers and staff do not drink alcohol while they have a task, and especially not while working with children, on the water or with money.

Droge na našim događajima nisu dozvoljene ni u kom obliku.

Drugs are not allowed at our events in any form.

Član 7 — Djeca

Article 7 — Children

Za sve što se tiče djece važi naša Politika zaštite djece: djeca su uvijek sa najmanje dvije odrasle osobe i u vidokrugu drugih; nema kontakta nasamo ni privatnih poruka; fotografisanje samo uz saglasnost roditelja; roditelj se zove za svaku ličnu potrebu djeteta; sumnja se prijavljuje odgovornoj osobi za zaštitu djece na događaju. Ova pravila važe i za roditelje i navijače prema tuđoj djeci.

For everything that concerns children our Child Safeguarding Policy applies: children are always with at least two adults and in view of others; there is no one-to-one contact and no private messaging; photographs only with a parent's consent; a parent is called for any personal need of the child; a concern is reported to the safeguarding lead at the event. These rules also apply to parents and supporters towards other people's children.

Član 8 — Bezbjednost

Article 8 — Safety

Prati uputstva organizatora, redara, spasilaca i medicinske službe, odmah i bez rasprave. Ne izlazi sa obilježene trase i ne ulazi u vodu van predviđenih zona i termina. Ne ulazi u vodu ako se ne osjećaš dobro. Ako vidiš nekoga u nevolji, javi najbližem članu tima; ako je u neposrednoj opasnosti, pozovi hitne službe pa nas. Ne donosi staklo, otvoreni plamen ni pirotehniku. Kostim mora biti bezbjedan za aktivnost.

Follow the instructions of organisers, marshals, lifeguards and medical staff, at once and without argument. Do not leave the marked course and do not enter the water outside the designated zones and times. Do not enter the water if you do not feel well. If you see someone in trouble, tell the nearest team member; if they are in immediate danger, call the emergency services, then us. Do not bring glass, open flame or pyrotechnics. A costume must be safe for the activity.

Član 9 — Naš grad, naši komšije, naše more

Article 9 — Our town, our neighbours, our sea

Ne ostavljamo ništa za sobom: otpad ide u predviđene kese i kante, plastika se ne baca ni na kopnu ni u vodu, a staza i plaža nakon događaja izgledaju bolje nego prije. Poštujemo stanovnike, saobraćaj i lokale kroz koje prolazimo: bez buke van programa, bez blokiranja ulaza, bez oštećenja. Prema životinjama i obali ponašamo se pažljivo. Ko dođe da navija, dobrodošao je uz ista pravila.

We leave nothing behind: waste goes in the bags and bins provided, plastic is not thrown away on land or in the water, and the course and the beach look better after the event than before. We respect the residents, the traffic and the venues we pass through: no noise outside the programme, no blocking of entrances, no damage. We treat animals and the shore with care. Anyone who comes to cheer is welcome under the same rules.

Član 10 — Dodatna pravila za volontere, tim i organe

Article 10 — Additional rules for volunteers, staff and officers

Ko nosi našu oznaku predstavlja udruženje. Volonteri, zaposleni, lica ogranaka, članovi organa i osnivači dodatno:

Whoever wears our badge represents the association. Volunteers, employees, chapter persons, officers and founders additionally:

  1. prolaze upoznavanje prije zadatka i rade samo zadatke za koje su upoznati;
  2. nose vidljivu oznaku dok su na zadatku i skidaju je kada završe;
  3. ne primaju novac, poklone ni pogodnosti od učesnika, korisnika, sponzora ni dobavljača mimo Pravila o sukobu interesa;
  4. rukuju novcem samo po pravilima o gotovini, uvijek u dvoje, sa potvrdom i evidencijom;
  5. ne otkrivaju podatke o donatorima, korisnicima pomoći, učesnicima i djeci koje saznaju na zadatku, ni tokom ni nakon angažmana;
  6. ne daju izjave za medije o politici, finansijama, korisnicima ni incidentima; to radi Izvršni direktor ili lice koje on ovlasti;
  7. ne koriste naziv, znak, naloge ni kontakte udruženja za lične svrhe;
  8. prijavljuju svaki sukob interesa, incident i povredu ovog kodeksa, uključujući svoju.
  1. receive a briefing before a task and do only the tasks they have been briefed for;
  2. wear visible identification while on a task and take it off when they finish;
  3. do not accept money, gifts or favours from participants, beneficiaries, sponsors or suppliers outside the Conflict of Interest Policy;
  4. handle money only under the cash rules, always in pairs, with a receipt and a record;
  5. do not disclose data about donors, beneficiaries, participants and children that they learn on a task, neither during nor after the engagement;
  6. do not give media statements on policy, finances, beneficiaries or incidents; that is done by the Executive Director or a person they authorise;
  7. do not use the association's name, mark, accounts or contacts for personal purposes;
  8. report every conflict of interest, incident and breach of this code, including their own.

Ko ima zadatak sa djecom potpisuje izjavu iz Politike zaštite djece.

Anyone with a task involving children signs the declaration from the Child Safeguarding Policy.

Član 11 — Partneri, sponzori i izvođači

Article 11 — Partners, sponsors and contractors

Klubovi, ugostitelji, sponzori, fotografi i drugi izvođači prihvataju ovaj kodeks kao dio saradnje sa nama. Sponzorstvo ne daje pravo na izuzetak ni na uticaj na to ko dobija sredstva. Lice partnera koje krši kodeks udaljavamo sa događaja kao i svakog drugog, a o ponovljenom kršenju obavještavamo partnera i preispitujemo saradnju.

Clubs, venues, sponsors, photographers and other contractors accept this code as part of their cooperation with us. Sponsorship gives no right to an exemption and no say over who receives funds. A partner's person who breaches the code is removed from the event like anyone else, and on a repeated breach we inform the partner and reconsider the cooperation.

Član 12 — Kako prijaviti problem

Article 12 — How to report a problem

Na događaju: obrati se bilo kom označenom članu tima, rukovodiocu događaja ili, ako se tiče djeteta, odgovornoj osobi za zaštitu djece; svi su vidljivo označeni. Pisanim putem: [[PLACEHOLDER: kontakt e-pošta]] ili obrazac na sajtu. Ako se prijava tiče Izvršnog direktora ili člana organa: predsjedniku Upravnog odbora na [[PLACEHOLDER: e-pošta]]. Ako je neko u neposrednoj opasnosti, prvo pozovi hitne službe (112), pa nas.

At an event: speak to any identified team member, the event manager or, if it concerns a child, the safeguarding lead; all are visibly identified. In writing: [[PLACEHOLDER: contact email]] or the form on the site. If the report concerns the Executive Director or an officer: to the President of the Board at [[PLACEHOLDER: email]]. If someone is in immediate danger, call the emergency services (112) first, then us.

Prijava može biti anonimna. Svaku prijavu tretiramo povjerljivo: identitet prijavioca ne otkrivamo osobi na koju se prijava odnosi. Niko ne trpi posljedice zbog savjesne prijave, i kada se pokaže neosnovanom; odmazda je sama po sebi povreda kodeksa.

A report may be anonymous. We treat every report confidentially: we do not reveal the reporter's identity to the person the report concerns. Nobody suffers consequences for a good-faith report, even when it proves unfounded; retaliation is in itself a breach of the code.

Član 13 — Šta se dešava nakon prijave

Article 13 — What happens after a report

Prijavu zabilježimo, odmah zaštitimo osobu koja je ugrožena (razdvajanje, pratnja, medicinska pomoć), saslušamo obje strane i odlučimo u roku iz Dijela B. O ishodu obavještavamo prijavioca u mjeri u kojoj to ne ugrožava povjerljivost drugih. Kada prijava upućuje na krivično djelo, obavještavamo policiju; kada se tiče djeteta, postupamo po Politici zaštite djece.

We record the report, protect the person at risk at once (separation, escort, medical help), hear both sides and decide within the deadline in Part B. We inform the reporter of the outcome to the extent that this does not endanger the confidentiality of others. When a report points to a criminal offence, we inform the police; when it concerns a child, we act under the Child Safeguarding Policy.

Član 15 — Preispitivanje

Article 15 — Review

Kodeks preispitujemo poslije svakog većeg događaja i najmanje jednom godišnje, uz Politiku zaštite djece, i dopunjujemo ga onim što smo naučili. Kratku verziju objavljujemo na sajtu i čitamo na brifingu prije svakog događaja.

We review the code after every major event and at least once a year, together with the Child Safeguarding Policy, and add what we have learned. We publish a short version on the site and read it at the briefing before every event.

DIO B: POSTUPANJE PO PRIJAVI (INTERNO)

PART B: INCIDENT PROCEDURE (INTERNAL)

Član 16 — Na događaju

Article 16 — At the event

  1. Član tima koji primi prijavu ili primijeti incident odmah obavještava rukovodioca događaja; ako se tiče djeteta, odgovornu osobu za zaštitu djece; ako se tiče povrede ili nesreće, medicinsku službu.
  2. Rukovodilac događaja prvo obezbjeđuje osobu koja je ugrožena, zatim razdvaja strane i, kada je potrebno, udaljava osobu na koju se prijava odnosi iz zone događaja uz pratnju dva člana tima. Udaljenje se saopštava mirno, bez rasprave pred drugima.
  3. Prijava se bilježi na obrascu za incidente iz Paketa za ogranak istog dana: ko, kada, gdje, šta se dogodilo, svjedoci, šta je preduzeto. Ne uzimaju se izjave od djece preko onoga što su sama rekla.
  4. Rukovodilac događaja obavještava Izvršnog direktora u roku od 24 sata o svakom udaljenju, povredi, incidentu sa djetetom, sukobu sa partnerom ili medijskom događaju.
  1. The team member who receives a report or notices an incident immediately informs the event manager; if it concerns a child, the safeguarding lead; if it concerns an injury or an accident, the medical staff.
  2. The event manager first secures the person at risk, then separates the parties and, where necessary, removes the person the report concerns from the event zone, escorted by two team members. The removal is communicated calmly, without argument in front of others.
  3. The report is recorded on the incident form from the Chapter Pack the same day: who, when, where, what happened, witnesses, what was done. No statements are taken from children beyond what they said themselves.
  4. The event manager informs the Executive Director within 24 hours of every removal, injury, incident involving a child, dispute with a partner or media event.

Član 17 — Nakon događaja i onlajn

Article 17 — After the event and online

Prijave van događaja i onlajn prijave prima Izvršni direktor ili lice koje on odredi; prijave koje se tiču Izvršnog direktora ili člana organa prima predsjednik Upravnog odbora. Primalac u roku od tri radna dana potvrđuje prijem, u roku od [[PLACEHOLDER: broj, npr. 15]] dana saslušava obje strane (odvojeno, uz mogućnost pratnje osobe od povjerenja) i odlučuje o mjeri. Mjere iz člana 14 koje se tiču volontera i naloga izriče Izvršni direktor; razrješenje, prestanak članstva i zabranu učešća izriče Upravni odbor na predlog Izvršnog direktora; o prigovoru odlučuje predsjednik Upravnog odbora, odnosno Upravni odbor bez lica koje je odlučivalo.

Reports outside events and online reports are received by the Executive Director or a person they designate; reports concerning the Executive Director or an officer are received by the President of the Board. The recipient acknowledges receipt within three working days, hears both sides within [[PLACEHOLDER: number, e.g. 15]] days (separately, with the option of being accompanied by a trusted person) and decides on the measure. The measures in Article 14 concerning volunteers and accounts are imposed by the Executive Director; dismissal, end of membership and a ban are imposed by the Board on the proposal of the Executive Director; an appeal is decided by the President of the Board, or by the Board without the person who took the decision.

Za povrede koje se tiču sukoba interesa primjenjuju se Pravila o sukobu interesa; za povrede koje se tiču djece Politika zaštite djece; za onlajn sadržaj postupak moderacije iz Uslova korišćenja.

For breaches concerning conflicts of interest the Conflict of Interest Policy applies; for breaches concerning children the Child Safeguarding Policy; for online content the moderation procedure in the Terms of Use.

Član 18 — Evidencija

Article 18 — Records

Izvršni direktor vodi evidenciju prijava i mjera (datum, vrsta, mjera, prigovor, ishod) odvojeno od drugih evidencija, sa pristupom za Izvršnog direktora, predsjednika Upravnog odbora i lice za zaštitu djece kada se tiče djeteta. Evidencija se čuva [[PLACEHOLDER: broj]] godina. Godišnji izvještaj Upravnom odboru sadrži broj prijava po vrsti i broj mjera, bez ličnih podataka. Zabrane učešća vode se na posebnoj listi koju rukovodilac događaja provjerava pri prijavama.
