7. Iznosi

7. Amounts

Standardna dodjela iznosi do [[PLACEHOLDER: iznos]] EUR po korisniku i odluci. Komisija je odobrava većinom glasova svih članova.

A standard allocation is up to [[PLACEHOLDER: amount]] EUR per beneficiary and per decision. The Committee approves it by a majority of the votes of all members.

Dodjela preko tog iznosa moguća je samo jednoglasnom odlukom svih članova Komisije, uz pisano obrazloženje zašto manji iznos ne bi ostvario svrhu.

An allocation above that amount is possible only by a unanimous decision of all members of the Committee, with written reasons why a smaller amount would not achieve the purpose.

Ukupan iznos dodjela u jednoj godini ne može preći sredstva stvarno prikupljena za korisnike u tekućoj i prethodnim godinama, umanjena za već dodijeljena sredstva. Komisija ne dodjeljuje sredstva na račun očekivanih budućih priloga.

The total amount allocated in one year cannot exceed the funds actually collected for beneficiaries in the current and previous years, less the funds already allocated. The Committee does not allocate funds against expected future contributions.

Komisija može odobriti manji iznos od traženog, ili dio troška uz uslov da ostatak pokrije drugi izvor.

The Committee may approve a smaller amount than requested, or a share of the cost on condition that the remainder is covered by another source.

8. Hitna pomoć

8. Urgent aid

Kada odlaganje do redovne sjednice nanosi nepovratnu štetu (hitno liječenje, gubitak doma, nesreća), predsjednik Komisije može pokrenuti skraćeni postupak: prijavu sa dokazima dostavlja elektronskim putem svim članovima, a odluka je donesena kada za nju glasa većina svih članova, najkasnije u roku od 48 sati.

Where delay until the regular meeting would cause irreversible harm (urgent treatment, loss of a home, an accident), the chair of the Committee may start a fast procedure: the application with its evidence is sent electronically to all members, and the decision is taken when a majority of all members vote for it, within 48 hours at the latest.

U skraćenom postupku može se odobriti najviše [[PLACEHOLDER: iznos]] EUR, u granici koju utvrdi Upravni odbor. U hitnom slučaju može se naknadno priznati i trošak plaćen najviše 30 dana prije prijave, uz račun.

In the fast procedure at most [[PLACEHOLDER: amount]] EUR may be approved, within the limit set by the Board. In an urgent case a cost paid at most 30 days before the application may also be recognised afterwards, against an invoice.

Svaka hitna odluka se na prvoj narednoj sjednici Komisije unosi u zapisnik i objavljuje kao i svaka druga.

Every urgent decision is entered in the minutes at the next meeting of the Committee and published like any other.

Izuzetno od odjeljka 3, korisnik koji je već primio sredstva može ponovo dobiti hitnu pomoć ako je nastupio novi, nepredvidivi događaj; Komisija to posebno obrazlaže.

By way of exception to section 3, a beneficiary who has already received funds may receive urgent aid again if a new, unforeseeable event has occurred; the Committee gives specific reasons for this.

9. Postupak i rokovi

9. Procedure and timelines

  1. Prijem. Izvršni direktor ili lice koje on odredi potvrđuje prijem u roku od tri radna dana i provjerava samo potpunost prijave, bez ocjene osnovanosti.
  2. Priprema. Kompletna prijava sa prilozima i kratkim sažetkom dostavlja se članovima Komisije najmanje pet dana prije sjednice. Sažetak ne sadrži preporuku.
  3. Provjera. Komisija može zatražiti dodatne dokaze, razgovor sa podnosiocem, ili da rukovodilac ogranka ili član udruženja obiđe korisnika. Nalaz obilaska se unosi u spis.
  4. Odluka. Komisija odlučuje u roku od 21 dan od dana kompletiranja prijave. Odluka sadrži: korisnika, iznos, namjenu, način isplate, uslove, bodove po kriterijumima i razloge.
  5. Obavještenje. Podnosilac se pisano obavještava u roku od pet dana od odluke. Odbijeni podnosilac dobija razloge i može jednom zatražiti ponovno razmatranje u roku od 15 dana, sa novim dokazima; Komisija odlučuje na prvoj narednoj sjednici i ta odluka je konačna.
  6. Sprovođenje. Izvršni direktor sprovodi odluku u roku od deset dana od ispunjenja uslova.
  1. Receipt. The Executive Director, or a person designated by the Director, acknowledges receipt within three working days and checks only whether the application is complete, without assessing its merits.
  2. Preparation. The complete application with its attachments and a short summary is sent to the members of the Committee at least five days before the meeting. The summary contains no recommendation.
  3. Verification. The Committee may request further evidence, an interview with the applicant, or a visit to the beneficiary by a chapter lead or a member of the association. The findings of the visit are entered in the file.
  4. Decision. The Committee decides within 21 days of the day the application is complete. The decision contains: the beneficiary, the amount, the purpose, the method of payment, the conditions, the points per criterion and the reasons.
  5. Notification. The applicant is notified in writing within five days of the decision. A declined applicant receives the reasons and may once request reconsideration within 15 days, with new evidence; the Committee decides at its next meeting and that decision is final.
  6. Implementation. The Executive Director implements the decision within ten days of the conditions being met.

10. Sukob interesa

10. Conflicts of interest

Član Komisije koji je sa korisnikom ili podnosiocem u srodstvu, poslovnom, radnom, susjedskom ili drugom ličnom odnosu, ili je sam predložio korisnika, prijavljuje to prije rasprave i ne učestvuje ni u raspravi ni u glasanju. Prijava i izuzeće se unose u zapisnik i u objavljeni sažetak odluke.

A member of the Committee who is related to the beneficiary or the applicant, or is in a business, employment, neighbourly or other personal relationship with them, or who proposed the beneficiary, declares this before the discussion and takes no part in the discussion or the vote. The declaration and the recusal are entered in the minutes and in the published summary of the decision.

Ako se zbog izuzeća ne može obezbijediti kvorum, odluku donose preostali članovi jednoglasno.

If a quorum cannot be reached because of recusals, the remaining members take the decision unanimously.

Član Komisije ne smije primiti nikakvu korist, poklon ili uslugu od korisnika, podnosioca ili dobavljača.

A member of the Committee may not accept any benefit, gift or favour from a beneficiary, applicant or supplier.

11. Isplata i dokumentacija

11. Payment and documentation

Sredstva se po pravilu plaćaju direktno dobavljaču (bolnici, apoteci, prodavcu, izvođaču, školi) na osnovu računa ili predračuna. Isplata korisniku na račun moguća je kada plaćanje dobavljaču nije moguće; isplata u gotovini samo izuzetno, do [[PLACEHOLDER: iznos]] EUR, uz potpisanu potvrdu o prijemu.

Funds are as a rule paid directly to the supplier (hospital, pharmacy, seller, contractor, school) against an invoice or pro forma invoice. Payment to the beneficiary's account is possible where payment to the supplier is not possible; payment in cash only exceptionally, up to [[PLACEHOLDER: amount]] EUR, against a signed receipt.

Za svaku dodjelu se u spisu čuvaju: odluka Komisije sa oznakom, prijava sa prilozima, račun ili predračun, dokaz o plaćanju, i potvrda korisnika da je trošak izvršen ili roba primljena, u roku od 30 dana od isplate.

For each allocation the file keeps: the Committee's decision with its reference, the application with its attachments, the invoice or pro forma invoice, proof of payment, and the beneficiary's confirmation that the cost has been met or the goods received, within 30 days of payment.

Neiskorišćena sredstva se vraćaju udruženju. Ako se sredstva iskoriste suprotno namjeni, Komisija može zatražiti povraćaj, a korisnik gubi pravo na nove prijave narednih [[PLACEHOLDER: broj]] mjeseci.

Unused funds are returned to the association. If funds are used contrary to their purpose, the Committee may request their return, and the beneficiary loses the right to make new applications for the following [[PLACEHOLDER: number]] months.

12. Objavljivanje i zaštita privatnosti

12. Publication and privacy

Za svaku dodjelu udruženje u javnom registru na svojoj internet stranici objavljuje: datum, iznos, kategoriju, ogranak i opis korisnika u obliku koji ne otkriva identitet (na primjer: „Porodica iz Tivta, troškovi liječenja, 1.200 EUR“), kao i oznaku odluke Komisije.

For each allocation the association publishes in the public ledger on its website: the date, the amount, the category, the chapter and a description of the beneficiary in a form that does not reveal their identity (for example: "Family from Tivat, medical costs, 1,200 EUR"), together with the reference of the Committee's decision.

Ne objavljuju se: ime i prezime, adresa, dijagnoza, fotografije ni bilo koji podatak koji omogućava prepoznavanje korisnika, osim uz izričitu, posebnu i opozivu pisanu saglasnost korisnika. Dijete se ne može prepoznati ni uz saglasnost roditelja, osim imenom i uzrastom u priči objavljenoj uz saglasnost oba roditelja ili staratelja.

The following are not published: name and surname, address, diagnosis, photographs or any data that would allow the beneficiary to be identified, except with the beneficiary's explicit, separate and revocable written consent. A child may not be made identifiable even with a parent's consent, other than by first name and age in a story published with the consent of both parents or the guardian.

Lični podaci iz prijava dostupni su samo članovima Komisije i licima koja pripremaju spis. Čuvaju se [[PLACEHOLDER: broj]] godina od posljednje isplate, zatim se brišu, osim podataka koje zakon nalaže duže čuvati.

Personal data from applications is accessible only to the members of the Committee and to the persons who prepare the file. It is kept for [[PLACEHOLDER: number]] years from the last payment and then deleted, except for data that the law requires to be kept longer.

13. Evidencija, izvještavanje i izmjene

13. Records, reporting and amendments

Komisija vodi registar odluka sa rednim brojem, datumom, iznosom, kategorijom i ishodom, koji se koristi kao oznaka odluke u javnom registru.

The Committee keeps a register of decisions with a serial number, date, amount, category and outcome, which is used as the decision reference in the public ledger.

Komisija podnosi Skupštini i Upravnom odboru godišnji izvještaj sa brojem primljenih, odobrenih i odbijenih prijava, ukupnim iznosima po kategoriji i ogranku, prosječnim rokom odlučivanja i brojem izuzeća zbog sukoba interesa.

The Committee submits to the Assembly and the Board an annual report with the number of applications received, approved and declined, the total amounts by category and chapter, the average time to decision and the number of recusals for conflict of interest.

Komisija najmanje jednom godišnje preispituje ove kriterijume i predlaže Upravnom odboru izmjene. Izmjene se objavljuju najmanje 15 dana prije primjene i ne primjenjuju se na prijave podnijete prije objavljivanja.

The Committee reviews these criteria at least once a year and proposes amendments to the Board. Amendments are published at least 15 days before they apply and do not apply to applications submitted before publication.

I. OPŠTE ODREDBE

I. GENERAL PROVISIONS

Član 1 — Predmet

Article 1 — Subject

Ovim pravilima bliže se uređuju osnivanje, organizacija, rad, finansije, izvještavanje i prestanak rada ogranaka udruženja, u skladu sa članovima 40 do 44 Statuta.

These rules govern in more detail the founding, organisation, operation, finances, reporting and dissolution of the association's chapters, in accordance with Articles 40 to 44 of the Statute.

Pravila su jedinstvena za sve ogranke. Upravni odbor može odlukom o osnivanju ogranka utvrditi samo one posebnosti koje ova pravila izričito dopuštaju.

The rules are the same for every chapter. In its decision founding a chapter the Board may set only those particulars that these rules expressly allow.

Član 2 — Položaj ogranka

Article 2 — Status of a chapter

Ogranak je unutrašnja organizaciona jedinica udruženja za područje jedne ili više opština. Ogranak nema svojstvo pravnog lica, nema sopstveni račun, pečat ni imovinu, i ne može zaključivati ugovore niti preuzimati obaveze.

A chapter is an internal organisational unit of the association for the area of one or more municipalities. A chapter is not a legal person, has no account, seal or property of its own, and cannot conclude contracts or assume obligations.

Sve što ogranak radi, radi u ime i za račun udruženja. Za obaveze koje nastanu radom ogranka odgovara udruženje, a lica koja su ih preuzela bez ovlašćenja odgovaraju udruženju.

Everything a chapter does, it does in the name and on behalf of the association. The association answers for obligations arising from a chapter's work, and persons who assumed them without authority answer to the association.

II. OSNIVANJE

II. FOUNDING

Član 3 — Predlog za osnivanje

Article 3 — Proposal to found a chapter

Predlog za osnivanje ogranka podnose Upravnom odboru najmanje tri člana udruženja sa prebivalištem na predloženom području. Predlog sadrži:

A proposal to found a chapter is submitted to the Board by at least three members of the association resident in the proposed area. The proposal states:

  1. područje ogranka (opština ili opštine);
  2. imena predloženog rukovodioca ogranka, blagajnika i koordinatora volontera, sa kratkim opisom iskustva;
  3. plan prvog javnog događaja u roku od dvanaest mjeseci, sa procjenom troškova i izvora sredstava;
  4. spisak klubova, škola, privrednih društava i drugih partnera sa kojima su predlagači već u kontaktu;
  5. izjavu predlagača da prihvataju Statut, ova pravila, kriterijume za dodjelu sredstava i Politiku zaštite djece.
  1. the chapter's area (the municipality or municipalities);
  2. the names of the proposed chapter lead, treasurer and volunteer coordinator, with a brief description of their experience;
  3. a plan for a first public event within twelve months, with an estimate of costs and sources of funds;
  4. a list of the clubs, schools, companies and other partners with whom the proposers are already in contact;
  5. a declaration by the proposers that they accept the Statute, these rules, the grant criteria and the Child Safeguarding Policy.

Upravni odbor odlučuje o predlogu na prvoj narednoj sjednici, po pribavljenom mišljenju Izvršnog direktora.

The Board decides on the proposal at its next meeting, after obtaining the Executive Director's opinion.

Član 4 — Odluka o osnivanju i Paket za ogranak

Article 4 — Founding decision and the Chapter in a Box

Odlukom o osnivanju Upravni odbor utvrđuje naziv ogranka (naziv udruženja i naziv opštine, na primjer „Santamore Kotor“), područje, imena lica iz člana 3 tačka 2, početni budžet i lice iz reda zaposlenih ili organa udruženja koje je stalni kontakt ogranka (nacionalni kontakt).

In the founding decision the Board sets the chapter's name (the association's name and the name of the municipality, for example "Santamore Kotor"), its area, the names of the persons under Article 3 point 2, its starting budget and the person from among the association's staff or bodies who is the chapter's standing contact (the national contact).

U roku od 30 dana od odluke Izvršni direktor ogranku dostavlja Paket za ogranak, koji sadrži najmanje:

Within 30 days of the decision the Executive Director delivers the Chapter in a Box to the chapter, containing at least:

  1. priručnik za organizaciju događaja sa obrascima (plan, budžet, procjena rizika, lista dozvola, program dana, izvještaj);
  2. vizuelni identitet: logotip, boje, šablone za objave, plakate i majice;
  3. obrasce za evidenciju gotovine, obračun troškova i prijavu incidenta;
  4. pristup platformi udruženja: stranicu ogranka, evidenciju prihoda i rashoda ogranka, alat za evidenciju gotovine i registar volontera;
  5. adresu elektronske pošte ogranka na domenu udruženja;
  6. potvrdu o osiguranju koje pokriva događaje ogranka i uslove pod kojima važi;
  7. ova pravila, kriterijume za dodjelu sredstava, Politiku zaštite djece i Uslove učešća na događajima.
  1. the event playbook with templates (plan, budget, risk assessment, permit checklist, run sheet, report);
  2. the visual identity: logo, colours, templates for posts, posters and T-shirts;
  3. forms for the cash log, expense reconciliation and incident reports;
  4. access to the association's platform: the chapter page, the chapter's income and expenditure ledger, the cash log tool and the volunteer register;
  5. a chapter email address on the association's domain;
  6. the confirmation of insurance covering the chapter's events and the conditions under which it applies;
  7. these rules, the grant criteria, the Child Safeguarding Policy and the Event Terms.

III. ORGANIZACIJA

III. ORGANISATION

Član 5 — Lica ogranka

Article 5 — Chapter officers

Ogranak ima rukovodioca ogranka, blagajnika ogranka i koordinatora volontera. Imenuje ih Upravni odbor na predlog članova ogranka, na mandat od dvije godine, uz mogućnost ponovnog imenovanja (član 41 Statuta).

A chapter has a chapter lead, a chapter treasurer and a volunteer coordinator. They are appointed by the Board on the proposal of the chapter's members for a term of two years, renewable (Article 41 of the Statute).

Ta lica moraju biti punoljetni članovi udruženja. Rukovodilac ogranka i blagajnik ne mogu biti isto lice, niti bračni drugovi ili bliski srodnici. Ista lica ne mogu istovremeno biti članovi Komisije za dodjelu sredstava.

These persons must be adult members of the association. The chapter lead and the treasurer cannot be the same person, nor spouses or close relatives. The same persons cannot at the same time be members of the Grants Committee.

Ako neko od tih mjesta ostane upražnjeno, rukovodilac ogranka u roku od 30 dana predlaže zamjenu, a do imenovanja poslove obavlja lice koje odredi Izvršni direktor.

If any of these posts falls vacant, the chapter lead proposes a replacement within 30 days, and until the appointment the duties are performed by a person designated by the Executive Director.

Član 6 — Rukovodilac ogranka

Article 6 — Chapter lead

Rukovodilac ogranka:

The chapter lead:

  1. organizuje rad ogranka i predstavlja ga prema partnerima i javnosti na svom području, u okviru ovlašćenja iz ovih pravila;
  2. priprema godišnji plan i budžet ogranka i predlaže ih Izvršnom direktoru;
  3. odgovara za to da se svaki događaj ogranka pripremi i održi u skladu sa dijelom IV ovih pravila;
  4. saziva i vodi sastanke članova ogranka;
  5. podnosi izvještaje iz dijela VII ovih pravila;
  6. prima prijave za pomoć sa svog područja i prosljeđuje ih u postupak iz kriterijuma za dodjelu sredstava, bez ocjene i bez obećanja podnosiocu;
  7. bez odlaganja obavještava Izvršnog direktora o svakom incidentu, prigovoru, medijskom upitu ili okolnosti koja može štetiti ugledu udruženja.
  1. organises the chapter's work and represents it towards partners and the public in its area, within the authority given by these rules;
  2. prepares the chapter's annual plan and budget and proposes them to the Executive Director;
  3. is responsible for every chapter event being prepared and held in accordance with Part IV of these rules;
  4. convenes and chairs the meetings of the chapter's members;
  5. submits the reports under Part VII of these rules;
  6. receives applications for aid from the chapter's area and forwards them into the procedure under the grant criteria, without assessing them and without promising anything to the applicant;
  7. informs the Executive Director without delay of every incident, complaint, media enquiry or circumstance that may harm the association's reputation.

Rukovodilac ogranka ne može zaključivati ugovore, zapošljavati, primati sponzorstva na lični račun ni davati javne izjave o politici udruženja bez pisanog ovlašćenja Izvršnog direktora.

The chapter lead cannot conclude contracts, hire staff, receive sponsorship into a personal account or make public statements on the association's policy without the Executive Director's written authorisation.

Član 7 — Blagajnik ogranka

Article 7 — Chapter treasurer

Blagajnik ogranka:

The chapter treasurer:

  1. vodi evidenciju svih prihoda i rashoda ogranka na platformi udruženja i čuva prateću dokumentaciju;
  2. odgovara za rukovanje gotovinom u skladu sa članom 13 ovih pravila;
  3. provjerava da svaki trošak ima odobrenje, račun na ime udruženja i pokriće u budžetu;
  4. priprema finansijski dio izvještaja ogranka i sarađuje sa računovođom udruženja;
  5. ne raspolaže sredstvima udruženja: nema pristup računu i ne vrši plaćanja, osim isplate gotovine iz odobrenih sitnih troškova do iznosa iz člana 14.
  1. keeps the record of all of the chapter's income and expenditure on the association's platform and keeps the supporting documents;
  2. is responsible for cash handling in accordance with Article 13 of these rules;
  3. checks that every expense has an approval, an invoice in the association's name and cover in the budget;
  4. prepares the financial part of the chapter's reports and works with the association's accountant;
  5. does not dispose of the association's funds: has no access to the account and makes no payments, other than paying cash from approved petty cash up to the amount in Article 14.

Član 8 — Koordinator volontera

Article 8 — Volunteer coordinator

Koordinator volontera vodi registar volontera ogranka, organizuje pozivanje, raspored i uputstva volontera za svaki događaj, obezbjeđuje da svaki volonter prije događaja prođe kratku obuku iz bezbjednosti i zaštite djece, i vodi evidenciju sati volontera za godišnji izvještaj.

The volunteer coordinator keeps the chapter's volunteer register, organises the recruiting, rostering and briefing of volunteers for every event, ensures that every volunteer receives a short safety and child safeguarding briefing before the event, and records volunteer hours for the annual report.

Član 9 — Članovi i sastanci ogranka

Article 9 — Chapter members and meetings

Članovi ogranka su članovi udruženja sa prebivalištem ili stalnim angažmanom na području ogranka, koji su u registru članova označeni kao članovi tog ogranka. Član može biti član samo jednog ogranka.

Chapter members are members of the association resident in or permanently engaged in the chapter's area who are marked in the register of members as members of that chapter. A member can be a member of only one chapter.

Ogranak održava sastanak članova najmanje jednom u tri mjeseca. O sastanku se vodi kratak zapisnik (datum, prisutni, odluke), koji se čuva na platformi. Sastanak prije godišnje sjednice Skupštine, na kome se razmatra dnevni red Skupštine, uslov je da rukovodilac ogranka može zastupati članove po punomoćju (član 17d Statuta).

A chapter holds a meeting of its members at least once every three months. Brief minutes of the meeting (date, those present, decisions) are kept on the platform. The meeting before the annual session of the Assembly, at which the Assembly's agenda is considered, is the condition for the chapter lead to be able to represent members by proxy (Article 17d of the Statute).

IV. DOGAĐAJI

IV. EVENTS

Član 10 — Godišnji plan

Article 10 — Annual plan

Rukovodilac ogranka do [[PLACEHOLDER: datum, npr. 31. oktobra]] dostavlja Izvršnom direktoru plan ogranka za narednu godinu: događaje sa okvirnim datumima, ciljni iznos prikupljanja, potrebe za volonterima, planirane partnere i sponzore i budžet po događaju.

By [[PLACEHOLDER: date, e.g. 31 October]] the chapter lead sends the Executive Director the chapter's plan for the following year: events with indicative dates, the fundraising target, volunteer needs, planned partners and sponsors, and a budget per event.

Izvršni direktor plan usaglašava sa nacionalnim kalendarom i budžetom i dostavlja ga Upravnom odboru uz predlog godišnjeg budžeta udruženja. Odobreni budžet ogranka je gornja granica troškova ogranka u toj godini.

The Executive Director reconciles the plan with the national calendar and budget and passes it to the Board together with the proposed annual budget of the association. The approved chapter budget is the ceiling on the chapter's costs in that year.

Svaki ogranak organizuje najmanje jedan javni događaj godišnje (član 41 Statuta).

Every chapter organises at least one public event a year (Article 41 of the Statute).

Član 11 — Odobravanje događaja

Article 11 — Event approval

Nijedan događaj se ne objavljuje ni ne održava bez pisanog odobrenja Izvršnog direktora.

No event is announced or held without the Executive Director's written approval.

Rukovodilac ogranka najavljuje događaj Izvršnom direktoru najmanje [[PLACEHOLDER: broj, npr. 60]] dana prije održavanja, a najmanje [[PLACEHOLDER: broj, npr. 30]] dana prije dostavlja kompletnu dokumentaciju: plan događaja, budžet sa izvorom sredstava za troškove prije prihoda, procjenu rizika, listu potrebnih dozvola i status svake, plan bezbjednosti i medicinske pomoći, ime lica zaduženog za zaštitu djece, plan volontera i plan komunikacije.

The chapter lead notifies the Executive Director of an event at least [[PLACEHOLDER: number, e.g. 60]] days before it is held, and at least [[PLACEHOLDER: number, e.g. 30]] days before delivers the complete file: the event plan, the budget with the source of funds for costs incurred before income, the risk assessment, the list of required permits and the status of each, the safety and medical plan, the name of the person responsible for child safeguarding, the volunteer plan and the communications plan.

Izvršni direktor odobrava događaj u roku od sedam dana od prijema kompletne dokumentacije, može ga odobriti uz uslove, ili ga odbija uz obrazloženje. Događaj koji predviđa učešće u vodi, učešće djece ili više od [[PLACEHOLDER: broj]] učesnika Izvršni direktor odobrava tek po pribavljenoj saglasnosti nacionalnog lica za bezbjednost, odnosno zaštitu djece.

The Executive Director approves the event within seven days of receiving the complete file, may approve it with conditions, or refuses it with reasons. An event that involves activity in the water, the participation of children or more than [[PLACEHOLDER: number]] participants is approved by the Executive Director only after obtaining the consent of the national safety lead or the national child safeguarding lead respectively.

Član 12 — Uslovi za održavanje događaja

Article 12 — Conditions for holding an event

Za svaki događaj ogranka obavezno je:

For every chapter event the following are mandatory:

  1. dozvola nadležnog organa opštine i, kada je potrebno, policije i upravljača puta ili obale, pribavljena prije objave prijava;
  2. osiguranje od odgovornosti koje pokriva događaj, u skladu sa potvrdom iz Paketa za ogranak;
  3. medicinska pomoć na licu mjesta srazmjerna broju učesnika i vrsti aktivnosti;
  4. prijava učesnika isključivo preko platforme udruženja, sa prihvatanjem Uslova učešća i Izjave o učešću; za maloljetne učesnike saglasnost roditelja ili staratelja;
  5. imenovano lice za zaštitu djece, vidljivo označeno i objavljeno na stranici događaja;
  6. ograničenje broja učesnika utvrđeno u planu i poštovano;
  7. za događaje u vodi: kvalifikovani spasioci, prateći čamac, bezbjednosni brifing svih učesnika i saradnja sa klubom koji takve aktivnosti obavlja profesionalno; bez toga se događaj u vodi ne održava;
  8. fotografisanje i snimanje samo uz objavljenu napomenu, a djeca prepoznatljiva samo uz saglasnost roditelja;
  9. izvještaj o događaju u roku iz člana 19.
  1. a permit from the competent municipal authority and, where required, from the police and the road or shore authority, obtained before registration opens;
  2. liability insurance covering the event, in accordance with the confirmation in the Chapter in a Box;
  3. on-site medical cover proportionate to the number of participants and the type of activity;
  4. registration of participants exclusively through the association's platform, with acceptance of the Event Terms and the Participation Waiver; for minor participants, the consent of a parent or guardian;
  5. a named child safeguarding lead, visibly identified and published on the event page;
  6. a participant limit set in the plan and enforced;
  7. for events in the water: qualified lifeguards, a safety boat, a safety briefing for all participants and cooperation with a club that carries out such activities professionally; without these, no event in the water is held;
  8. photography and filming only with a published notice, and children identifiable only with parental consent;
  9. an event report within the deadline in Article 19.

V. NOVAC I EVIDENCIJA

V. MONEY AND RECORDS

Član 13 — Osnovna pravila

Article 13 — Basic rules

Sva sredstva prikupljena radom ogranka su sredstva udruženja i uplaćuju se na račun udruženja. Ogranak, njegova lica i volonteri ne smiju držati sredstva udruženja na ličnim računima, u privatnim kasama ni u gotovini duže nego što ova pravila dopuštaju.

All funds raised through a chapter's work are funds of the association and are paid into the association's account. The chapter, its officers and volunteers may not hold the association's funds in personal accounts, in private tills or in cash for longer than these rules allow.

Prilozi se prikupljaju prvenstveno preko platforme udruženja (kartica, uplata sa referencom, stranice učesnika). Gotovina se prima samo kada drugi način nije moguć.

Contributions are collected primarily through the association's platform (card, transfer with a reference, fundraiser pages). Cash is accepted only when no other way is possible.

Za primljenu gotovinu izdaje se numerisana potvrda iz bloka udruženja. Gotovinu prebrojavaju dva lica, od kojih jedno mora biti blagajnik ili rukovodilac ogranka, i oba potpisuju obračun. Iznos se unosi u evidenciju gotovine na platformi u roku od 48 sati, a polaže na račun udruženja u roku od pet radnih dana, sa referencom koja povezuje uplatu sa evidencijom. Do potvrde prijema od strane udruženja, iznos se na platformi vodi kao „predat na čekanju“.

For cash received, a numbered receipt from the association's receipt book is issued. Cash is counted by two persons, one of whom must be the treasurer or the chapter lead, and both sign the count. The amount is entered in the cash log on the platform within 48 hours and deposited into the association's account within five working days, with a reference linking the deposit to the log. Until the association confirms receipt, the amount is shown on the platform as "handed in, pending".

Član 14 — Troškovi

Article 14 — Expenses

Ogranak može napraviti trošak samo u okviru odobrenog budžeta i odobrenog događaja. Trošak preko [[PLACEHOLDER: iznos]] EUR po stavci, ili ukupno preko budžeta stavke za više od 10 procenata, traži prethodno pisano odobrenje Izvršnog direktora.

A chapter may incur an expense only within the approved budget and for an approved event. An expense above [[PLACEHOLDER: amount]] EUR per item, or a total exceeding the budget line by more than 10 percent, requires the Executive Director's prior written approval.

Račun glasi na udruženje, sa PIB-om udruženja. Plaćanja vrši udruženje sa svog računa. Lice koje je uz odobrenje platilo trošak sopstvenim sredstvima podnosi zahtjev za refundaciju sa računom u roku od 30 dana; udruženje refundira u roku od 15 dana od urednog zahtjeva.

The invoice is issued to the association, with the association's PIB. Payments are made by the association from its account. A person who, with approval, paid an expense from their own funds submits a reimbursement claim with the invoice within 30 days; the association reimburses within 15 days of a complete claim.

Blagajnik može voditi sitne troškove u gotovini do [[PLACEHOLDER: iznos]] EUR ukupno, uz račun za svaku stavku i obračun na platformi u roku od sedam dana.

The treasurer may run petty cash in cash up to [[PLACEHOLDER: amount]] EUR in total, with a receipt for every item and a reconciliation on the platform within seven days.

Ogranak ne isplaćuje sredstva korisnicima. O svakoj dodjeli odlučuje Komisija za dodjelu sredstava, a isplatu vrši udruženje (kriterijumi za dodjelu sredstava, odjeljak 11).

A chapter does not pay funds to beneficiaries. Every grant is decided by the Grants Committee and paid by the association (grant criteria, section 11).

Član 15 — Sponzorstva i pokloni

Article 15 — Sponsorship and gifts

Sponzorstva, donacije privrednih društava i pokloni u naturi za događaje ogranka dogovaraju se u ime udruženja. Ugovor o sponzorstvu potpisuje Izvršni direktor; rukovodilac ogranka može voditi pregovore u okviru nacionalnih paketa i cjenovnika za sponzore.

Sponsorship, donations from companies and in-kind gifts for chapter events are agreed in the association's name. A sponsorship contract is signed by the Executive Director; the chapter lead may negotiate within the national sponsor packages and price list.

Svaki poklon u naturi (oprema, hrana, usluge, prostor) evidentira se na platformi sa procijenjenom vrijednošću i imenom davaoca. Sponzorske obaveze prema davaocu (logotip, pominjanje, mjesto na događaju) evidentiraju se i ispunjavaju kako je ugovoreno.

Every in-kind gift (equipment, food, services, premises) is recorded on the platform with an estimated value and the giver's name. Obligations owed to a sponsor (logo, mention, a place at the event) are recorded and fulfilled as agreed.

Lica ogranka ne mogu primati lične poklone, naknade ni pogodnosti od sponzora, dobavljača ili korisnika.

Chapter officers cannot accept personal gifts, fees or favours from sponsors, suppliers or beneficiaries.

Član 16 — Raspodjela sredstava prikupljenih na području ogranka

Article 16 — Split of funds raised in the chapter's area

Sredstva prikupljena na području ogranka raspoređuju se po objavljenoj formuli koju udruženje vodi za svaki ogranak na platformi: [[PLACEHOLDER: procenat, vodič tima predviđa 70]] procenata korisnicima sa područja ogranka, [[PLACEHOLDER: procenat, 20]] procenata nacionalnim operacijama i [[PLACEHOLDER: procenat, 10]] procenata Fondu solidarnosti za područja sa najvećom potrebom i najmanjim mogućnostima prikupljanja.

Funds raised in the chapter's area are distributed by the published formula that the association keeps for each chapter on the platform: [[PLACEHOLDER: percentage, the team guide proposes 70]] percent to beneficiaries in the chapter's area, [[PLACEHOLDER: percentage, 20]] percent to national operations and [[PLACEHOLDER: percentage, 10]] percent to the Solidarity Fund for areas with the greatest need and the smallest fundraising capacity.

Dobrovoljni prilozi i donacije prikupljeni za korisnike ne umanjuju se za troškove rada udruženja (Statut, član 34 stav 2).

Voluntary contributions and donations collected for beneficiaries are not reduced by the association's operating costs (Statute, Article 34 paragraph 2).

O dodjeli dijela namijenjenog korisnicima sa područja ogranka odlučuje Komisija za dodjelu sredstava po kriterijumima za dodjelu sredstava.

The allocation of the share intended for beneficiaries in the chapter's area is decided by the Grants Committee under the grant criteria.

Član 17 — Evidencija

Article 17 — Records

Ogranak vodi na platformi udruženja: evidenciju prihoda po događaju i izvoru; evidenciju rashoda sa dokumentima; evidenciju gotovine; registar volontera sa evidencijom obuke; zapisnike sastanaka; izvještaje o događajima; evidenciju dozvola, osiguranja i incidenata.

A chapter keeps on the association's platform: a record of income by event and source; a record of expenses with documents; the cash log; the volunteer register with briefing records; meeting minutes; event reports; a record of permits, insurance and incidents.

Dokumentacija u papirnom obliku (potvrde o gotovini, potpisani obračuni, dozvole) predaje se udruženju u roku od 30 dana od događaja. Ogranak ne vodi paralelne evidencije van platforme.

Paper documents (cash receipts, signed counts, permits) are handed to the association within 30 days of the event. A chapter keeps no parallel records outside the platform.

VI. NAZIV, ZNAK I JAVNI NASTUP

VI. NAME, MARK AND PUBLIC VOICE

Član 18 — Upotreba naziva i znaka

Article 18 — Use of the name and mark

Ogranak koristi naziv isključivo u obliku iz odluke o osnivanju („Santamore“ i naziv opštine) i logotip, boje i šablone iz Paketa za ogranak, bez izmjena. Naziv i znak koriste se samo za aktivnosti odobrene po ovim pravilima.

A chapter uses the name exclusively in the form set in the founding decision ("Santamore" and the name of the municipality) and the logo, colours and templates from the Chapter in a Box, without alteration. The name and mark are used only for activities approved under these rules.

Nalozi na društvenim mrežama, adrese e-pošte i internet stranice koje nose naziv ogranka pripadaju udruženju. Otvara ih udruženje, pristupne podatke čuva Izvršni direktor, a ogranku se dodjeljuje pristup za objavljivanje. Lice kome prestane funkcija gubi pristup istog dana.

Social media accounts, email addresses and web pages carrying the chapter's name belong to the association. The association opens them, the Executive Director holds the credentials, and the chapter is given posting access. A person whose function ends loses access the same day.

Rukovodilac ogranka može davati izjave za medije o događajima i radu ogranka. Izjave o politici udruženja, finansijama, korisnicima ili incidentima daje samo Izvršni direktor ili lice koje on ovlasti. Svaki medijski upit o tim temama prosljeđuje se Izvršnom direktoru istog dana.

The chapter lead may make statements to the media about the chapter's events and work. Statements on the association's policy, finances, beneficiaries or incidents are made only by the Executive Director or a person they authorise. Every media enquiry on those subjects is forwarded to the Executive Director the same day.

Logotipi sponzora prikazuju se u skladu sa nacionalnim paketima za sponzore. Ogranak ne može objaviti materijal koji sadrži političku poruku, vjersku poruku ili sadržaj suprotan ciljevima udruženja.

Sponsor logos are displayed in accordance with the national sponsor packages. A chapter cannot publish material containing a political message, a religious message or content contrary to the association's goals.

VII. IZVJEŠTAVANJE I SARADNJA

VII. REPORTING AND COOPERATION

Član 19 — Izvještaji

Article 19 — Reports

Rukovodilac ogranka podnosi Izvršnom direktoru, preko platforme:

The chapter lead submits to the Executive Director, through the platform:

  1. izvještaj o događaju u roku od 14 dana od održavanja: broj učesnika i volontera, prikupljena sredstva po izvoru, troškovi, sponzori i pokloni u naturi, incidenti i prigovori, fotografije sa evidencijom saglasnosti, naučene lekcije;
  2. tromjesečni izvještaj do 15. u mjesecu nakon tromjesečja: aktivnosti, prihodi i rashodi u odnosu na budžet, stanje gotovine i predaja, volonteri, partneri, planovi za naredno tromjesečje;
  3. godišnji izvještaj do [[PLACEHOLDER: datum, npr. 31. januara]]: sve iz tromjesečnih izvještaja za godinu, ocjena ispunjenja plana i predlozi za naredni plan.
  1. an event report within 14 days of the event: the number of participants and volunteers, funds raised by source, costs, sponsors and in-kind gifts, incidents and complaints, photographs with the consent records, lessons learned;
  2. a quarterly report by the 15th of the month following the quarter: activities, income and expenditure against budget, cash position and hand-ins, volunteers, partners, plans for the next quarter;
  3. an annual report by [[PLACEHOLDER: date, e.g. 31 January]]: everything from the quarterly reports for the year, an assessment of how far the plan was met and proposals for the next plan.

Ogranak ispunjava svoju obavezu iz Statuta (član 41) ako je u godini održao najmanje jedan odobreni javni događaj i podnio sve izvještaje iz ovog člana. Izvršni direktor to konstatuje u izvještaju Upravnom odboru za svaki ogranak posebno.

A chapter fulfils its obligation under the Statute (Article 41) if in the year it held at least one approved public event and submitted all the reports under this Article. The Executive Director records this for each chapter separately in the report to the Board.

Član 20 — Saradnja sa Izvršnim direktorom

Article 20 — Working with the Executive Director

Nacionalni kontakt iz člana 4 održava redovan mjesečni razgovor sa rukovodiocem ogranka i prvi je kome se ogranak obraća za pitanja, materijale i odobrenja.

The national contact under Article 4 holds a regular monthly call with the chapter lead and is the first person the chapter turns to for questions, materials and approvals.

Izvršni direktor rukovodi radom ogranaka (Statut, član 28): daje uputstva, usaglašava kalendare, odobrava događaje i troškove, i može ogranku naložiti da obustavi aktivnost koja nije u skladu sa Statutom, ovim pravilima, zakonom ili odobrenjem. Nalog o obustavi je obavezujući odmah, a ogranak može zatražiti da ga Upravni odbor preispita na prvoj narednoj sjednici.

The Executive Director directs the work of the chapters (Statute, Article 28): gives instructions, reconciles calendars, approves events and expenses, and may order a chapter to stop an activity that is not in accordance with the Statute, these rules, the law or an approval. A stop order is binding immediately, and the chapter may ask the Board to review it at its next meeting.

Ogranci međusobno sarađuju i razmjenjuju iskustva; Izvršni direktor najmanje jednom godišnje okuplja rukovodioce svih ogranaka.

Chapters cooperate with one another and share experience; the Executive Director gathers the leads of all chapters at least once a year.

Član 21 — Zaštita djece i incidenti

Article 21 — Child safeguarding and incidents

Na sve aktivnosti ogranka primjenjuje se Politika zaštite djece udruženja: nema kontakta odrasle osobe sa djetetom bez prisustva drugih, svi volonteri prolaze brifing, djeca se fotografišu samo uz saglasnost roditelja, a na svakom događaju je imenovano lice za zaštitu djece.

The association's Child Safeguarding Policy applies to all chapter activities: no contact between an adult and a child without others present, all volunteers receive a briefing, children are photographed only with parental consent, and a child safeguarding lead is named for every event.

Svaki incident (povreda, nesreća u vodi, prigovor u vezi sa djetetom, gubitak novca, sukob sa učesnikom ili partnerom, medijski događaj) prijavljuje se Izvršnom direktoru i, kada se tiče djeteta, nacionalnom licu za zaštitu djece odmah, a najkasnije u roku od 24 sata, na obrascu iz Paketa za ogranak. Nadležnim organima prijavljuje udruženje.

Every incident (injury, accident in the water, a concern about a child, loss of money, a dispute with a participant or partner, a media event) is reported to the Executive Director and, where it concerns a child, to the national child safeguarding lead, immediately and at the latest within 24 hours, on the form from the Chapter in a Box. Reports to the competent authorities are made by the association.

VIII. MJERE I PRESTANAK

VIII. MEASURES AND DISSOLUTION

Član 22 — Mjere

Article 22 — Measures

Ako ogranak ili neko od njegovih lica postupa suprotno Statutu, ovim pravilima ili odobrenju, Izvršni direktor može: izreći pisanu opomenu; obustaviti događaj ili aktivnost; privremeno, do 60 dana, oduzeti ovlašćenja licu ogranka i odrediti zamjenu. O privremenom oduzimanju ovlašćenja obavještava Upravni odbor, koji na prvoj narednoj sjednici odlučuje o razrješenju lica ili o vraćanju ovlašćenja.

If a chapter or any of its officers acts contrary to the Statute, these rules or an approval, the Executive Director may: issue a written warning; stop an event or activity; temporarily, for up to 60 days, withdraw a chapter officer's authority and designate a replacement. The Executive Director informs the Board of a temporary withdrawal of authority, and the Board at its next meeting decides on the officer's dismissal or on restoring their authority.

Lice ogranka ima pravo da se izjasni prije odluke Upravnog odbora.

The chapter officer has the right to be heard before the Board's decision.

Član 23 — Prestanak rada ogranka

Article 23 — Dissolution of a chapter

Upravni odbor ukida ogranak u slučajevima iz člana 44 Statuta. Prije odluke o ukidanju zbog neaktivnosti ili povrede pravila, Izvršni direktor pisano upozorava ogranak i ostavlja rok od najmanje 60 dana za otklanjanje razloga.

The Board dissolves a chapter in the cases under Article 44 of the Statute. Before a decision to dissolve for inactivity or breach of the rules, the Executive Director warns the chapter in writing and allows at least 60 days to remedy the grounds.

Po ukidanju, rukovodilac ogranka u roku od 15 dana predaje udruženju svu dokumentaciju, materijale, opremu i pristupne podatke. Sredstva evidentirana za ogranak ostaju namijenjena korisnicima sa njegovog područja, a o njima odlučuje Komisija za dodjelu sredstava.

On dissolution, the chapter lead hands over to the association all records, materials, equipment and credentials within 15 days. Funds recorded for the chapter remain earmarked for beneficiaries in its area, and the Grants Committee decides on them.

IX. PRELAZNE I ZAVRŠNE ODREDBE

IX. TRANSITIONAL AND FINAL PROVISIONS

Član 24

Article 24

Ogranak za područje opštine Tivat, sa Bokom Kotorskom kao početnim područjem djelovanja, prvi je ogranak udruženja i osniva se odlukom Upravnog odbora na prvoj sjednici po registraciji udruženja, bez predloga iz člana 3.

The chapter for the area of the municipality of Tivat, with the Bay of Kotor as its initial area of activity, is the association's first chapter and is founded by a decision of the Board at its first meeting after the association's registration, without a proposal under Article 3.

Ova pravila stupaju na snagu danom usvajanja na Upravnom odboru i objavljuju se članovima na platformi udruženja. Upravni odbor ih preispituje najmanje jednom godišnje, po izvještaju Izvršnog direktora o radu ogranaka.

These rules take effect on the day of their adoption by the Board and are published to members on the association's platform. The Board reviews them at least once a year, on the Executive Director's report on the work of the chapters.

I. OPŠTE ODREDBE

I. GENERAL PROVISIONS

Član 1 — Svrha

Article 1 — Purpose

Ova pravila uređuju kako udruženje prepoznaje, prijavljuje, bilježi i rješava sukob interesa, kako bi svaka odluka o novcu, ljudima i korisnicima bila donesena u interesu udruženja i mogla izdržati pitanje: „Kako znam da ovo ne ide vašim prijateljima?“

These rules set out how the association recognises, declares, records and resolves conflicts of interest, so that every decision about money, people and beneficiaries is taken in the interest of the association and can withstand the question: "How do I know this is not going to your friends?"

Pravila dopunjuju član 22 Statuta (isključenje prava glasa), član 39 Statuta (Komisija za dodjelu sredstava) i član 30 Zakona o nevladinim organizacijama (korišćenje imovine).

The rules supplement Article 22 of the Statute (exclusion from voting), Article 39 of the Statute (the Grants Committee) and Article 30 of the Law on Non-Governmental Organisations (use of assets).

Član 2 — Na koga se primjenjuju

Article 2 — Who is covered

Pravila se primjenjuju na: osnivače; članove Skupštine kada odlučuju; članove Upravnog odbora; članove Komisije za dodjelu sredstava; Izvršnog direktora; zaposlene; rukovodioce, blagajnike i koordinatore volontera ogranaka; volontere i spoljne saradnike kada u ime udruženja pregovaraju, nabavljaju, ocjenjuju prijave ili rukuju novcem (u daljem tekstu: obveznici).

The rules apply to: the founders; members of the Assembly when they decide; members of the Board; members of the Grants Committee; the Executive Director; employees; chapter leads, chapter treasurers and chapter volunteer coordinators; volunteers and external contractors when they negotiate, procure, assess applications or handle money on behalf of the association (together: covered persons).

Prihvatanje funkcije, zaposlenja ili angažmana podrazumijeva prihvatanje ovih pravila. Obveznici potpisuju izjavu iz člana 10 pri stupanju na funkciju.

Accepting a function, employment or engagement means accepting these rules. Covered persons sign the declaration under Article 10 on taking office.

Član 3 — Pojmovi

Article 3 — Definitions

Sukob interesa postoji kada lični interes obveznika ili sa njim povezanog lica utiče ili može uticati na to kako obveznik obavlja dužnost prema udruženju, ili kada bi razuman posmatrač tako zaključio. Sukob može biti:

A conflict of interest exists when a personal interest of a covered person, or of a person connected with them, influences or may influence how the covered person performs their duty to the association, or when a reasonable observer would conclude so. A conflict may be:

  1. stvarni: interes postoji u odluci koja se donosi;
  2. mogući: interes bi nastao ako se odluka donese na određeni način;
  3. prividni: interesa nema, ali okolnosti izgledaju tako da javnost može sumnjati.
  1. actual: the interest exists in the decision being taken;
  2. potential: the interest would arise if the decision were taken in a particular way;
  3. perceived: there is no interest, but the circumstances look such that the public may suspect one.

Sva tri se prijavljuju.

All three are declared.

Lični interes je svaka korist, novčana ili druga, uključujući zaposlenje, honorar, ugovor, sponzorstvo, poklon, uslugu, priznanje, prednost za pravno lice u kome obveznik ima udio ili funkciju, i korist za povezano lice.

A personal interest is any benefit, monetary or otherwise, including employment, a fee, a contract, sponsorship, a gift, a favour, recognition, an advantage for a legal entity in which the covered person holds a stake or an office, and a benefit for a connected person.

Povezano lice je: bračni i vanbračni drug; dijete, usvojenik i pastorak; roditelj, usvojilac i staratelj; brat i sestra; lice sa kojim obveznik živi u zajedničkom domaćinstvu; privredno društvo, preduzetnik ili organizacija u kojoj obveznik ili neko od navedenih lica ima udio od najmanje [[PLACEHOLDER: procenat, npr. 10]] procenata, funkciju u organu ili zaposlenje na rukovodećem mjestu; lice sa kojim obveznik ima tekući poslovni ili dužnički odnos.

A connected person is: a spouse or common-law partner; a child, adopted child or stepchild; a parent, adoptive parent or guardian; a brother or sister; a person with whom the covered person lives in the same household; a company, sole trader or organisation in which the covered person or any of the persons listed holds a stake of at least [[PLACEHOLDER: percentage, e.g. 10]] percent, an office in a governing body or a senior management job; a person with whom the covered person has a current business or debt relationship.

II. NAČELA

II. PRINCIPLES

Član 4 — Dužnosti obveznika

Article 4 — Duties of covered persons

Obveznik:

A covered person:

  1. odlučuje i djeluje isključivo u interesu udruženja i njegovih korisnika;
  2. ne koristi funkciju, informacije do kojih je došao u udruženju, imovinu, naziv ni kontakte udruženja za ličnu korist ili korist povezanog lica;
  3. prijavljuje svaki sukob interesa čim ga postane svjestan, a najkasnije prije rasprave o odluci na koju se odnosi;
  4. ne učestvuje u pripremi, raspravi ni odlučivanju o pitanju u kome je u sukobu interesa, osim ako ovim pravilima nije drugačije određeno;
  5. ne prima poklone, gostoprimstvo ni pogodnosti suprotno dijelu VI ovih pravila;
  6. odgovara istinito na pitanja organa o postojanju sukoba interesa.
  1. decides and acts solely in the interest of the association and its beneficiaries;
  2. does not use their function, information obtained in the association, or the association's assets, name or contacts for their own benefit or the benefit of a connected person;
  3. declares every conflict of interest as soon as they become aware of it, and at the latest before the discussion of the decision it concerns;
  4. takes no part in preparing, discussing or deciding a matter in which they have a conflict of interest, unless these rules provide otherwise;
  5. does not accept gifts, hospitality or favours contrary to Part VI of these rules;
  6. answers truthfully the questions of a body about the existence of a conflict of interest.

Kada obveznik nije siguran da li sukob postoji, prijavljuje ga. Prijava nikada nije na štetu obveznika; neprijavljivanje jeste.

When a covered person is unsure whether a conflict exists, they declare it. Declaring is never held against a covered person; failing to declare is.

III. TIPIČNE SITUACIJE

III. TYPICAL SITUATIONS

Član 5 — Dodjela sredstava korisnicima

Article 5 — Allocation of funds to beneficiaries

Član Komisije za dodjelu sredstava, Izvršni direktor, član Upravnog odbora i lice ogranka koje priprema spis ne učestvuju ni u čemu što se tiče prijave korisnika koji je povezano lice, susjed, kolega, klijent, poslodavac ili lice koje su sami predložili, niti prijave organizacije u kojoj imaju funkciju.

A member of the Grants Committee, the Executive Director, a member of the Board and a chapter officer preparing a file take no part in anything concerning the application of a beneficiary who is a connected person, neighbour, colleague, client, employer or a person they themselves proposed, or the application of an organisation in which they hold an office.

Član Komisije koji je sam predložio korisnika prijavljuje to i izuzima se, a Komisija u obrazloženju navodi ko je korisnika predložio.

A member of the Committee who themselves proposed a beneficiary declares it and recuses themselves, and the Committee states in its reasons who proposed the beneficiary.

Obveznik, njegovo povezano lice i privredno društvo u kome ima udio ne mogu biti korisnici sredstava udruženja (kriterijumi za dodjelu sredstava, odjeljak 3), osim članova udruženja koji nemaju funkciju, uz prijavu i izuzeće svakog lica koje ih poznaje.

A covered person, their connected person and a company in which they hold a stake cannot be beneficiaries of the association's funds (grant criteria, section 3), except for members of the association who hold no function, subject to declaration and recusal of every person who knows them.

Učesnik koji na platformi udruženja prikuplja sredstva za kampanju čiji je korisnik njegovo povezano lice mora to navesti na svojoj stranici; Komisija to uzima u obzir pri dodjeli, a sredstva se i tada dodjeljuju samo po kriterijumima.

A participant who raises funds on the association's platform for a cause whose beneficiary is their connected person must state this on their fundraiser page; the Committee takes it into account when allocating, and even then funds are allocated only according to the criteria.

Član 6 — Nabavke, dobavljači i ugovori sa povezanim licima

Article 6 — Procurement, suppliers and contracts with connected persons

Udruženje ne zaključuje ugovor o nabavci robe, usluga ili zakupa sa obveznikom ni sa njegovim povezanim licem, osim kada su ispunjeni svi uslovi:

The association does not conclude a contract for the procurement of goods, services or a lease with a covered person or with their connected person, unless all of the following conditions are met:

  1. sukob je prijavljen unaprijed i unesen u registar;
  2. za nabavku preko [[PLACEHOLDER: iznos]] EUR pribavljene su najmanje dvije uporedive ponude drugih ponuđača, a uslovi povezanog lica nisu nepovoljniji od tržišnih;
  3. ugovor je odobrio Upravni odbor većinom nezavisnih članova, bez učešća obveznika, uz pisano obrazloženje zašto je izbor u interesu udruženja;
  4. ugovor je naveden u godišnjem izvještaju o radu sa nazivom druge strane, predmetom i iznosom.
  1. the conflict has been declared in advance and entered in the register;
  2. for a procurement above [[PLACEHOLDER: amount]] EUR, at least two comparable quotes from other bidders have been obtained, and the connected person's terms are no less favourable than market terms;
  3. the contract has been approved by the Board by a majority of its independent members, without the participation of the covered person, with written reasons why the choice is in the interest of the association;
  4. the contract is listed in the annual activity report with the name of the other party, the subject and the amount.

Poklon u naturi ili usluga bez naknade od povezanog lica dozvoljeni su i poželjni, uz prijavu i evidenciju vrijednosti.

An in-kind gift or a free service from a connected person is permitted and welcome, subject to declaration and a record of its value.

Obveznik ne učestvuje u izboru dobavljača u kome ima interes, ne prima od dobavljača proviziju ni pogodnost, i ne otkriva ponuđačima podatke iz tuđih ponuda.

A covered person takes no part in the selection of a supplier in which they have an interest, accepts no commission or favour from a supplier, and does not disclose to bidders the details of other bidders' offers.

Član 7 — Sponzori i partneri

Article 7 — Sponsors and partners

Obveznik koji je zaposlen, vlasnik, član organa ili stalni saradnik sponzora, partnera ili kandidata za sponzora prijavljuje to i ne učestvuje u odlučivanju o uslovima sponzorstva, protivuslugama ni o odabiru tog sponzora; može posredovati u kontaktu.

A covered person who is an employee, owner, member of a governing body or regular contractor of a sponsor, partner or prospective sponsor declares this and takes no part in deciding the terms of the sponsorship, the deliverables or the selection of that sponsor; they may make the introduction.

Sponzorstvo ne daje sponzoru ni njegovim ljudima uticaj na to ko će dobiti sredstva. Svaki pokušaj takvog uticaja prijavljuje se Upravnom odboru.

Sponsorship gives neither the sponsor nor its people any influence over who receives funds. Any attempt at such influence is reported to the Board.

Član 8 — Zapošljavanje, naknade i angažovanje

Article 8 — Employment, remuneration and engagement

Na zapošljavanje, honorare i naknade primjenjuje se dio V ovih pravila.

Part V of these rules applies to employment, fees and remuneration.

Obveznik ne učestvuje u odluci o zapošljavanju, angažovanju, unapređenju, naknadi, ocjeni ili prestanku rada svog povezanog lica, ni o svojoj sopstvenoj.

A covered person takes no part in a decision on the employment, engagement, promotion, remuneration, appraisal or termination of their connected person, or of themselves.

Povezano lice obveznika ne može biti zaposleno ni angažovano uz naknadu u udruženju u periodu od [[PLACEHOLDER: broj]] godina od registracije udruženja, bez izuzetka. Nakon tog perioda, samo po javnom pozivu, odlukom Upravnog odbora većinom nezavisnih članova bez učešća obveznika, uz objavu u godišnjem izvještaju.

A connected person of a covered person cannot be employed or engaged for remuneration by the association for a period of [[PLACEHOLDER: number]] years from the registration of the association, without exception. After that period, only through an open call, by a decision of the Board by a majority of its independent members without the participation of the covered person, and with publication in the annual report.

Volonterski rad povezanih lica je dozvoljen i poželjan.

Volunteer work by connected persons is permitted and welcome.

Član 9 — Spoljne funkcije, informacije i imovina

Article 9 — Outside roles, information and assets

Obveznik prijavljuje funkcije u organima drugih nevladinih organizacija, privrednih društava i političkih partija, i javne funkcije, koje mogu doći u dodir sa radom udruženja.

A covered person declares offices in the governing bodies of other non-governmental organisations, companies and political parties, and public offices, that may come into contact with the work of the association.

Član Upravnog odbora i Komisije za dodjelu sredstava ne može u isto vrijeme biti nosilac funkcije u političkoj partiji ni kandidat na izborima; za vrijeme kandidature mandat miruje.

A member of the Board or of the Grants Committee cannot at the same time hold an office in a political party or be a candidate in an election; the mandate is suspended for the duration of the candidacy.

Obveznik ne koristi podatke o donatorima, korisnicima, sponzorima, volonterima i učesnicima ni za koju svrhu van udruženja, ni za vrijeme funkcije ni nakon nje. Imovina, oprema, nalozi i naziv udruženja koriste se samo za rad udruženja.

A covered person does not use data on donors, beneficiaries, sponsors, volunteers and participants for any purpose outside the association, either during the function or after it. The assets, equipment, accounts and name of the association are used only for the work of the association.

IV. POSTUPAK

IV. PROCEDURE

Član 10 — Godišnja izjava i registar interesa

Article 10 — Annual declaration and register of interests

Svaki član Upravnog odbora, Komisije za dodjelu sredstava, Izvršni direktor, zaposleni i lica ogranaka potpisuju izjavu o interesima pri stupanju na funkciju i zatim svake godine do [[PLACEHOLDER: datum, npr. 31. januara]], a dopunjuju je u roku od 30 dana od svake promjene.

Every member of the Board, every member of the Grants Committee, the Executive Director, employees and chapter officers sign a declaration of interests on taking office and then every year by [[PLACEHOLDER: date, e.g. 31 January]], and update it within 30 days of any change.

Izjava sadrži: zaposlenje i poslovne aktivnosti obveznika; udjele i funkcije u pravnim licima; funkcije u drugim organizacijama i političke funkcije; povezana lica koja su zaposlena, sponzori, dobavljači, korisnici ili podnosioci prijava udruženja, koliko je obvezniku poznato; primljene poklone iznad praga iz člana 15; potvrdu da je obveznik pročitao ova pravila.

The declaration contains: the covered person's employment and business activities; stakes and offices in legal entities; offices in other organisations and political offices; connected persons who are employees, sponsors, suppliers, beneficiaries or applicants of the association, as far as known to the covered person; gifts received above the threshold in Article 15; confirmation that the covered person has read these rules.

Izjave čine registar interesa, koji vodi Izvršni direktor; izjave Izvršnog direktora čuva predsjednik Upravnog odbora. Registar je dostupan članovima Upravnog odbora i Komisije, računovođi i revizoru, a svakom članu udruženja na zahtjev u dijelu koji se odnosi na članove organa. Sažetak (broj izjava, broj prijavljenih sukoba i izuzeća, ugovori sa povezanim licima) objavljuje se u godišnjem izvještaju.

The declarations form the register of interests, which is kept by the Executive Director; the Executive Director's declarations are kept by the President of the Board. The register is available to the members of the Board and of the Committee, to the accountant and to the auditor, and to any member of the association on request in the part concerning members of governing bodies. A summary (number of declarations, number of conflicts declared and recusals, contracts with connected persons) is published in the annual report.

Lični podaci iz registra obrađuju se samo u svrhu ovih pravila i čuvaju [[PLACEHOLDER: broj]] godina od prestanka funkcije.

Personal data in the register is processed only for the purposes of these rules and kept for [[PLACEHOLDER: number]] years after the function ends.

Član 11 — Prijava u konkretnom slučaju

Article 11 — Declaration in a specific case

Obveznik prijavljuje sukob interesa predsjedavajućem organa, odnosno Izvršnom direktoru, čim primi materijal ili sazna za pitanje, a najkasnije na početku rasprave. Prijava se unosi u zapisnik sa opisom interesa.

A covered person declares a conflict of interest to the chair of the body, or to the Executive Director, as soon as they receive the papers or learn of the matter, and at the latest at the start of the discussion. The declaration is minuted with a description of the interest.

Ako drugi član organa smatra da obveznik ima sukob koji nije prijavio, iznosi to prije rasprave; o tome odlučuje organ bez tog obveznika.

If another member of the body believes that a covered person has a conflict they have not declared, they raise it before the discussion; the body decides on it without that covered person.

Član 12 — Izuzeće

Article 12 — Recusal

Obveznik u sukobu interesa: ne dobija materijal o tom pitanju, osim ako je nužan za prijavu; napušta prostoriju ili vezu za vrijeme rasprave i glasanja; ne glasa; ne razgovara o pitanju sa članovima organa van sjednice; ne učestvuje u sprovođenju odluke ako to nosi novi uticaj.

A covered person with a conflict of interest: receives no papers on that matter, except where necessary for the declaration; leaves the room or the call for the duration of the discussion and vote; does not vote; does not discuss the matter with members of the body outside the meeting; does not take part in implementing the decision where that carries new influence.

Zapisnik bilježi prijavu, izuzeće, vrijeme napuštanja i vraćanja i da je odluka donesena bez izuzetog lica. Izuzeti se ne računa u kvorum za to pitanje. Ako izuzeća naruše kvorum, primjenjuje se član 39 Statuta, odnosno kriterijumi za dodjelu sredstava, odjeljak 10.

The minutes record the declaration, the recusal, the times of leaving and returning, and that the decision was taken without the recused person. The recused person does not count towards the quorum on that item. If recusals break the quorum, Article 39 of the Statute or, as the case may be, section 10 of the grant criteria applies.

Izuzetno, organ može jednoglasno odlučiti da obveznik ostane prisutan samo da bi dao činjenične informacije, nakon čega napušta sjednicu.

Exceptionally, the body may decide unanimously that the covered person remains present only to give factual information, after which they leave the meeting.

Član 13 — Ko odlučuje o postojanju sukoba

Article 13 — Who decides whether a conflict exists

O tome da li sukob postoji i o mjerama odlučuje:

Whether a conflict exists, and the measures to take, are decided:

  1. za člana Skupštine: Predsjednik Skupštine;
  2. za člana Upravnog odbora: Upravni odbor bez tog člana;
  3. za člana Komisije za dodjelu sredstava: Komisija bez tog člana; ako je sporno, Upravni odbor;
  4. za Izvršnog direktora: predsjednik Upravnog odbora, a u slučaju spora Upravni odbor;
  5. za zaposlene, lica ogranaka, volontere i saradnike: Izvršni direktor, a za lica ogranaka po pribavljenom mišljenju rukovodioca ogranka.
  1. for a member of the Assembly: by the President of the Assembly;
  2. for a member of the Board: by the Board without that member;
  3. for a member of the Grants Committee: by the Committee without that member; if disputed, by the Board;
  4. for the Executive Director: by the President of the Board, and in case of dispute by the Board;
  5. for employees, chapter officers, volunteers and contractors: by the Executive Director, and for chapter officers after obtaining the opinion of the chapter lead.

Odluka se unosi u zapisnik ili registar. Obveznik može tražiti da Upravni odbor preispita odluku iz tačaka 1, 3 i 5; odluka Upravnog odbora je konačna.

The decision is minuted or entered in the register. The covered person may ask the Board to review a decision under points 1, 3 and 5; the Board's decision is final.

Član 14 — Sukob interesa nakon odluke

Article 14 — Conflict of interest discovered after a decision

Ako se nakon odluke utvrdi da je u njenom donošenju učestvovalo lice u neprijavljenom sukobu interesa, organ koji je odluku donio ponovo o njoj odlučuje bez tog lica u roku od 30 dana. Ako je odluka već sprovedena, organ utvrđuje da li je udruženju nastala šteta i primjenjuje član 19.

If it is established after a decision that a person with an undeclared conflict of interest took part in taking it, the body that took the decision decides on it again without that person within 30 days. If the decision has already been implemented, the body establishes whether the association has suffered a loss and applies Article 19.

V. ZARADE, NAKNADE I IMOVINA

V. PAY, REMUNERATION AND ASSETS

Član 15 — Načelo

Article 15 — Principle

Imovina udruženja koristi se samo za ostvarivanje njegovih ciljeva, naknadu opravdanih troškova, zarade i naknade zaposlenih po osnovu stvarno obavljenog rada i druge namjene dopuštene članom 30 Zakona o nevladinim organizacijama. Imovina se ne može raspodijeliti osnivačima, članovima, članovima organa ni zaposlenima.

The assets of the association are used only for achieving its goals, reimbursing justified costs, paying salaries and remuneration to employees for work actually done, and other purposes permitted by Article 30 of the Law on Non-Governmental Organisations. The assets cannot be distributed to the founders, members, members of governing bodies or employees.

Isplata zarade za obavljeni rad nije raspodjela imovine. Razlika mora biti očigledna i dokumentovana. Zato:

Paying a salary for work done is not a distribution of assets. The difference must be obvious and documented. Therefore:

  1. Ugovor, ne transfer. Svako lice koje prima naknadu ima pisani ugovor, opis posla, evidenciju radnog vremena ili isporučenog rada i isplatu preko obračuna zarada sa plaćenim porezima i doprinosima. Bez izuzetka, ni za osnivače.
  2. Onaj ko plaća nije onaj ko prima. O zaradi, naknadi i njihovim promjenama odlučuju samo nezavisni članovi Upravnog odbora (Statut, član 34 stav 3). Lice koje prima naknadu ne učestvuje u odluci o svojoj ni o tuđoj naknadi ako je u istom lancu odlučivanja.
  3. Objavljeni rasponi. Rasponi zarada po radnom mjestu objavljuju se u godišnjem izvještaju, a uporedni podaci na osnovu kojih su utvrđeni unose se u zapisnik Upravnog odbora.
  4. Bez srodnika na platnom spisku u periodu iz člana 8.
  5. Pisano mišljenje prije prve isplate. Prije prve isplate zarade ili honorara bilo kom obvezniku, Upravni odbor pribavlja pisano mišljenje računovođe ili pravnika u Crnoj Gori o usklađenosti sa Zakonom o nevladinim organizacijama i poreskim propisima, i čuva ga u registru.
  6. Bez nagrada iz priloga. Zarade, naknade i nagrade ne isplaćuju se iz priloga i donacija prikupljenih za korisnike (Statut, član 34 stav 2).
  1. A contract, not a transfer. Every person who receives remuneration has a written contract, a job description, records of working time or of work delivered, and payment through payroll with taxes and contributions paid. Without exception, not even for the founders.
  2. The payer is never the payee. Only the independent members of the Board decide on salaries, remuneration and changes to them (Statute, Article 34 paragraph 3). A person who receives remuneration takes no part in the decision on their own remuneration, nor on another's if they are in the same chain of decision.
  3. Published bands. Pay bands per position are published in the annual report, and the benchmark data on which they were set is entered in the minutes of the Board.
  4. No relatives on the payroll for the period under Article 8.
  5. A written opinion before the first payment. Before the first payment of a salary or fee to any covered person, the Board obtains a written opinion from an accountant or lawyer in Montenegro on compliance with the Law on Non-Governmental Organisations and tax regulations, and keeps it in the register.
  6. No awards out of contributions. Salaries, remuneration and awards are not paid out of contributions and donations collected for beneficiaries (Statute, Article 34 paragraph 2).

Naknada opravdanih troškova (putni troškovi, materijal, oprema kupljena za udruženje) isplaćuje se uz račun i odobrenje, po pravilima o troškovima, i nije naknada za rad.

Reimbursement of justified costs (travel costs, materials, equipment bought for the association) is paid against a receipt and with approval, under the expenses rules, and is not remuneration for work.

VI. POKLONI I GOSTOPRIMSTVO

VI. GIFTS AND HOSPITALITY

Član 16 — Pokloni

Article 16 — Gifts

Obveznik ne prima novac, vaučere ni ekvivalent novca ni od koga u vezi sa radom udruženja, u bilo kom iznosu.

A covered person does not accept cash, vouchers or cash equivalents from anyone in connection with the work of the association, in any amount.

Obveznik može primiti poklon simbolične vrijednosti do [[PLACEHOLDER: iznos, npr. 30]] EUR (promotivni predmeti, hrana i piće na događaju, zahvalnica). Poklon veće vrijednosti odbija se ili, ako odbijanje nije moguće bez uvrede, predaje udruženju i evidentira u registru poklona sa datumom, davaocem, opisom i procijenjenom vrijednošću; o njegovoj upotrebi odlučuje Izvršni direktor.

A covered person may accept a gift of token value up to [[PLACEHOLDER: amount, e.g. 30]] EUR (promotional items, food and drink at an event, a letter of thanks). A gift of higher value is declined or, where declining is not possible without offence, handed over to the association and entered in the gifts register with the date, the giver, a description and an estimated value; the Executive Director decides on its use.

Poklon od korisnika, podnosioca prijave ili dobavljača u toku postupka odbija se bez obzira na vrijednost.

A gift from a beneficiary, an applicant or a supplier during a procedure is declined regardless of its value.

Više poklona od istog davaoca u godini sabira se.

Several gifts from the same giver in a year are added together.

Član 17 — Gostoprimstvo i putovanja

Article 17 — Hospitality and travel

Gostoprimstvo sponzora ili partnera (ručak, ulaznica, smještaj) prihvata se samo ako je vezano za posao udruženja, srazmjerno prilici i evidentirano u registru poklona kada prelazi [[PLACEHOLDER: iznos]] EUR po prilici. Putovanja i smještaj koje plaća treće lice odobrava unaprijed Izvršni direktor, a za Izvršnog direktora predsjednik Upravnog odbora.

Hospitality from a sponsor or partner (a lunch, a ticket, accommodation) is accepted only if it is tied to the association's business, proportionate to the occasion and entered in the gifts register when it exceeds [[PLACEHOLDER: amount]] EUR per occasion. Travel and accommodation paid by a third party are approved in advance by the Executive Director, and for the Executive Director by the President of the Board.

VII. PRIJAVLJIVANJE POVREDA I MJERE

VII. REPORTING BREACHES AND MEASURES

Član 18 — Prijavljivanje

Article 18 — Reporting

Svako, uključujući članove, volontere, donatore i korisnike, može prijaviti sumnju na povredu ovih pravila predsjedniku Upravnog odbora ili, ako se prijava tiče njega, predsjedniku Komisije za dodjelu sredstava, na adresu objavljenu na internet stranici udruženja. Prijava može biti anonimna.

Anyone, including members, volunteers, donors and beneficiaries, may report a suspected breach of these rules to the President of the Board or, if the report concerns the President, to the chair of the Grants Committee, at the address published on the association's website. A report may be anonymous.

Lice koje u dobroj vjeri prijavi sumnju ne smije zbog toga trpjeti nikakve posljedice; svaka mjera protiv njega zbog prijave je sama povreda ovih pravila.

A person who reports a suspicion in good faith must not suffer any consequences for doing so; any measure against them because of the report is itself a breach of these rules.

Primalac prijave u roku od 15 dana provjerava navode, pribavlja izjavu lica na koje se prijava odnosi i podnosi nalaz Upravnom odboru, koji odlučuje bez članova na koje se prijava odnosi.

The recipient of the report checks the allegations within 15 days, obtains a statement from the person the report concerns and submits findings to the Board, which decides without the members the report concerns.

Član 19 — Mjere

Article 19 — Measures

Za povredu ovih pravila, srazmjerno težini, mogu se izreći: pisana opomena; ponovno odlučivanje bez tog lica (član 14); poništenje ili raskid ugovora zaključenog u sukobu interesa, kada je to moguće; zahtjev za povraćaj koristi ili naknadu štete; razrješenje sa funkcije po Statutu; prestanak radnog odnosa ili angažmana po ugovoru i zakonu; prestanak članstva (Statut, član 37).

For a breach of these rules, in proportion to its seriousness, the following may be imposed: a written warning; a new decision without that person (Article 14); annulment or termination of a contract concluded under a conflict of interest, where possible; a claim for the return of the benefit or for damages; dismissal from the function under the Statute; termination of employment or engagement under the contract and the law; termination of membership (Statute, Article 37).

Namjerno prikrivanje sukoba interesa u vezi sa dodjelom sredstava korisnicima ili sa ugovorom povlači razrješenje.

Deliberately concealing a conflict of interest in connection with an allocation of funds to beneficiaries or with a contract leads to dismissal.

VIII. OBJAVLJIVANJE I ZAVRŠNE ODREDBE

VIII. PUBLICATION AND FINAL PROVISIONS

Član 20 — Objavljivanje

Article 20 — Publication

Udruženje objavljuje ova pravila na svojoj internet stranici. Godišnji izvještaj o radu sadrži: broj primljenih izjava o interesima; broj prijavljenih sukoba i izuzeća po organu; svaki ugovor sa povezanim licem (druga strana, predmet, iznos); raspone zarada; sažetak registra poklona; broj prijava povreda i ishod.

The association publishes these rules on its website. The annual activity report contains: the number of declarations of interests received; the number of conflicts declared and recusals per body; every contract with a connected person (other party, subject, amount); pay bands; a summary of the gifts register; the number of reports of breaches and their outcome.

Član 21 — Obuka i preispitivanje

Article 21 — Training and review

Svaki obveznik prolazi kratko upoznavanje sa ovim pravilima pri stupanju na funkciju, a članovi organa jednom godišnje. Upravni odbor preispituje pravila najmanje jednom godišnje i po svakom slučaju iz člana 18.

Every covered person receives a short induction to these rules on taking office, and members of governing bodies once a year. The Board reviews the rules at least once a year and after every case under Article 18.

Pravila stupaju na snagu danom usvajanja na Upravnom odboru. Do izbora Upravnog odbora, ovlašćenja Upravnog odbora iz ovih pravila vrši Skupština, a ovlašćenja predsjednika Upravnog odbora Predsjednik Skupštine.

The rules enter into force on the day of their adoption by the Board. Until the Board is elected, the powers of the Board under these rules are exercised by the Assembly, and the powers of the President of the Board by the President of the Assembly.
