DIO A: KRATKA IZJAVA VOLONTERA NA DOGAĐAJU

PART A: EVENT-DAY VOLUNTEER FORM

Prikazuje se pri prijavi za volontiranje na sajtu i pri potvrdi zadatka za konkretan događaj. Platforma čuva verziju, datum i vrijeme potvrde.

Shown at volunteer sign-up on the site and when a task for a specific event is confirmed. The platform stores the version, date and time of confirmation.

Prijavljujem se da volontiram na događaju [naziv, datum] u ulozi [redar / prijave / okrepa / podjela kostima / fotograf / dječija zona / voda / drugo] i potvrđujem:

I am signing up to volunteer at the event [name, date] in the role of [marshal / registration / refreshments / costume distribution / photographer / children's zone / water / other] and I confirm that:

  1. Imam navršenih 18 godina. [Za lica od 15 do 18 godina: prijavu podnosi i potvrđuje roditelj ili staratelj, koji je saglasan sa ulogom; takvi volonteri ne rade sa novcem, na vodi ni sami sa djecom.]
  2. Volontiram dobrovoljno i bez naknade. Opravdane troškove koje udruženje unaprijed odobri (prevoz, materijal) refundira uz račun.
  3. Proći ću upoznavanje prije zadatka i raditi samo zadatke za koje sam upoznat/a; pratiću uputstva rukovodioca događaja, redara, spasilaca i medicinske službe.
  4. Pročitao/la sam i prihvatam Kodeks ponašanja i, ako je moj zadatak sa djecom, Politiku zaštite djece; potpisujem izjavu iz Politike zaštite djece i potvrđujem da protiv mene nije vođen niti se vodi postupak za krivično djelo protiv djece, polne slobode ili nasilja u porodici.
  5. Nosiću oznaku udruženja samo dok sam na zadatku i neću davati izjave u ime udruženja.
  6. Neću primati novac ni poklone od učesnika, korisnika ni sponzora; gotovinu primam samo u dvoje, uz potvrdu, i predajem je odmah blagajniku.
  7. Podatke o učesnicima, donatorima, korisnicima i djeci do kojih dođem na zadatku neću koristiti ni otkrivati.
  8. Zdravstveno sam sposoban/na za zadatak; obavijestiću koordinatora o svemu što može uticati na moju bezbjednost na zadatku.
  9. Fotografije: [ ] pristajem da budem prepoznatljiv/a na objavljenim materijalima [ ] ne pristajem.
  10. Kontakt za hitne slučajeve: [ime, telefon]. Veličina majice: [ ].
  11. Moji podaci obrađuju se po Politici privatnosti; mogu tražiti brisanje po završetku angažmana.
  1. I am 18 years of age or older. [For persons aged 15 to 18: the application is submitted and confirmed by a parent or guardian, who agrees to the role; such volunteers do not work with money, on the water or alone with children.]
  2. I volunteer voluntarily and without pay. Justified costs approved by the association in advance (travel, materials) are reimbursed against a receipt.
  3. I will attend a briefing before the task and perform only the tasks I have been briefed for; I will follow the instructions of the event manager, marshals, lifeguards and the medical service.
  4. I have read and accept the Code of Conduct and, if my task involves children, the Child Safeguarding Policy; I sign the declaration under the Child Safeguarding Policy and confirm that no proceedings have been or are being conducted against me for a criminal offence against children, against sexual freedom or of domestic violence.
  5. I will wear the association's badge only while on task and will not make statements on behalf of the association.
  6. I will not accept money or gifts from participants, beneficiaries or sponsors; I accept cash only in pairs, against a receipt, and hand it over to the treasurer immediately.
  7. I will not use or disclose data about participants, donors, beneficiaries and children that I come across on the task.
  8. I am medically fit for the task; I will inform the coordinator of anything that may affect my safety on the task.
  9. Photographs: [ ] I consent to being recognisable in published materials [ ] I do not consent.
  10. Emergency contact: [name, telephone]. T-shirt size: [ ].
  11. My data is processed under the Privacy Policy; I may request its deletion once my engagement ends.

[ ] Potvrđujem. Datum i vrijeme bilježi platforma.

[ ] I confirm. The platform records the date and time.

DIO B: UGOVOR O VOLONTIRANJU (STALNE ULOGE)

PART B: VOLUNTEER AGREEMENT (RECURRING ROLES)

Zaključuje se u pisanom obliku, u dva primjerka ili elektronski, za uloge sa redovnim zadacima: vođa tima (volonteri, logistika, komunikacije, fotografija, partnerstva), veza sa klubovima, rukovodilac, blagajnik i koordinator volontera ogranka, lice za zaštitu djece, i svaki drugi angažman koji traje duže od [[PLACEHOLDER: broj, prema Zakonu o volonterskom radu]] sati mjesečno ili [[PLACEHOLDER: broj]] mjeseci.

Concluded in writing, in two copies or electronically, for roles with regular tasks: team lead (volunteers, logistics, communications, photography, partnerships), club connector, chapter lead, chapter treasurer and chapter volunteer coordinator, safeguarding lead, and any other engagement lasting longer than [[PLACEHOLDER: number, per the Law on Volunteering]] hours a month or [[PLACEHOLDER: number]] months.

UGOVOR O VOLONTIRANJU broj [[PLACEHOLDER: broj ugovora]]

VOLUNTEER AGREEMENT No. [[PLACEHOLDER: agreement number]]

zaključen dana [datum] u Tivtu između:

concluded on [date] in Tivat between:

Nevladinog udruženja „Santamore“, Teuta 113, Porto Montenegro, 85320 Tivat, registarski broj [[PLACEHOLDER: registarski broj]], PIB [[PLACEHOLDER: PIB]], koje zastupa [ime i prezime], Izvršni direktor (u daljem tekstu: organizator volontiranja), i

the Non-governmental association “Santamore”, Teuta 113, Porto Montenegro, 85320 Tivat, registration number [[PLACEHOLDER: registration number]], PIB [[PLACEHOLDER: PIB]], represented by [first and last name], Executive Director (hereinafter: the volunteering organiser), and

[ime i prezime], JMB ili broj putne isprave [broj], adresa [adresa], e-pošta [adresa], telefon [broj] (u daljem tekstu: volonter).

[first and last name], JMB or travel document number [number], address [address], e-mail [address], telephone [number] (hereinafter: the volunteer).

Član 1 — Predmet

Article 1 — Subject

Volonter se obavezuje da za organizatora volontiranja obavlja volonterske aktivnosti u ulozi [naziv uloge], opisane u Prilogu 1 (opis uloge), dobrovoljno i bez naknade, radi ostvarivanja ciljeva udruženja. Volontiranje ne zasniva radni odnos i ne stvara pravo na zaradu, naknadu za rad ni druga prava iz radnog odnosa.

The volunteer undertakes to perform volunteer activities for the volunteering organiser in the role of [role name], described in Annex 1 (role description), voluntarily and without pay, in order to further the association's goals. Volunteering does not establish an employment relationship and creates no right to a salary, remuneration for work or other rights arising from employment.

Član 2 — Trajanje i obim

Article 2 — Duration and scope

Ugovor se zaključuje na [[PLACEHOLDER: određeno vrijeme do datuma / neodređeno vrijeme]]. Očekivani obim angažmana je oko [broj] sati mjesečno, prema dogovoru sa [nacionalni kontakt / koordinator volontera / Izvršni direktor]; volonter nije dužan da prihvati zadatak koji ne može obaviti i o tome obavještava koordinatora što prije.

The agreement is concluded for [[PLACEHOLDER: a fixed term until a date / an indefinite term]]. The expected scope of the engagement is about [number] hours a month, as agreed with the [national contact / volunteer coordinator / Executive Director]; the volunteer is not obliged to accept a task they cannot perform and informs the coordinator of this as early as possible.

Član 3 — Obaveze organizatora volontiranja

Article 3 — Duties of the volunteering organiser

Organizator volontiranja se obavezuje da: volonteru obezbijedi upoznavanje i obuku potrebnu za ulogu, uključujući obuku iz Politike zaštite djece kada je uloga uključuje; obezbijedi uslove, opremu, materijale i uputstva za bezbjedan rad; imenuje lice koje je volonteru stalni kontakt; refundira opravdane troškove iz člana 5; obezbijedi osiguranje iz člana 6; obrađuje podatke volontera po Politici privatnosti; na zahtjev izda potvrdu o volontiranju sa opisom uloge, trajanjem i brojem sati; volontera tretira sa poštovanjem, zaštiti ga od uznemiravanja i sasluša njegove prijedloge i prigovore.

The volunteering organiser undertakes to: provide the volunteer with the induction and training the role requires, including training in the Child Safeguarding Policy where the role involves it; provide the conditions, equipment, materials and instructions for safe work; name a person who is the volunteer's permanent contact; reimburse justified costs under Article 5; provide the insurance under Article 6; process the volunteer's data under the Privacy Policy; issue on request a certificate of volunteering with the role description, duration and number of hours; treat the volunteer with respect, protect them from harassment and hear their suggestions and complaints.

Član 4 — Obaveze volontera

Article 4 — Duties of the volunteer

Volonter se obavezuje da: obavlja zadatke savjesno i po uputstvima, u okviru uloge iz Priloga 1; prođe upoznavanje i obuku; poštuje Statut, Kodeks ponašanja, Politiku zaštite djece, Pravila o sukobu interesa, Pravila o ograncima i druge akte udruženja koji se odnose na ulogu, i potpiše izjave koje ti akti traže; čuva povjerljivost podataka iz člana 8; ne zaključuje ugovore, ne preuzima obaveze, ne prima sponzorstva ni donacije na lični račun i ne daje javne izjave u ime udruženja bez pisanog ovlašćenja; rukuje novcem i imovinom udruženja samo po pravilima o gotovini i troškovima; prijavi sukob interesa, incident i povredu pravila; vodi evidenciju sati na način koji odredi koordinator; vrati opremu, materijale i pristupne podatke po prestanku ugovora.

The volunteer undertakes to: perform tasks conscientiously and according to instructions, within the role under Annex 1; complete the induction and training; comply with the Statute, the Code of Conduct, the Child Safeguarding Policy, the Conflict of Interest Policy, the Chapter Rules and the other acts of the association that apply to the role, and sign the declarations those acts require; keep the confidentiality of data under Article 8; not conclude contracts, assume obligations, receive sponsorships or donations into a personal account or make public statements on behalf of the association without written authorisation; handle the association's money and property only under the cash and expense rules; report conflicts of interest, incidents and breaches of the rules; keep a record of hours in the manner the coordinator sets; return equipment, materials and access credentials on termination of the agreement.

Član 5 — Troškovi

Article 5 — Expenses

Volonter ima pravo na refundaciju opravdanih troškova nastalih u vezi sa volontiranjem (prevoz, materijal, komunikacija, ishrana na zadatku dužem od [[PLACEHOLDER: broj]] sati), koje je koordinator unaprijed odobrio, uz račun i zahtjev podnesen u roku od 30 dana; udruženje refundira u roku od 15 dana od urednog zahtjeva. Refundacija troškova nije naknada za rad. Paušalne naknade se ne isplaćuju, osim ako ih zakon izričito dozvoljava i Upravni odbor odluči, uz pisano mišljenje računovođe. [[PLACEHOLDER: potvrditi sa advokatom i računovođom koje naknade volonterima Zakon o volonterskom radu i poreski propisi dozvoljavaju bez oporezivanja]]

The volunteer is entitled to reimbursement of justified costs incurred in connection with volunteering (travel, materials, communication, meals on a task longer than [[PLACEHOLDER: number]] hours) which the coordinator approved in advance, against a receipt and a claim submitted within 30 days; the association reimburses within 15 days of a complete claim. Reimbursement of costs is not remuneration for work. Lump-sum allowances are not paid, unless the law expressly permits them and the Board so decides, with the accountant's written opinion. [[PLACEHOLDER: confirm with the lawyer and the accountant which allowances to volunteers the Law on Volunteering and the tax regulations permit without taxation]]

Član 6 — Osiguranje i bezbjednost

Article 6 — Insurance and safety

Organizator volontiranja osigurava volontera od posljedica nesrećnog slučaja za vrijeme obavljanja volonterskih aktivnosti [[PLACEHOLDER: da li je obavezno po Zakonu o volonterskom radu i pod kojim uslovima; polisa i osiguravač]], i obezbjeđuje da su aktivnosti na vodi, sa djecom i sa gotovinom pokrivene uslovima iz Pravila o ograncima. Volonter ne obavlja zadatak za koji nije upoznat ili opremljen, i ima pravo da odbije zadatak koji smatra opasnim, bez posljedica. Povredu na zadatku prijavljuje odmah rukovodiocu događaja ili koordinatoru; udruženje je bilježi kao incident.

The volunteering organiser insures the volunteer against the consequences of accidents during the performance of volunteer activities [[PLACEHOLDER: whether mandatory under the Law on Volunteering and under what conditions; policy and insurer]], and ensures that activities on the water, with children and with cash are covered by the conditions in the Chapter Rules. The volunteer does not perform a task for which they have not been briefed or equipped, and has the right to refuse a task they consider dangerous, without consequences. The volunteer reports an injury on the task immediately to the event manager or the coordinator; the association records it as an incident.

Član 7 — Odgovornost

Article 7 — Liability

Volonter odgovara za štetu koju namjerno ili krajnjom nepažnjom prouzrokuje organizatoru volontiranja ili trećim licima. Za štetu koju volonter prouzrokuje trećim licima obavljajući zadatak po uputstvima i u okviru uloge, prema trećim licima odgovara organizator volontiranja, koji može tražiti naknadu od volontera samo u slučaju namjere ili krajnje nepažnje. [[PLACEHOLDER: uskladiti sa odredbama Zakona o volonterskom radu i Zakona o obligacionim odnosima o odgovornosti za volontere]]

The volunteer is liable for damage they cause to the volunteering organiser or to third parties intentionally or by gross negligence. For damage the volunteer causes to third parties while performing a task according to instructions and within the role, the volunteering organiser is liable towards the third parties and may seek compensation from the volunteer only in the case of intent or gross negligence. [[PLACEHOLDER: align with the provisions of the Law on Volunteering and the Law on Obligations on liability for volunteers]]

Član 8 — Povjerljivost i podaci

Article 8 — Confidentiality and data

Volonter čuva kao povjerljive sve podatke o donatorima, korisnicima pomoći, učesnicima, djeci, članovima, sponzorima, zaposlenima i unutrašnjem radu udruženja do kojih dođe u ulozi, za vrijeme i nakon prestanka ugovora, i koristi ih samo za zadatak. Pristup sistemima udruženja koristi samo lično i ukida se danom prestanka ugovora. Volonter ne fotografiše niti objavljuje učesnike, korisnike ni djecu privatnim uređajima i nalozima. Podaci volontera obrađuju se po Politici privatnosti i čuvaju [[PLACEHOLDER: broj]] godine nakon prestanka ugovora.

The volunteer keeps confidential all data about donors, beneficiaries, participants, children, members, sponsors, employees and the internal work of the association that they come across in the role, during and after the termination of the agreement, and uses it only for the task. Access to the association's systems is used only personally and is revoked on the day the agreement ends. The volunteer does not photograph or publish participants, beneficiaries or children with private devices or accounts. The volunteer's data is processed under the Privacy Policy and kept for [[PLACEHOLDER: number]] years after the agreement ends.

Član 9 — Rad sa djecom

Article 9 — Working with children

Ako uloga uključuje rad sa djecom, volonter prije prvog zadatka potpisuje izjavu iz Politike zaštite djece, prolazi obuku i, za stalne uloge iz te politike, dostavlja uvjerenje o nekažnjavanju [[PLACEHOLDER: pravni osnov, Politika zaštite djece, dio IX]]. Udruženje može, bez navođenja razloga i bez posljedica po volontera, rasporediti volontera na zadatke bez kontakta sa djecom.

If the role involves working with children, before the first task the volunteer signs the declaration under the Child Safeguarding Policy, completes the training and, for the permanent roles under that policy, provides a criminal record certificate [[PLACEHOLDER: legal basis, Child Safeguarding Policy, part IX]]. The association may, without giving reasons and without consequences for the volunteer, assign the volunteer to tasks without contact with children.

Član 10 — Sukob interesa, pokloni i mediji

Article 10 — Conflicts of interest, gifts and media

Na volontera se primjenjuju Pravila o sukobu interesa: prijavljuje interese i sukobe, ne prima poklone iznad simbolične vrijednosti ni novac ni od koga u vezi sa radom udruženja, ne učestvuje u odlukama u kojima ima interes. Ne daje izjave medijima o politici, finansijama, korisnicima ni incidentima; upite prosljeđuje Izvršnom direktoru istog dana. Na sopstvenim nalozima jasno govori u svoje ime.

The Conflict of Interest Policy applies to the volunteer: they declare interests and conflicts, do not accept gifts above token value or money from anyone in connection with the association's work, and do not take part in decisions in which they have an interest. They do not make statements to the media on policy, finances, beneficiaries or incidents; they forward enquiries to the Executive Director the same day. On their own accounts they clearly speak in their own name.

Član 11 — Intelektualna svojina i fotografije

Article 11 — Intellectual property and photographs

Materijale koje volonter izradi u ulozi (tekstovi, fotografije, dizajn, spiskovi, planovi) udruženje može koristiti za svoj rad bez naknade i vremenskog ograničenja, uz navođenje autora gdje je uobičajeno; volonter zadržava autorstvo i pravo da ih koristi u svom portfoliju bez podataka o licima. Volonter pri potpisivanju bira da li pristaje da bude prepoznatljiv na objavljenim fotografijama i na stranici tima; izbor može promijeniti.

The association may use the materials the volunteer creates in the role (texts, photographs, design, lists, plans) for its work without payment or time limit, crediting the author where customary; the volunteer retains authorship and the right to use them in their portfolio without data about persons. At signing, the volunteer chooses whether they consent to being recognisable in published photographs and on the team page; the choice may be changed.

Član 12 — Prestanak

Article 12 — Termination

Svaka strana može raskinuti ugovor pisanim obavještenjem, uz otkazni rok od [[PLACEHOLDER: broj, npr. 15]] dana, bez navođenja razloga. Udruženje može raskinuti ugovor bez otkaznog roka u slučaju povrede Kodeksa ponašanja, Politike zaštite djece, Pravila o sukobu interesa ili pravila o novcu, uz saslušanje volontera po postupku iz Kodeksa. Ugovor prestaje i istekom roka, prestankom uloge ili sporazumno. Po prestanku volonter vraća opremu, materijale, oznaku i pristupne podatke u roku od 15 dana, a udruženje na zahtjev izdaje potvrdu iz člana 3.

Either party may terminate the agreement by written notice, with a notice period of [[PLACEHOLDER: number, e.g. 15]] days, without giving reasons. The association may terminate the agreement without a notice period in the event of a breach of the Code of Conduct, the Child Safeguarding Policy, the Conflict of Interest Policy or the rules on money, after hearing the volunteer under the procedure in the Code. The agreement also ends on expiry of its term, when the role ends or by mutual agreement. On termination, the volunteer returns the equipment, materials, badge and access credentials within 15 days, and the association issues on request the certificate under Article 3.

Član 13 — Ostalo

Article 13 — Other provisions

Na ugovor se primjenjuje pravo Crne Gore, posebno Zakon o volonterskom radu. Sporove strane rješavaju dogovorom, a ako to ne uspije nadležan je [[PLACEHOLDER: sud]]. Prilozi 1 (opis uloge), 2 (izjava o interesima) i 3 (izjava o zaštiti djece, ako se primjenjuje) čine dio ugovora. Ugovor je sačinjen u dva istovjetna primjerka, po jedan za svaku stranu, ili je potvrđen elektronski na platformi udruženja.

The agreement is governed by the law of Montenegro, in particular the Law on Volunteering. The parties resolve disputes by agreement and, failing that, the [[PLACEHOLDER: court]] has jurisdiction. Annexes 1 (role description), 2 (declaration of interests) and 3 (safeguarding declaration, where applicable) form part of the agreement. The agreement is drawn up in two identical copies, one for each party, or is confirmed electronically on the association's platform.

Za organizatora volontiranja: ____________________ Izvršni direktor. Volonter: ____________________. [Za volontera od 15 do 18 godina: roditelj ili staratelj ____________________.]

For the volunteering organiser: ____________________ Executive Director. Volunteer: ____________________. [For a volunteer aged 15 to 18: parent or guardian ____________________.]

Prilog 1 — Opis uloge

Annex 1 — Role description

PoljeSadržaj
Naziv uloge[npr. Vođa tima za volontere; Veza sa klubom; Koordinator volontera ogranka Tivat; Lice za zaštitu djece na događajima]
Svrha[jedna rečenica šta uloga postiže]
Zadaci[lista, najviše osam stavki]
Ovlašćenja[šta može odlučiti sam, šta traži odobrenje, šta nikad]
Kome odgovara[nacionalni kontakt / Izvršni direktor / rukovodilac ogranka]
Očekivano vrijeme[sati mjesečno; vodič tima: vođa tima 4 do 6 sati mjesečno, rukovodilac ogranka 1 dan mjesečno]
Obuka[upoznavanje; zaštita djece; gotovina; bezbjednost na vodi]
Rad sa djecom[da / ne]
Rukovanje novcem[da / ne]
Oprema i pristup[oznaka, majica, pristup platformi po ulozi, e-pošta]
Trajanje[od, do ili neodređeno]
FieldContent
Role[e.g. Volunteer team lead; Club connector; Volunteer coordinator of the Tivat chapter; Safeguarding lead at events]
Purpose[one sentence on what the role achieves]
Tasks[list, at most eight items]
Authority[what they may decide alone, what needs approval, what never]
Reports to[national contact / Executive Director / chapter lead]
Expected time[hours a month; team guide: team lead 4 to 6 hours a month, chapter lead 1 day a month]
Training[induction; child safeguarding; cash; water safety]
Child contact[yes / no]
Cash handling[yes / no]
Equipment and access[badge, T-shirt, platform access by role, e-mail]
Duration[from, to or indefinite]

DIO C: PRAVILA ZA VOLONTERE

PART C: VOLUNTEER RULES

Član 14 — Ko može volontirati

Article 14 — Who may volunteer

Volontirati može punoljetno lice i, uz pisanu saglasnost roditelja ili staratelja, lice od [[PLACEHOLDER: uzrast, prema Zakonu o volonterskom radu, npr. 15]] godina, na zadacima primjerenim uzrastu, bez novca, vode i samostalnog rada sa djecom. Strani državljani volontiraju pod istim uslovima [[PLACEHOLDER: potvrditi da li boravišni status ograničava volontiranje]]. Lice pravosnažno osuđeno za djelo protiv djece ne može volontirati ni na jednom zadatku.

An adult may volunteer and, with the written consent of a parent or guardian, so may a person aged [[PLACEHOLDER: age, per the Law on Volunteering, e.g. 15]] or over, on age-appropriate tasks, without money, water or unsupervised work with children. Foreign nationals volunteer under the same conditions [[PLACEHOLDER: confirm whether residence status restricts volunteering]]. A person finally convicted of an offence against children may not volunteer on any task.

Član 15 — Prijava, raspored i upoznavanje

Article 15 — Sign-up, rostering and briefing

Prijava ide preko sajta ili preko koordinatora volontera ogranka i unosi se u registar volontera (ime, kontakt, uloge, upoznavanja, sati, izjave). Koordinator raspoređuje zadatke, potvrđuje ih volonteru najmanje [[PLACEHOLDER: broj, npr. 7]] dana prije događaja sa mjestom, vremenom, trajanjem i kontaktom, i vodi upoznavanje od najmanje 15 minuta prije svakog događaja (uloge, bezbjednost, zaštita djece, gotovina, kome se prijavljuje problem). Volonter koji nije prošao upoznavanje ne dobija zadatak sa djecom, na vodi ni sa novcem.

Sign-up is through the site or through the chapter's volunteer coordinator and is entered in the volunteer register (name, contact, roles, briefings, hours, declarations). The coordinator assigns tasks, confirms them to the volunteer at least [[PLACEHOLDER: number, e.g. 7]] days before the event with the place, time, duration and contact, and holds a briefing of at least 15 minutes before every event (roles, safety, child safeguarding, cash, whom to report a problem to). A volunteer who has not attended the briefing is not given a task with children, on the water or with money.

Član 16 — Na zadatku

Article 16 — On duty

Volonter nosi oznaku, dolazi na vrijeme, javlja se koordinatoru pri dolasku i odlasku, ostaje na dodijeljenom mjestu dok ga ne zamijene, ne konzumira alkohol, prati uputstva i prijavljuje probleme. Zadatke na vodi obavljaju samo volonteri koje odredi nacionalno lice za bezbjednost, uz spasioce. Zadatke sa gotovinom obavljaju dva volontera zajedno. Volonter ne prevozi učesnike ni djecu svojim vozilom osim po Politici zaštite djece i uz odobrenje koordinatora.

The volunteer wears the badge, arrives on time, reports to the coordinator on arrival and departure, stays at the assigned post until relieved, does not consume alcohol, follows instructions and reports problems. Tasks on the water are performed only by volunteers designated by the national safety lead, with lifeguards present. Tasks with cash are performed by two volunteers together. The volunteer does not transport participants or children in their own vehicle except under the Child Safeguarding Policy and with the coordinator's approval.

Član 17 — Priznanje i podrška

Article 17 — Recognition and support

Udruženje volonterima obezbjeđuje: majicu ili oznaku, okrepu na zadatku, javnu zahvalnicu, potvrdu o volontiranju na zahtjev, poziv na godišnji susret volontera i, gdje je moguće, obuku koja volonteru koristi i van udruženja. Sati volontera unose se u godišnji izvještaj udruženja kao doprinos zajednice. Volonteri koji preuzmu istaknute uloge mogu biti predloženi za organe udruženja po Statutu. Udruženje pazi da iste ljude ne traži za sve: koordinator prati opterećenje i nudi pauzu prije nego što je neko zatraži.

The association provides volunteers with: a T-shirt or badge, refreshments on the task, public thanks, a certificate of volunteering on request, an invitation to the annual volunteer gathering and, where possible, training that is useful to the volunteer beyond the association. Volunteer hours are entered in the association's annual report as the community's contribution. Volunteers who take on prominent roles may be proposed for the association's bodies under the Statute. The association takes care not to ask the same people for everything: the coordinator monitors workload and offers a break before anyone asks for one.

Član 18 — Prigovori volontera

Article 18 — Volunteer complaints

Volonter može svaki problem, uključujući ponašanje drugih volontera, tima ili učesnika, prijaviti koordinatoru, rukovodiocu događaja, Izvršnom direktoru ili, ako se tiče njih, predsjedniku Upravnog odbora, po Kodeksu ponašanja. Prijava je povjerljiva i ne smije imati posljedice po volontera. Volonter ima pravo da bude saslušan prije svake mjere koja se na njega odnosi.

The volunteer may report any problem, including the conduct of other volunteers, the team or participants, to the coordinator, the event manager, the Executive Director or, if it concerns them, the President of the Board, under the Code of Conduct. The report is confidential and must have no consequences for the volunteer. The volunteer has the right to be heard before any measure that concerns them.

DIO A: UGOVOR O SPONZORSTVU

PART A: SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT

UGOVOR O SPONZORSTVU broj [[PLACEHOLDER: broj ugovora]]

SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT No. [[PLACEHOLDER: contract number]]

zaključen dana [datum] u Tivtu između:

concluded on [date] in Tivat between:

Nevladinog udruženja „Santamore“, Teuta 113, Porto Montenegro, 85320 Tivat, registarski broj [[PLACEHOLDER: registarski broj]], PIB [[PLACEHOLDER: PIB]], [[PLACEHOLDER: PDV broj ili „nije obveznik PDV-a“]], račun [[PLACEHOLDER: IBAN]], koje zastupa [ime i prezime], Izvršni direktor (u daljem tekstu: udruženje), i

the Non-governmental association “Santamore”, Teuta 113, Porto Montenegro, 85320 Tivat, registration number [[PLACEHOLDER: registration number]], PIB [[PLACEHOLDER: PIB]], [[PLACEHOLDER: VAT number or “not registered for VAT”]], account [[PLACEHOLDER: IBAN]], represented by [first name and surname], Executive Director (hereinafter: the association), and

[naziv privrednog društva ili lica], [adresa], registarski broj [broj], PIB [broj], PDV broj [broj], koje zastupa [ime i prezime, funkcija] (u daljem tekstu: sponzor).

[name of the company or person], [address], registration number [number], PIB [number], VAT number [number], represented by [first name and surname, position] (hereinafter: the sponsor).

Član 1 — Predmet

Article 1 — Subject

Sponzor se obavezuje da udruženju plati sponzorski iznos, odnosno pruži robu ili usluge iz člana 4, a udruženje se obavezuje da sponzoru pruži protivusluge promotivne prirode iz Priloga 1 (paket), u vezi sa [naziv događaja i datum / programom udruženja za godinu / kampanjom], u skladu sa ovim ugovorom.

The sponsor undertakes to pay the association the sponsorship sum, or to provide the goods or services in Article 4, and the association undertakes to provide the sponsor with the promotional consideration in Annex 1 (the package), in connection with [name and date of the event / the association's programme for the year / the campaign], in accordance with this agreement.

Sponzorstvo je ugovor sa protivuslugom i nije donacija. Sponzorski iznos ulazi u Operativni fond udruženja i koristi se za organizaciju događaja i rad udruženja; ne ulazi u Fond za pomoć i ne isplaćuje se korisnicima. Udruženje sponzorstvo objavljuje u javnom registru sa nazivom sponzora, iznosom ili vrijednošću i namjenom.

Sponsorship is a contract with consideration and is not a donation. The sponsorship sum goes to the association's Operations Fund and is used for organising events and running the association; it does not go to the Impact Fund and is not paid out to beneficiaries. The association publishes the sponsorship in the public ledger with the sponsor's name, the amount or value and the purpose.

Član 2 — Paket i protivusluge

Article 2 — Package and consideration

Protivusluge udruženja utvrđene su u Prilogu 1 po nivou paketa [Core Cost Partner / Title Partner / Gold / Silver / Local Business / Match Partner / In kind]. Svaki paket obuhvata najmanje: izvještaj sponzoru u roku od 30 dana od događaja (fotografije sa ljudima sponzora, broj učesnika, medijska pokrivenost, prikupljena sredstva i gdje su otišla); mjesto za tim zaposlenih sponzora na platformi udruženja; poziv na javnu predaju sredstava korisnicima.

The association's consideration is set out in Annex 1 by package tier [Core Cost Partner / Title Partner / Gold / Silver / Local Business / Match Partner / In kind]. Every package includes at least: a report to the sponsor within 30 days of the event (photographs with the sponsor's people, the number of participants, media coverage, the funds raised and where they went); a slot for a team of the sponsor's employees on the association's platform; an invitation to the public handover of funds to beneficiaries.

Udruženje protivusluge pruža u dogovorenom obliku, na dogovorenim mjestima i u dogovorenom periodu, sa dužnom pažnjom, i evidentira izvršenje svake stavke. Ako neku stavku ne može pružiti (na primjer zbog otkazivanja događaja), primjenjuje se član 9.

The association provides the consideration in the agreed form, at the agreed places and in the agreed period, with due care, and records the delivery of every item. If it cannot provide an item (for example because the event is cancelled), Article 9 applies.

Član 3 — Šta sponzorstvo ne daje

Article 3 — What sponsorship does not give

Sponzorstvo ne daje sponzoru: uticaj na to ko dobija sredstva udruženja, o čemu odlučuje isključivo Komisija za dodjelu sredstava po objavljenim kriterijumima; uticaj na izbor korisnika, zaposlenih, članova organa ni dobavljača; pristup podacima o donatorima, učesnicima, korisnicima ni volonterima; pravo da udruženje promoviše proizvode ili poruke suprotne ciljevima udruženja, Kodeksu ponašanja ili Politici zaštite djece; ekskluzivnost, osim ako je izričito ugovorena u Prilogu 1; pravo da naziv, znak ili materijale udruženja koristi van člana 6.

Sponsorship does not give the sponsor: influence over who receives the association's funds, which the Grants Committee alone decides under the published criteria; influence over the choice of beneficiaries, staff, members of bodies or suppliers; access to data on donors, participants, beneficiaries or volunteers; the right to have the association promote products or messages contrary to the association's goals, the Code of Conduct or the Child Safeguarding Policy; exclusivity, unless expressly agreed in Annex 1; the right to use the association's name, mark or materials beyond Article 6.

Udruženje zadržava pravo da odbije ili prekine prikazivanje sponzorskog materijala koji je nezakonit, uvredljiv, usmjeren na djecu na neprimjeren način, ili u suprotnosti sa članom 12.

The association reserves the right to refuse or stop displaying sponsor material that is unlawful, offensive, aimed at children in an inappropriate way, or contrary to Article 12.

Član 4 — Sponzorski iznos, roba i usluge

Article 4 — Sponsorship sum, goods and services

Sponzorski iznos je [iznos] EUR [[PLACEHOLDER: bez PDV-a / sa PDV-om, prema mišljenju računovođe]], plativ [jednokratno / u ratama: datumi] na račun udruženja iz zaglavlja, na osnovu računa udruženja, u roku od [[PLACEHOLDER: broj, npr. 15]] dana od prijema računa. Za Match Partner: sponzor uplaćuje iznos jednak donacijama prikupljenim u periodu [datum i vrijeme od–do], najviše do [iznos] EUR, u roku od 15 dana od dostavljanja obračuna iz javnog registra.

The sponsorship sum is [amount] EUR [[PLACEHOLDER: excluding VAT / including VAT, per the accountant's opinion]], payable [in one instalment / in instalments: dates] to the association's account in the heading, against the association's invoice, within [[PLACEHOLDER: number, e.g. 15]] days of receipt of the invoice. For a Match Partner: the sponsor pays an amount equal to the donations collected in the period [date and time from–to], up to a maximum of [amount] EUR, within 15 days of delivery of the statement from the public ledger.

Sponzorstvo u naturi: sponzor isporučuje [opis robe ili usluga, količina, rok, mjesto]. Strane saglasno utvrđuju vrijednost sponzorstva u naturi na [iznos] EUR radi paketa, evidencije i objave; ta vrijednost se ne fakturiše novčano, osim ako računovođa utvrdi da propisi traže drugačije. Roba mora biti ispravna i bezbjedna; usluge se pružaju sa pažnjom dobrog stručnjaka; za hranu, piće, medicinsku službu i mjerenje vremena sponzor obezbjeđuje propisane dozvole i osiguranje.

In-kind sponsorship: the sponsor delivers [description of the goods or services, quantity, deadline, place]. The parties agree the value of the in-kind sponsorship at [amount] EUR for the purposes of the package, the records and publication; that value is not invoiced in money, unless the accountant finds that the regulations require otherwise. Goods must be sound and safe; services are provided with the care of a good professional; for food, drink, medical services and timekeeping the sponsor obtains the required permits and insurance.

Član 5 — Porezi i računi

Article 5 — Taxes and invoices

Udruženje izdaje račun za sponzorstvo u skladu sa propisima Crne Gore. [[PLACEHOLDER: da li se na sponzorstvo obračunava PDV, da li je udruženje obveznik PDV-a i od kada, i da li prihod od sponzorstva podliježe porezu na dobit; potvrđuje računovođa]]. Svaka strana snosi svoje poreze. Ako se propisi ili status udruženja promijene tako da utiču na PDV, strane usaglašavaju iznos tako da neto iznos za udruženje ostane isti, osim ako je drugačije ugovoreno.

The association issues an invoice for the sponsorship in accordance with the regulations of Montenegro. [[PLACEHOLDER: whether VAT is charged on sponsorship, whether the association is registered for VAT and from when, and whether sponsorship income is subject to profit tax; to be confirmed by the accountant]]. Each party bears its own taxes. If the regulations or the association's status change in a way that affects VAT, the parties adjust the amount so that the net amount for the association stays the same, unless agreed otherwise.

Član 6 — Upotreba naziva i znaka

Article 6 — Use of names and marks

Udruženje ima pravo da naziv i znak sponzora koristi za protivusluge iz Priloga 1, u obliku koji sponzor dostavi, bez izmjena, za vrijeme trajanja ugovora i u izvještajima i arhivi nakon toga. Sponzor ima pravo da za vrijeme trajanja ugovora navodi da je sponzor udruženja ili događaja i da koristi znak udruženja i oznaku iz Priloga 2 (na primjer „Zvanični partner Santamore Santa Run 2026“), u obliku i uz pravila iz Priloga 2, bez izmjena i bez utiska da udruženje preporučuje proizvode sponzora. Svaka druga upotreba naziva, znaka, fotografija ili materijala udruženja traži prethodno pisano odobrenje. Po prestanku ugovora sponzor prestaje sa novom upotrebom, a već objavljeni materijali mogu ostati.

The association has the right to use the sponsor's name and mark for the consideration in Annex 1, in the form the sponsor supplies, unaltered, for the term of the agreement and in reports and archives afterwards. The sponsor has the right, for the term of the agreement, to state that it is a sponsor of the association or the event and to use the association's mark and the designation in Annex 2 (for example “Official partner of Santamore Santa Run 2026”), in the form and under the rules in Annex 2, unaltered and without giving the impression that the association endorses the sponsor's products. Any other use of the association's name, mark, photographs or materials requires prior written approval. On termination of the agreement the sponsor ceases any new use, and material already published may remain.

Fotografije sa događaja koje udruženje dostavi sponzoru za izvještaj i objave sponzor koristi samo uz navođenje udruženja, samo za nekomercijalnu komunikaciju o sponzorstvu, i samo one za koje postoji saglasnost prikazanih lica; fotografije djece sponzor ne objavljuje bez posebnog pisanog odobrenja udruženja.

Article 7 — Term

Ugovor stupa na snagu potpisivanjem i traje [do izvršenja svih obaveza u vezi sa događajem, najkasnije do datuma / do 31. decembra godine za godišnje partnerstvo]. Strane će najkasnije [[PLACEHOLDER: broj, npr. 60]] dana prije isteka razgovarati o obnovi; obnova nije automatska.

The parties will discuss renewal no later than [[PLACEHOLDER: number, e.g. 60]] days before expiry; renewal is not automatic.

Član 8 — Obaveze sponzora

Article 8 — Sponsor's duties

Sponzor: plaća sponzorski iznos i isporučuje robu ili usluge u rokovima; dostavlja logotip, tekstove i materijale u traženom formatu najkasnije [[PLACEHOLDER: broj, npr. 21]] dana prije događaja, jer kasnije dostavljeni materijali možda neće stići na štampu; određuje kontakt osobu; poštuje Kodeks ponašanja i Politiku zaštite djece za svoje predstavnike i promotere na događaju, uključujući pravilo da promoteri ne kontaktiraju djecu bez roditelja; ne prikuplja podatke učesnika na događaju bez saglasnosti učesnika i bez odobrenja udruženja; ne organizuje aktivnosti na događaju van dogovorenih; obavještava udruženje o svakoj promjeni koja može uticati na ugovor ili ugled događaja.

The sponsor: pays the sponsorship sum and delivers the goods or services on time; supplies the logo, texts and materials in the required format no later than [[PLACEHOLDER: number, e.g. 21]] days before the event, because materials supplied later may not make it to print; names a contact person; observes the Code of Conduct and the Child Safeguarding Policy for its representatives and promoters at the event, including the rule that promoters do not approach children without their parents; does not collect participants' data at the event without the participants' consent and without the association's approval; does not run activities at the event beyond those agreed; informs the association of any change that may affect the agreement or the reputation of the event.

Član 9 — Otkazivanje, odlaganje i izmjena događaja

Article 9 — Cancellation, postponement and changes to the event

Ako udruženje događaj odloži, protivusluge se pružaju na novom terminu; ako ga otkaže iz razloga van svoje kontrole (vrijeme, odluka nadležnog organa, viša sila), udruženje pruža protivusluge koje su i dalje moguće (objave, izvještaj, tim na platformi) i sa sponzorom dogovara: prenos sponzorstva na sljedeći događaj, srazmjerno umanjenje za nepružene stavke, ili pretvaranje u donaciju Fondu za pomoć po izboru sponzora. Ako udruženje otkaže događaj iz razloga koji su u njegovoj kontroli, vraća sponzoru srazmjerni dio iznosa za nepružene stavke u roku od 30 dana. Ako sponzor odustane nakon potpisivanja, plaća troškove koje je udruženje već imalo u vezi sa njegovim paketom (štampa, proizvodnja), a najviše [[PLACEHOLDER: procenat]] procenata iznosa.

If the association postpones the event, the consideration is provided on the new date; if it cancels the event for reasons beyond its control (weather, a decision of a competent authority, force majeure), the association provides the consideration that is still possible (posts, the report, the team on the platform) and agrees with the sponsor: carrying the sponsorship over to the next event, a proportional reduction for the items not provided, or conversion into a donation to the Impact Fund, at the sponsor's choice. If the association cancels the event for reasons within its control, it refunds the sponsor the proportional part of the sum for the items not provided within 30 days. If the sponsor withdraws after signature, it pays the costs the association has already incurred in connection with its package (printing, production), up to a maximum of [[PLACEHOLDER: percentage]] percent of the sum.

Član 10 — Odgovornost

Article 10 — Liability

Svaka strana odgovara drugoj za štetu koju prouzrokuje povredom ugovora, do visine sponzorskog iznosa, osim za štetu prouzrokovanu namjerno ili krajnjom nepažnjom. Udruženje ne odgovara za poslovne rezultate sponzora ni za obim medijske pokrivenosti. Sponzor odgovara za robu i usluge koje isporučuje i za ponašanje svojih ljudi na događaju. Ništa u ovom članu ne isključuje odgovornost koju po zakonu nije moguće isključiti.

Each party is liable to the other for damage it causes by breach of the agreement, up to the amount of the sponsorship sum, except for damage caused intentionally or by gross negligence. The association is not liable for the sponsor's business results or for the extent of media coverage. The sponsor is liable for the goods and services it delivers and for the conduct of its people at the event. Nothing in this Article excludes liability that cannot be excluded by law.

Član 11 — Povjerljivost i podaci

Article 11 — Confidentiality and data

Uslovi ovog ugovora su povjerljivi, osim naziva sponzora, nivoa paketa i iznosa ili vrijednosti, koje udruženje objavljuje u javnom registru i godišnjem izvještaju u skladu sa svojom politikom transparentnosti, na šta sponzor pristaje. Udruženje sponzoru ne dostavlja lične podatke donatora, učesnika, korisnika ni volontera; tim zaposlenih sponzora na platformi vidi samo ono što vide svi članovi tima. Ako sponzor u vezi sa događajem prikuplja lične podatke (nagradna igra, prijave), on je rukovalac tih podataka i obavještava lica o tome.

The terms of this agreement are confidential, except for the sponsor's name, the package tier and the amount or value, which the association publishes in the public ledger and the annual report in accordance with its transparency policy, to which the sponsor consents. The association does not give the sponsor personal data of donors, participants, beneficiaries or volunteers; the team of the sponsor's employees on the platform sees only what all team members see. If the sponsor collects personal data in connection with the event (a prize draw, sign-ups), it is the controller of that data and informs the persons concerned accordingly.

Član 12 — Etika i raskid

Article 12 — Ethics and termination

Udruženje može raskinuti ugovor bez otkaznog roka, uz zadržavanje već plaćenog dijela za pružene stavke i povraćaj ostatka, ako: sponzor ili njegovi predstavnici prekrše član 3, član 8 ili Kodeks ponašanja; protiv sponzora bude pokrenut postupak ili objavljena okolnost koja bi nastavak saradnje činila štetnim po ugled udruženja; sponzor pokuša da utiče na izbor korisnika ili na odluke organa; sponzor ne plati iznos ni u naknadnom roku od 15 dana. Sponzor može raskinuti ugovor bez otkaznog roka ako udruženje bitno prekrši član 2 i ne ispravi povredu u roku od 15 dana od pisane opomene, uz povraćaj srazmjernog dijela iznosa. Svaka strana može raskinuti ugovor uz otkazni rok od [[PLACEHOLDER: broj, npr. 30]] dana ako je događaj trajno otkazan.

The association may terminate the agreement without notice, keeping the part already paid for the items provided and refunding the rest, if: the sponsor or its representatives breach Article 3, Article 8 or the Code of Conduct; proceedings are brought against the sponsor or a circumstance is made public that would make continued cooperation harmful to the association's reputation; the sponsor attempts to influence the choice of beneficiaries or the decisions of the association's bodies; the sponsor fails to pay the sum even within an additional period of 15 days. The sponsor may terminate the agreement without notice if the association materially breaches Article 2 and does not remedy the breach within 15 days of a written warning, with a refund of the proportional part of the sum. Either party may terminate the agreement on [[PLACEHOLDER: number, e.g. 30]] days' notice if the event is permanently cancelled.

Član 13 — Ostalo

Article 13 — Other provisions

Na ugovor se primjenjuje pravo Crne Gore. Sporove strane rješavaju dogovorom, a ako to ne uspije, nadležan je [[PLACEHOLDER: sud]]. Izmjene ugovora važe samo u pisanom obliku. Prilozi 1 (paket i protivusluge), 2 (pravila upotrebe naziva i znaka) i 3 (izvještaj sponzoru) čine dio ugovora. Ugovor je sačinjen u dva istovjetna primjerka.

The agreement is governed by the law of Montenegro. The parties resolve disputes by agreement, and if that fails, the [[PLACEHOLDER: court]] has jurisdiction. Amendments to the agreement are valid only in writing. Annexes 1 (package and consideration), 2 (name and mark usage rules) and 3 (sponsor report) form part of the agreement. The Board adopts the sponsorship packages and price list for the year, on the proposal of the Executive Director. The starting proposal is the sheet from the team guide: Core Cost Partner [[PLACEHOLDER: amount, team guide: 10,000 EUR and above per year]]; Title Partner [[PLACEHOLDER: amount, team guide: 5,000 EUR per event]]; Gold [[PLACEHOLDER: amount, team guide: 2,500 EUR]]; Silver [[PLACEHOLDER: amount, team guide: 1,000 EUR]]; Local Business [[PLACEHOLDER: amount, team guide: 250 to 500 EUR]]; Match Partner (any amount, matching within a window); In kind (valued, recorded and recognised like cash). Every package must contain the three items in Article 2. Chapters sell sponsorships only under these packages, and the Executive Director may approve a deviation of up to [[PLACEHOLDER: percentage]] percent of the price, with reasons.

Član 15 — Ko pregovara, ko potpisuje, kako se fakturiše

Article 15 — Who negotiates, who signs, how it is invoiced

Pregovore vode Izvršni direktor, lice zaduženo za partnerstva i, u okviru paketa, rukovodioci ogranaka. Ugovor potpisuje isključivo Izvršni direktor; ugovor preko [[PLACEHOLDER: iznos]] EUR ili sa ekskluzivnošću prethodno odobrava Upravni odbor. Račun izdaje udruženje po uputstvu računovođe, sa oznakom „sponzorstvo“ i nazivom događaja; uplata ide isključivo na račun udruženja i knjiži se u Operativni fond, a dio koji pripada ogranku po objavljenoj formuli evidentira se za taj ogranak. Sponzorstvo u naturi se evidentira sa vrijednošću i objavljuje kao poklon u naturi sa oznakom sponzora.

Negotiations are led by the Executive Director, the person in charge of partnerships and, within the packages, the chapter leads. Only the Executive Director signs the agreement; an agreement above [[PLACEHOLDER: amount]] EUR or with exclusivity is approved by the Board in advance. The association issues the invoice as instructed by the accountant, marked “sponsorship” and with the name of the event; payment goes only to the association's account and is booked to the Operations Fund, and the share belonging to the chapter under the published formula is recorded for that chapter. In-kind sponsorship is recorded with its value and published as an in-kind gift with the sponsor named.

Član 16 — Provjera sponzora

Article 16 — Sponsor screening

Prije potpisivanja Izvršni direktor provjerava: da sponzor nije u djelatnosti koju je Upravni odbor isključio [[PLACEHOLDER: lista, npr. duvan, kockanje, oružje; odlučuje Upravni odbor, v. Pravila donacija čl. 18]]; da nema javno poznatih okolnosti koje bi sponzorstvo činile štetnim po ugled; da sponzor nije povezano lice nekog obveznika po Pravilima o sukobu interesa, a ako jeste, da je sukob prijavljen i da to lice ne učestvuje u odlučivanju; da sponzor prihvata član 3. Sponzorstvo od političke partije, kandidata ili vjerske zajednice se ne prima. Sponzorstvo alkoholnih brendova prihvata se samo za događaje za odrasle i bez brendiranja dječijih zona i materijala za djecu.

Before signing, the Executive Director checks: that the sponsor is not in an industry the Board has excluded [[PLACEHOLDER: list, e.g. tobacco, gambling, weapons; decided by the Board, see Donation Policy Art. 18]]; that there are no publicly known circumstances that would make the sponsorship harmful to the association's reputation; that the sponsor is not a connected person of a person covered by the Conflict of Interest Rules, and if it is, that the conflict has been declared and that person takes no part in the decision; that the sponsor accepts Article 3. Sponsorship from a political party, a candidate or a religious community is not accepted. Sponsorship from alcohol brands is accepted only for adult events and without branding of children's zones or children's materials.

Poreska olakšica koju vodič tima navodi kao prodajni argument (odbitak do 3,5 procenata bruto prihoda za humanitarna, sportska, zdravstvena, kulturna i ekološka davanja) koristi se u razgovorima sa sponzorima tek kada je računovođa potvrdi u pisanom obliku i kada je jasno da li se odnosi na sponzorstvo ili samo na donacije; do tada se ne navodi.

The tax relief the team guide cites as a selling point (a deduction of up to 3.5 percent of gross income for humanitarian, sports, health, cultural and environmental giving) is used in conversations with sponsors only once the accountant has confirmed it in writing and it is clear whether it applies to sponsorship or only to donations; until then it is not mentioned.

Član 17 — Isporuka i evidencija

Article 17 — Delivery and records

Lice zaduženo za partnerstva, ili do njegovog imenovanja Izvršni direktor, odgovara za isporuku svake stavke iz Priloga 1 i vodi evidenciju sponzora na platformi (naziv, nivo, iznos ili vrijednost, u naturi, ogranak, ugovor, stavke i status izvršenja, status: potencijalni, u pregovorima, potpisan, aktivan, završen). Izvještaj iz Priloga 3 šalje se u roku od 30 dana bez podsjećanja; nepravovremen izvještaj se bilježi kao propust. Razgovor o obnovi zakazuje se prije isteka. Sponzori se objavljuju na stranici partnera i u godišnjem izvještaju po nivou.

The person in charge of partnerships, or the Executive Director until one is appointed, is responsible for the delivery of every item in Annex 1 and keeps the sponsor record on the platform (name, tier, amount or value, in kind, chapter, contract, items and delivery status, status: prospect, in negotiation, signed, active, completed). The report in Annex 3 is sent within 30 days without being reminded; a late report is logged as a failure. The renewal conversation is scheduled before expiry. Sponsors are published on the partners page and in the annual report by tier.

F. Saglasnosti i izjave

F. Consents and declarations

Za dijete: posebna saglasnost oba roditelja ili staratelja, i tek po odluci nacionalnog lica za zaštitu djece.
  7. Kako želite da vas obavještavamo: [ ] telefon [ ] e-pošta [ ] poruka [ ] preko rukovodioca ogranka
  1. * The information in the application is accurate and complete; I know that inaccurate information means refusal and possible repayment of the funds.

I may withdraw my consent; before a decision, this means withdrawing the application.
  3. * I consent to the association verifying the statements made (an interview, a visit in the presence of two persons, a check with the supplier or institution with my approval).
  4. * I understand that every grant is published in the public ledger in a form that does not reveal identity (for example "a family from Tivat, medical costs, EUR 1,200") and that the Committee decides on grants under the published criteria; submitting an application creates no entitlement to funds.
  5. * Is the beneficiary or the applicant related to, or in a business or personal relationship with, any founder, member of a body, employee or volunteer holding a function in the association? [ ] no [ ] yes, with: [name and relationship]. (A "yes" does not mean refusal; it means that person takes no part in the decision.)
  6. Story and photograph (optional and without effect on the decision): [ ] I consent to the association publishing, subject to my later approval of the text, a short story without my name and address [ ] and a photograph in which I am recognisable [ ] I do not consent. Datum: [ ]. Potpis podnosioca (na papiru) ili potvrda na sajtu (verzija obrasca, datum i vrijeme bilježi platforma). Za dijete: potpis roditelja ili staratelja, odnosno ovlašćenog lica ustanove.

Date: [ ]. Signature of the applicant (on paper) or confirmation on the website (the platform records the form version, date and time). For a child: signature of the parent or guardian, or of the authorised person of the institution.

DIO B: UPUTSTVO ZA PODNOSIOCE

PART B: GUIDANCE FOR APPLICANTS

Prikazuje se uz obrazac i šalje uz potvrdu prijema.

Shown with the form and sent with the acknowledgement.

Ko može da traži pomoć. Svako. Ne treba vam veza ni preporuka. Pomoć tražimo za porodice u nevolji, djecu i mlade, mala lokalna preduzeća nakon štete i lokalne organizacije koje rade sa konkretnim ljudima. Prednost imaju ljudi sa područja gdje je novac prikupljen, ali to nije uslov.

Who can ask for help. Anyone. You do not need a connection or a recommendation. We raise help for families in trouble, children and young people, small local businesses after damage, and local organisations that work with specific people. People from the area where the money was raised have priority, but that is not a condition.

Za šta pomažemo. Za konkretan, dokumentovan trošak: liječenje, ljekove i pomagala; hitne popravke doma, grijanje, osnovne stvari nakon požara ili poplave; školu, terapije i sport za djecu; posljedice nesreće ili nepogode; opremu ili aktivnost škole, kluba ili ustanove. Ne pomažemo za redovne troškove života bez događaja koji ih je izazvao, za otplatu kredita i dugova, za troškove koji su već plaćeni (osim hitnih), za zarade, ni za ono što po zakonu plaća država ili osiguranje dok se ta mogućnost ne iscrpi.

What we help with. A specific, documented cost: treatment, medicines and aids; urgent home repairs, heating, basic things after a fire or flood; school, therapies and sport for children; the consequences of an accident or disaster; equipment or an activity of a school, club or institution. We do not help with regular living costs without an event that caused them, with repaying loans and debts, with costs already paid (except urgent ones), with wages, or with anything the state or insurance pays for by law until that possibility has been exhausted.

Kako ide. Pošaljete korak 1; u roku od tri radna dana vam se javljamo i zajedno popunjavamo korak 2, ako želite i uz pomoć rukovodioca ogranka. Nepotpunu prijavu ne odbijamo; kažemo vam šta nedostaje. Kada je prijava potpuna, o njoj odlučuje nezavisna Komisija za dodjelu sredstava, po objavljenim kriterijumima, u roku od 21 dan; u hitnom slučaju u roku od 48 sati. Odgovor dobijate pisano, sa razlozima ako je odbijena, i možete jednom tražiti ponovno razmatranje sa novim dokazima. Odobrena pomoć se po pravilu plaća direktno onome kome se duguje (bolnici, prodavcu, školi), u roku od deset dana od ispunjenja uslova.

How it works. You send step 1; within three working days we get in touch and fill in step 2 together, with the help of the chapter lead if you wish. We do not refuse an incomplete application; we tell you what is missing. Once the application is complete, the independent Grants Committee decides on it, under the published criteria, within 21 days; in an urgent case within 48 hours. You receive the answer in writing, with reasons if it is refused, and you may ask once for reconsideration with new evidence. Approved help is as a rule paid directly to whoever is owed (the hospital, the retailer, the school), within ten days of the conditions being met.

Šta objavljujemo. Svaku dodjelu objavljujemo u javnom registru, ali bez vašeg imena, adrese, dijagnoze ili bilo čega po čemu vas neko može prepoznati: samo „porodica iz Tivta, troškovi liječenja, 1.200 EUR“. Priču ili fotografiju objavljujemo samo ako to sami želite, i tek kada odobrite tekst. Vaši dokumenti ostaju kod Komisije i ljudi koji pripremaju spis, i ni kod koga drugog.

What we publish. We publish every grant in the public ledger, but without your name, address, diagnosis or anything by which someone could recognise you: only "a family from Tivat, medical costs, EUR 1,200". We publish a story or photograph only if you want it yourself, and only once you have approved the text. Your documents stay with the Committee and the people preparing the file, and with nobody else.

Ako se predomislite. Prijavu možete povući u svakom trenutku porukom na kontakt koji ste dali.

If you change your mind. You can withdraw the application at any time by a message to the contact you gave.

Pomoć u popunjavanju. Ako vam je lakše uživo, javite se na [[PLACEHOLDER: telefon ili e-pošta]]; član tima ili rukovodilac ogranka može doći kod vas, uvijek u dvoje.

Help with filling in the form. If it is easier for you in person, contact [[PLACEHOLDER: phone or email]]; a member of the team or the chapter lead can come to you, always in pairs.

DIO C: PRIJEM I OBRADA (INTERNO)

PART C: INTAKE AND PROCESSING (INTERNAL)

C.1 — Postupak prijema

C.1 — Intake procedure

  1. Prijem (Izvršni direktor ili lice koje odredi; rukovodilac ogranka za prijave sa svog područja): potvrda prijema automatski; kontakt u roku od tri radna dana; provjera samo potpunosti, bez ocjene osnovanosti; unos u evidenciju sa datumom prijema i ogrankom.
  2. Kompletiranje: poziv podnosiocu da popuni korak 2, uz ponudu pomoći; lista onoga što nedostaje šalje se u jednoj poruci, ne u više navrata; rok za dopunu [[PLACEHOLDER: broj, npr. 30]] dana, nakon čega se prijava zatvara kao nepotpuna uz obavještenje da se može ponovo podnijeti.
  3. Provjera povezanosti: odgovor na tačku 26 i registar interesa se provjeravaju prije nego što spis ode Komisiji; svako povezano lice se označava i isključuje iz pripreme i odlučivanja.
  4. Spis za Komisiju: prijava, prilozi, kratak neutralan sažetak (činjenice, bez preporuke), oznaka hitnosti ako podnosilac ili priprema tako ocijene, dostavljen najmanje pet dana prije sjednice; hitne prijave odmah predsjedniku Komisije.
  5. Obavještenje: pisano, u roku od pet dana od odluke, po obrascima C.2; kod odobrenja i uputstvo dobavljaču ili korisniku o načinu isplate.
  6. Evidencija: status prijave (primljena, u obradi, odobrena, odbijena, povučena, zatvorena kao nepotpuna), datumi, oznaka odluke Komisije, način isplate; lični podaci po rasporedu čuvanja iz Politike privatnosti.
  1. Receipt (the Executive Director or a person they designate; the chapter lead for applications from their area): automatic acknowledgement; contact within three working days; a check of completeness only, without assessing the merits; entry in the register with the date of receipt and the chapter.
  2. Completion: an invitation to the applicant to fill in step 2, with an offer of help; the list of what is missing is sent in a single message, not in several instalments; a completion deadline of [[PLACEHOLDER: number, e.g. 30]] days, after which the application is closed as incomplete with a notice that it may be resubmitted.
  3. Connection check: the answer to point 26 and the register of interests are checked before the file goes to the Committee; every connected person is flagged and excluded from preparation and decision-making.
  4. File for the Committee: the application, the attachments, a short neutral summary (facts, no recommendation), an urgency flag if the applicant or the preparer so assesses, delivered at least five days before the meeting; urgent applications go straight to the chair of the Committee.
  5. Notice: in writing, within five days of the decision, using the C.2 templates; for an approval, also instructions to the supplier or beneficiary on the method of payment.
  6. Records: application status (received, in review, approved, declined, withdrawn, closed as incomplete), dates, the reference of the Committee's decision, method of payment; personal data under the retention schedule in the Privacy Policy.

C.2 — Obrasci pisama

C.2 — Letter templates

Potvrda prijema (automatska). „Hvala što ste nam se javili. Vašu prijavu smo primili [datum] pod brojem [broj]. Javićemo vam se u roku od tri radna dana da zajedno prođemo sljedeći korak. Prijavu možete povući u svakom trenutku odgovorom na ovu poruku. Kako odlučujemo i šta objavljujemo: [veza na kriterijume i uputstvo].“

Acknowledgement (automatic). "Thank you for getting in touch. We received your application on [date] under number [number]. We will contact you within three working days to go through the next step together. You can withdraw the application at any time by replying to this message. How we decide and what we publish: [link to the criteria and the guidance]."

Šta nedostaje. „Da bi Komisija mogla da odluči, treba nam još: [lista]. Možemo pomoći da to pribavite; javite se na [kontakt]. Ako ne dobijemo dopunu do [datum], prijavu ćemo zatvoriti, a možete je ponovo podnijeti kad god budete imali dokumente.“

What is missing. "For the Committee to be able to decide, we still need: [list]. We can help you obtain it; contact us at [contact]. If we do not receive the additional material by [date], we will close the application, and you can resubmit it whenever you have the documents."

Odobreno. „Komisija za dodjelu sredstava je [datum] odlučila da odobri [iznos] EUR za [namjena] (odluka broj [oznaka]). Iznos ćemo platiti [dobavljaču: naziv / na vaš račun] u roku od deset dana od [uslov, npr. prijema računa]. Molimo vas da nam u roku od 30 dana od isplate potvrdite da je [trošak izvršen / roba primljena]. U javnom registru ova dodjela će biti prikazana kao „[uopšteni opis], [iznos] EUR“, bez vašeg imena. [Ako je odobreno manje od traženog: Komisija je odobrila manji iznos jer [razlog].]“

Approved. "On [date] the Grants Committee decided to approve EUR [amount] for [purpose] (decision number [reference]). We will pay the amount [to the supplier: name / to your account] within ten days of [condition, e.g. receipt of the invoice]. Please confirm to us within 30 days of payment that [the cost has been incurred / the goods have been received]. In the public ledger this grant will be shown as "[generalised description], EUR [amount]", without your name. [If less than requested was approved: the Committee approved a lower amount because [reason].]"

Odbijeno. „Komisija za dodjelu sredstava je [datum] razmotrila vašu prijavu i nije mogla da je odobri. Razlog: [razlog po kriterijumima, npr. trošak pokriva Fond za zdravstveno osiguranje; prijava se odnosi na redovne troškove bez događaja koji ih je izazvao; sredstva su u ovom trenutku dodijeljena hitnijim prijavama]. Ako imate nove dokaze ili se okolnosti promijene, možete u roku od 15 dana zatražiti ponovno razmatranje odgovorom na ovu poruku; Komisija će odlučiti na prvoj narednoj sjednici. Ako vam možemo pomoći da se obratite [nadležna služba], recite nam.“

Declined. "On [date] the Grants Committee considered your application and was unable to approve it. Reason: [reason under the criteria, e.g. the cost is covered by the Health Insurance Fund; the application concerns regular costs without an event that caused them; the funds are at this time allocated to more urgent applications]. If you have new evidence or your circumstances change, you may request reconsideration within 15 days by replying to this message; the Committee will decide at its next meeting. If we can help you approach [competent service], let us know."

Povučeno ili zatvoreno. „Vašu prijavu smo na vaš zahtjev povukli / zatvorili jer nismo dobili dopunu. Dokumente brišemo u skladu sa Politikom privatnosti. Uvijek se možete ponovo javiti.“

Withdrawn or closed. "We have withdrawn your application at your request / closed it because we did not receive the additional material. We delete the documents in accordance with the Privacy Policy. You can always get in touch again."

guide.html:
This is the working guide for the founders. It says what to collect, what to decide, which form each fact lands in, and what each draft is for. Open the forms and drafts at /admin/registracija in the console (staff only). Montenegrin is the operative text of everything that is filed; the English side is a translation for founders who do not read it. Nothing in this pack is legal advice: the lawyer reviews the Montenegrin before anything is signed.

1. What to do, in order

  1. Collect the facts in section 2. Every square-bracketed value in the forms is one of them.
  2. Fill the blue blanks in the console, in the language you think in. One value serves every form: the founders' names appear in the Decision, the Statute and the Minutes at once.
  3. Switch language once you are done. The blanks you changed are translated; read the other side, correct it, then press Save.
  4. Take the decisions in section 3 (statute option, terms, seal, Executive Director).
  5. Send the lawyer the Montenegrin side of the four filing documents (02, 03, 04, 05) and the Statute additions draft. Ask the questions in section 6 of the additions.
  6. Hold the founding assembly: all founders present, agenda as in the Minutes, adopt the Decision and the Statute, elect the President and Deputy of the Assembly and the Executive Director. Note the start and end time; those go into the Minutes.
  7. Print each filing document from the console (Print / PDF, Montenegrin side), sign where the lines are, and file them at the Ministry with photocopies of every founder's identity card. Tick the steps in form 01 as you go.
  8. After the registration decision arrives: order the seal, register the activity code at MONSTAT, open the bank account, get the PIB. Form 01 lists each step with the office it belongs to.
  9. Then the drafts: the Board adopts the policies in section 4 at its first session, and the public ones go on the website before the first event or donation.

2. Facts to collect (the blanks)

FactBlank in the consoleUsed inWho has it
Founders' full names, JMB and home addresses. Founder 1 is always shown; add the others with the button in the Complete panel, and a founder's row appears in every form once named. Three founders are the legal minimum for an association and the print check reminds you; five blanks are available. JMB (jedinstveni matični broj) is the 13-digit personal identification number printed on the Montenegrin identity card; a foreign founder gives the number from their passport or residence permit insteadFounder 1 to 502 Decision, 04 Statute (signatures), 05 MinutesEach founder, from the identity card
Address of the seat (street and number, Tivat)Address02, 03, 05Whoever provides the premises; the Ministry needs a real address, a founder's home is acceptable
Date of the founding assemblyDate of the founding assembly02, 03, 04, 05Set by the founders
Start and end time, venue of the assemblyStart time, End time, Venue address05Set by the founders
Who chairs the assembly, who takes the minutes, who is Deputy PresidentChair, Recorder, Deputy04, 05Elected at the assembly; decide beforehand
The Executive Director (the person authorised for representation): name, JMB, address. If they are one of the founders, pick the founder from the small menu next to the blank and the three values follow that founder. The same menu exists for the chair, deputy and recorderAuthorised person02, 03, 05The founders' decision; this person signs contracts and the Monri and bank paperwork
Chair's phone and email for the MinistryChair's phone, Chair's email03 (the applicant block is built from the name, address and chair blanks plus these two)The chair
Filing dateFiling date03The day you hand the documents in
Description of the mark in the centre of the sealSymbol in the centre of the seal04 Art. 8Brand: the Santamore icon; describe it in words

Goals, activities, economic activities, the seal's rim text and the four-year terms are already filled from the brief and the team guide. Check them; change them only with the lawyer.

3. Decisions to take before the assembly

  • Statute option. The template statute (form 04) is the minimum the Ministry accepts. The draft "Statute additions" adds the Board, the Grants Committee, chapters and proxy voting. Recommended: adopt the additions at founding, because a later change means a new assembly and a new filing. Form 04a is form 04 with the additions already merged and the articles renumbered (the template's 32 to 42 became 45 to 55; the proxy articles are 17a to 17f): print and file 04a instead of 04 if you adopt them. The English side of a new article is the draft's summary; the Montenegrin text is what is filed. Every form's wording can be changed in the console with "Edit text" (paragraphs and articles added, changed or removed; the blanks stay in Complete), so the lawyer's corrections go straight into the document.
  • Terms. Four years for the President of the Assembly, the Assembly and the Executive Director are pre-filled (the template's default). Shorter is allowed.
  • Economic activity. Article 35 lists the economic activities (event fees, merchandise). Keep it only if you intend to register with the Central Register of Business Entities (step 3 in form 01); otherwise the accountant advises removing it.
  • Short name. "NVU „Santamore“" is pre-filled; the Ministry accepts any short form that is not misleading.

4. The drafts: what each is, what it hangs on, what to add

Every draft is bilingual: Montenegrin paragraph, then its full English translation (the source files are docs/legal/governance/<id>.me.md and <id>.en.md). Edit either side in the console for review; the drafts do not auto-translate, so change both, and send the final wording to be folded into the source files, because the public pages of the site and the console's Rules section are built from those files, not from the console's copy.
